name: Completed and submitted the third essay, "The Vigil Behind the Glass."
description: On March 7, Sun Yuwei completed the third essay in her essay collection, Watch Behind the Glass, from the perspective of a bookstore owner, truthfully depicting the predicament of physical bookstores. On March 8, she submitted it to Southwest Literature, and it was quickly accepted. The creation of the essay collection continued to deepen.

subevent.name: Finalized the essay The Vigil Behind the Glass
subevent.description: On March 7, 2025, in her study at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei performed the final polishing and proofreading of the third prose piece, “Watching from Behind the Glass,” in her collection. Written from the perspective of an independent bookstore owner, it truthfully depicts the operational hardships and human warmth of physical bookstores. She confirmed that the manuscript met submission standards, finalized it, and saved the document.

subevent.name: Submitted to Southwest Literature and was accepted for publication.
subevent.description: On March 8, 2025, at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei sent the finalized essay The Vigil Behind the Glass by email to the submission address of the editorial department of Southwest Literature. That afternoon, she received a reply from the editor: the piece was quickly accepted and confirmed for publication in the next issue's column. Work on her essay collection continued to advance.

name: First attempt at running by Green Lake in the early morning, bought professional running shoes
description: On the morning of August 1, following the advice of her yoga partner, He Lu, Sun Yuwei put on her running shoes and tried running in Cuihu Park. She only lasted 800 meters before she was out of breath, but the morning glow in the sky and the golden light on the lake gave her the motivation to go on. That evening, she bought a pair of professional cushioned running shoes and resolved to build a running habit.

subevent.name: Early morning running attempt at Green Lake
subevent.description: Early in the morning on August 1, 2025, Sun Yuwei put on her running shoes and walked from home to Green Lake Park in Wuhua District, Kunming, to try running for exercise. She jogged along the lake but only managed about 800 meters before stopping, out of breath from exhaustion. Yet on the way she enjoyed the beautiful view of morning glow reflecting on the lake, felt encouraged, and resolved to keep building the habit of running.

subevent.name: Buying professional cushioned running shoes
subevent.description: That evening, Sun Yuwei went to a sports goods store in Wuhua District, Kunming. Based on her running experience during the day and the advice of her yoga partner He Lu, she chose a pair of professional cushioned running shoes. After trying them on, she paid and bought them, determined to use them in future running training to improve her posture and build up her physical strength.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - Sports Goods Store

name: Workstation organization and arrangement.
description: On the morning of July 3, Sun Yuwei went to MUJI and bought an acrylic file holder, a wooden pen holder, and a small desktop bookshelf. In the afternoon, she returned to her workstation and arranged her journaling tools, reference books, and mirrorless camera in separate sections. On the wall, she put up a quote from Kant: 'Beauty is the symbol of morality.' After arranging everything, she took a photo and sent it to her mother, writing: 'A second home.'

subevent.name: Going to MUJI to buy storage items
subevent.description: On the morning of July 3, Sun Yuwei walked from her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, to a nearby MUJI store. In the store, she carefully selected and purchased storage items such as an acrylic file rack, a wooden pen holder, and a small desktop bookshelf, preparing to set up her workstation in the afternoon.

subevent.name: Workstation organization and decoration, and sharing
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 3, Sun Yuwei returned to her study desk at home with the items she had purchased. She placed her journaling tools, reference books, and mirrorless camera in separate sections on the newly bought acrylic file stand, wooden pen holder, and small desktop bookshelf, and stuck a decorative paper with the Kant quotation 'Beauty is the symbol of morality' on the wall. After arranging everything, she took a photo with her phone and sent it to her mother via WeChat with the message, 'My second home.'
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Plan a family trip to Fuxian Lake for May Day and book a lake-view homestay
description: On the 25th, Sun Yutong, the elder sister, gave advance notice from Shenzhen that she would return to Kunming for the May Day holiday and suggested that the whole family take a short trip to Fuxian Lake. That evening, after a detailed discussion with her parents, Sun Yuwei decided to book a quiet guesthouse with a lake view. On the 26th, Sun Yuwei proactively used her recent writing fees to book the lakeside guesthouse online, getting ready for the family trip.

subevent.name: Elder sister notified that she would return to Kunming for May Day and proposed a trip to Fuxian Lake.
subevent.description: On April 25, 2025, Sun Yutong, who lives far away in Shenzhen, contacted Sun Yuwei via WeChat video call. She said she would return to Kunming during the May Day holiday and suggested the whole family take a short trip to Fuxian Lake in Yuxi City, hoping Sun Yuwei could help check accommodations and itinerary in advance.

subevent.name: Discussing the Fuxian Lake travel plan with parents.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 25, 2025, after receiving her sister's suggestion, Sun Yuwei discussed in detail the feasibility, schedule, and accommodation preferences for the trip to Fuxian Lake with her parents, Sun Mingyuan and Li Xiulan, in the living room of their home in Kunming. Her parents expressed support and hoped to book a quiet homestay with a lake view.

subevent.name: Used the manuscript payment to book a lake-view homestay at Fuxian Lake online.
subevent.description: On the morning of April 26, 2025, Sun Yuwei, based on the family discussion, searched for lakeside homestays around Fuxian Lake on a travel booking app on her phone. After weighing ratings, price, and views, she chose a lake-view homestay with two bedrooms and a living room, and used the writing fees she had recently earned to pay and complete the booking. She saved a screenshot of the order.

name: Discuss graduation thesis progress with supervisor
description: On the afternoon of March 5, Sun Yuwei went to the office of the School of Literature at Yunnan University to report the preliminary findings of her fieldwork to her advisor Wu Mingyuan and discuss the thesis framework. The advisor suggested supplementing the work by interviewing 2-3 readers to incorporate their perspectives, pointing the direction for the next stage of writing.

subevent.name: Prepare discussion materials.
subevent.description: In her home study in Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei organized her thesis fieldwork notebooks and preliminary findings, packed her computer, notebooks, and discussion materials into her bag, and prepared for the afternoon discussion with her advisor.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Go to the School of Literature at Yunnan University
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei set off from home and took a bus or walked to the office building of the School of Literature on the Chenggong Campus (or the main campus) of Yunnan University, reviewing fieldwork points along the way, preparing for the face-to-face meeting with her advisor Wu Mingyuan.
subevent.location: Kunming City, Yunnan Province - urban roads to Yunnan University

subevent.name: Discuss thesis progress with advisor Wu Mingyuan
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei reported her preliminary findings from the field survey to her advisor Wu Mingyuan in his office at the School of Literature, Yunnan University, showing her survey notes and preliminary framework. After listening, Advisor Wu Mingyuan suggested adding interviews with two or three readers to enrich the thesis theme and gave guidance on the next step of writing. The two talked for about an hour, and Sun Yuwei recorded the key suggestions.
subevent.location: Supervisor's office, School of Liberal Arts, Yunnan University, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Returned home and organized the content of the discussion.
subevent.description: After the discussion, Sun Yuwei left her advisor's office and took the bus home. Once home, she immediately took out her notebook and organized the advisor's suggested supplementary interview tasks and key framework revisions into a clear action-item list for next steps, marking them in the electronic copy of her thesis.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province: the road home and the study at home

name: Social insurance procedures
description: From 9:30 to 10:00 on the morning of July 21, Sun Yuwei organized and checked her ID card and household register in the study of her home in Wuhua District, Kunming. After confirming that everything was complete, she set off by bike. From 10:30 to 12:00, at the Wuhua District Social Security Center, she chose the minimum contribution base, handled the basic old-age insurance and medical insurance for urban workers, and set up automatic bank debit. After returning home, she pasted the payment voucher into her journal and wrote: 'I have written the first policy for my own future.'

subevent.name: Prepare materials and go out
subevent.description: From 9:30 to 10:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei organized and checked the ID card and household register needed for applying for social insurance in the study of her home in Wuhua District, Kunming. After confirming that all materials were complete, she got on her bicycle and set off for the Wuhua District Social Security Center.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Handle formalities at the social security center.
subevent.description: From 10:30 a.m. to 12:00, Sun Yuwei arrived at the Social Security Center of Wuhua District, Kunming. At the service window, she submitted her ID card and household registration booklet, clearly indicated her choice of the minimum contribution base in Kunming, and separately handled urban employee basic pension insurance and urban employee basic medical insurance. She also activated the bank auto-debit (custody) service and completed the first contribution procedures.
subevent.location: Wuhua District Social Security Center, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Going home to tidy up and write in my journal.
subevent.description: After 12:00 noon, Sun Yuwei cycled home, removed the payment voucher issued by the social security center from the receipt slip, pasted it into her journal, and beside it wrote in fountain pen: “Writing the first insurance policy for my own future.” After recording it, she put her ID card and household registration booklet back in place.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Write the first draft of the first chapter of the graduation thesis.
description: After discussing with her supervisor on March 12, Sun Yuwei followed the supervisor's advice and wrote the first draft of the first chapter of her thesis at home on March 13. The draft focused on the bookstore cultural ecology discovered during fieldwork, came to about 3,000 words, and she marked the interview content that still needed to be supplemented.

subevent.name: Discuss the framework of Chapter 1 of the thesis with my advisor
subevent.description: At the appointed time, Sun Yuwei discussed the framework of the first chapter of her graduation thesis in Professor Wu Mingyuan's office at the School of Literature, Yunnan University. Based on her preliminary fieldwork ideas, Professor Wu Mingyuan suggested focusing on the cultural ecology of bookstores and gave writing priorities and points to note. The discussion lasted about one hour.
subevent.location: Kunming - Professor's Office, School of Literature, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Write the first half of the first chapter of the thesis at home.
subevent.description: In her study at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei began writing the first chapter of her graduation thesis based on the framework she discussed with her advisor on March 12. She focused on describing the bookstore cultural phenomena discovered during field research, wrote from afternoon to evening, completed a first draft of about 1,500 words, and recorded interview points that still needed to be supplemented.

subevent.name: Complete the first draft of Chapter 1 of the thesis and mark the content that needs to be supplemented
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei continued writing Chapter One of her graduation thesis in her study at home in Kunming, completed the remaining part, and finally produced a first draft of about 3,000 characters. She carefully reviewed the whole text and used sticky notes to mark interview content that still needed to be supplemented (such as details from the bookstore owner's oral account and customer interviews), preparing for later revisions.

name: Designing a Zen-style flower arrangement corner for the yoga studio.
description: On March 6, 2025, at the invitation of yoga studio owner He Lu, Sun Yuwei, after discussing the design plan at Jingxin Yoga Life Studio, went to Dounan Flower Market to purchase materials such as succulents and driftwood. In the afternoon, she arranged a wabi-sabi style floral corner in the studio's rest area, with He Lu assisting throughout.

subevent.name: Accepted the invitation and communicated the design concept
subevent.description: On the morning of March 6, 2025, Sun Yuwei met with He Lu, the owner of Jingxin Yoga Life Studio in Kunming, to discuss the design plan for a flower arrangement corner. Based on He Lu’s need for a Zen atmosphere, Sun Yuwei proposed a design concept centered on a combination of succulents and dead wood. The two parties agreed on style, budget, and materials, and agreed to start installation that afternoon.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Prepare floral arrangement materials
subevent.description: At noon on March 6, 2025, Sun Yuwei went to Dounan Flower Market in Kunming to select succulents (such as Aeonium and Haworthia) and naturally shaped driftwood and pinecones needed for her design. She spent about two hours choosing and matching them, and brought them back to the yoga studio. Meanwhile, He Lu provided auxiliary materials such as old clay pots and hemp rope from the studio's storage room.

subevent.name: Design and arrange a Zen-style flower arrangement corner
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 6, 2025, in the corner of the rest area at Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center, Sun Yuwei used dead wood to build a framework and embedded succulents at staggered heights into the gaps between the pottery jar at the base and the dead wood, accenting it with twine wrapping and pinecones, creating a wabi-sabi miniature landscape. He Lu helped throughout with moving and adjusting the perspective. The entire arrangement took about three hours.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

name: Plan the framework for the remaining chapters of the essay collection.
description: On March 27, Sun Yuwei organized the table of contents for her essay collection at her home desk using her newly purchased MacBook Air. Drawing on fieldwork and column materials, she planned the themes and writing order for the remaining five essays and set a goal to finish the first draft by mid-April, making her writing plan clearer.

subevent.name: Organizing fieldwork and column materials
subevent.description: In her home study, Sun Yuwei organized the field research notes and published column articles she had accumulated before by theme, extracting core material and inspiration fragments that could be used for the remaining chapters of the essay collection.

subevent.name: Plan the writing order and execution schedule.
subevent.description: Based on the logical connections and emotional progression of the theme, Sun Yuwei arranged the writing order of the remaining five pieces and set an estimated completion time for each, forming a detailed schedule from March 27 to mid-April.

subevent.name: Update the essay collection's table of contents and first-draft targets.
subevent.description: On her MacBook Air, Sun Yuwei updated the full table of contents of her essay collection, incorporating the five newly planned essays, and recorded in her journal the milestone of completing the first draft by mid-April, reinforcing her intention to carry it out.

name: Read A Writer's Notebook and plan the morning journal
description: On the evening of January 9, Sun Yuwei was preparing to read in her home study in Kunming. Immersed in “A Writer's Notebook” and moved by the author's habit of keeping records, she decided to add a morning diary section, and immediately designed a template and planned the columns in her journal.

subevent.name: Preparing to read A Writer's Notebook
subevent.description: On the evening of January 9, in the study of her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei tidied her desk, brewed a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea, and took out "The Writer's Notebook" and her journal, ready to start reading and recording.

subevent.name: Immersive reading of 'A Writer's Notebook'
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei sat in the reading chair in her study, focused on reading the remaining chapters of The Writer's Notebook, carefully savoring the author's ideas about the habit of daily recording and writing methods, and from time to time copied sentences that resonated with her into her journal.

subevent.name: Reflected after reading and decided to add a morning diary
subevent.description: After reading A Writer's Notebook, Sun Yuwei was deeply moved by the author's habit of keeping daily records. Combined with her own love of journaling, she decided to add a morning diary section to her journal starting tomorrow, to help her better plan and reflect on each day.

subevent.name: Plan a morning diary section in the journal.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei immediately took out her journal and started designing the morning diary template on the last few blank pages, with columns for date, weather, today's goals, small gratitudes, and more. She decorated it simply with colored pens and stickers, making full preparations to start using it the next day.

name: Creation and fieldwork for the essay 'Poetry of the Wet Market'.
description: On February 14, she began writing the second essay of the collection, 'Poetry of the Vegetable Market'. She hit a bottleneck in the first draft, and her mother suggested she adopt the vendor's perspective, which suddenly enlightened her. On the weekend of February 15, she went to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market with her mother, using a mirrorless camera to capture the colors of produce and the people as illustration material. That night she stayed up revising the manuscript until the early morning, finally completing the revised draft.

subevent.name: Writing the first draft and breaking through a creative block
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei began writing the second piece of her essay collection, 'Poetry of the Vegetable Market,' according to plan. She wrote in her home study from morning to afternoon. When she completed the first half of the first draft, she hit a bottleneck: her descriptions were not vivid enough. That evening, while chatting with her mother, Li Xiulan, in the living room, her mother suggested she put herself in the vendors' shoes to feel the lively atmosphere of the market. This suggestion was an eye-opener for Sun Yuwei; she wrote down the inspiration on the spot and decided to go on a field visit to the market with her mother the next day.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Strolled through Zhuanxin Food Market with my mother to gather inspiration.
subevent.description: At 10 a.m. on the weekend, Sun Yuwei invited her mother Li Xiulan to go together to Kunming's famous Zhuanxin Food Market. She brought her Sony mirrorless camera, observed and photographed the brightly colored vegetables and fruits, busy vendors, and bustling crowds in the market, using the lens to record vivid scenes as illustrative material for her essay. As they walked, her mother told her the stories of various stalls and the origins of local ingredients. The two stayed in the market for about two hours, and at noon tasted douhua rice noodles at a small eatery near the market.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - Zhuanxin Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Stayed up late revising the manuscript until the revised draft was completed.
subevent.description: After returning home from the field trip, Sun Yuwei imported the photos into her computer, organized, and selected them. After dinner, she went to her study and began a comprehensive revision of the draft at 8 p.m., combining the details she had observed at the market during the day and her mother's suggestions, adding the vendors' dialogue and sensory descriptions of the food market. She stayed up until 1 a.m. the next day, finally completing a satisfactory revised draft. She saved the document and planned to add images and publish it later.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Video call with my older sister to share recent updates
description: On the evening of July 23, Sun Yuwei had a video call with her older sister Sun Yutong, who works in Shenzhen. She showed her sister the newly decorated balcony and the just-finished first draft of her essay collection, while her sister shared the good news of her promotion. The two chatted for forty minutes. Her sister encouraged her to keep running her self-media account well, and they agreed to return together to Kunming in August to visit their family. After hanging up, Sun Yuwei wrote in her diary: Even across the screen, you can feel the warmth of family.

subevent.name: Tidy the balcony and prepare the manuscript.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 23, Sun Yuwei was busy in the living room and balcony at home. She rearranged the newly added potted plants and small bookshelf, making the balcony tidy and cozy. Then she took the newly printed draft of her essay collection from the study and placed it next to her phone so she could show it to her sister during a video call.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home balcony and study

subevent.name: Video call with my older sister.
subevent.description: Around 8 p.m. on July 23, Sun Yuwei had a WeChat video call from her home in Kunming with her older sister Sun Yutong, who was working in distant Shenzhen. She first showed her sister the newly decorated balcony and the first draft of her essay collection, while her sister happily shared the good news of her promotion at work. The two chatted for about forty minutes. Her sister encouraged her to run her self-media well, and they agreed to return to Kunming together in August to visit relatives. The call was warm and intimate.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Recording her feelings after the call
subevent.description: After hanging up the video call, Sun Yuwei felt warm and encouraged. She took out her journal and fountain pen and wrote on a diary page how she felt that night: “I can feel my family’s warmth even through the screen.” She also briefly noted the details of her sister’s promotion and her August visit plans shared during the call, then put the journal back in the desk drawer.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Attended an academic lecture.
description: On the evening of February 20, Sun Yuwei walked from her home on Renmin Middle Road to the lecture hall of the School of Literature at Yunnan University to attend an academic lecture titled "Urban Culture and Memory Space." She took careful notes, and after the lecture ended, she talked with the speaker, Professor Zhang, discussing cases of independent bookstores in Kunming. She gained new inspiration, then walked back home.

subevent.name: Departing for the lecture venue
subevent.description: On the evening of February 20, after having dinner at home, Sun Yuwei took her notebook and pen and set out on foot at dusk for the lecture hall of the School of Literature at Yunnan University, planning to attend the academic lecture held that night.
subevent.location: Kunming: walking from home on Renmin Middle Road to Yunnan University

subevent.name: Attended an academic lecture.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei listened to a lecture titled ‘Urban Culture and Memory Space’ delivered by a renowned cultural geographer at the lecture hall of the School of Chinese Language and Literature, Yunnan University. She took careful notes and reflected on related questions throughout the lecture.
subevent.location: Kunming - Lecture Hall, School of Liberal Arts, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Academic exchange with the speaker
subevent.description: After the lecture, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to approach the speaker and talk, using Kunming's independent bookstores as an example to discuss the theoretical application of urban cultural memory spaces, and gained new research perspectives and inspiration.
subevent.location: Kunming - Lecture Hall, School of Liberal Arts, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Return home after the lecture ends
subevent.description: After finishing the exchange with the speaker, Sun Yuwei organized her notes, left the lecture hall of the School of Literature at Yunnan University, walked back to her home on Renmin Middle Road, and briefly reviewed the lecture content.
subevent.location: Kunming - walking from Yunnan University back to home on Renmin Middle Road

name: After receiving the manuscript fee, she shared the joy with her sister and planned future submissions.
description: On the evening of March 25, after Sun Yuwei received the payment for her contribution to Southwest Literature, she immediately shared the joy with her sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen via a WeChat video call. The sisters chatted for about half an hour. Her sister encouraged her to keep writing and suggested submitting her essay collection to a publishing house. After the call, Sun Yuwei felt much more confident, wrote down her sister's advice in her notebook, and began planning the submission.

subevent.name: Received notice of the manuscript payment
subevent.description: On the evening of March 25, Sun Yuwei received the notification that the manuscript fee from Southwest Literature had been credited. She confirmed the amount and planned to share the joy with her sister.

subevent.name: Video call with elder sister to share the joy of receiving the manuscript fee.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei video-called her sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen, on WeChat and excitedly shared the news that she had received a payment for her contribution to Southwest Literature. The two sisters talked for about half an hour. Her sister encouraged her to keep writing and suggested submitting her essay collection to a publishing house.
subevent.location: Kunming - at home (video call with Shenzhen - at home)

subevent.name: Sort out my feelings and take notes after the call.
subevent.description: After the video call, Sun Yuwei felt much more confident. She wrote down her sister's advice in her notebook and planned the next steps for submitting her essay collection.

name: New Year gathering with close girlfriends
description: On January 10, Sun Yuwei used WeChat to arrange with her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi to meet on the afternoon of January 11 at Zhiyu Coffee in Wuhua District, Kunming. On the 11th, Sun Yuwei arrived early and waited. The three then met and shared their New Year plans: Zhang Jing revealed her plan to switch to a cultural and creative company, Chen Sisi showed her flower arrangement work, and Sun Yuwei shared her writing plans and showed her journal. Their friendship deepened through the exchange.

subevent.name: Set a time and place for the gathering
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei chatted with her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi on WeChat and finally settled on meeting at 2 p.m. on January 11 at the independent café 'Zhiyu Coffee' in Wuhua District, Kunming.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District - Zhiyu Coffee

subevent.name: Going to the café to keep an appointment
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 11, Sun Yuwei walked to Zhiyu Coffee, an independent café near her residence, arrived at 13:50, and sat down early by the window to wait for her best friend.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District - Zhiyu Coffee

subevent.name: New Year gathering with close girlfriends
subevent.description: Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi arrived at the café one after another. The three sat around a table, each ordering a cup of coffee and dessert. Zhang Jing shared her plan to switch jobs to a cultural creative company, while Chen Sisi talked about her just-finished flower arrangement work. Sun Yuwei shared her New Year writing plan and showed everyone her new handmade journal. The three interacted frequently, the atmosphere was harmonious, and their friendship deepened through the exchange.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District - Zhiyu Coffee

name: Discuss and implement the annual writing plan.
description: On January 1, Sun Yuwei sorted through potential topics for her 2025 Kunming cultural essays in her home study, including the old streets of Kunming and the four seasons of Green Lake, and drafted an outline. On the afternoon of January 2, she communicated with Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Horizon, via WeChat about her annual writing plan and presented her topic directions. Xu Mingyuan gave her affirmation and suggested that she tie the essays to her collection, submitting one in-depth essay each month, with the first piece themed 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake' and a deadline of January 25. After the conversation, Sun Yuwei immediately organized the meeting notes, made a monthly submission schedule, and broke down the writing steps for the first piece.

subevent.name: Sorted out the year's writing directions and topic ideas.
subevent.description: Before the formal communication, on January 1, Sun Yuwei spent half a day in her home study in Kunming sorting out topics for the Kunming cultural essays she planned to write in 2025, including old streets in Kunming, the Four Seasons of Green Lake, and the transformation of Dianchi Lake. She also drafted a brief writing outline and a reference list, getting ready for the annual communication with her editor the next day.

subevent.name: Discussed the annual writing plan with editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 2, Sun Yuwei contacted Xu Mingyuan, editor of *Cultural Vision*, via WeChat, and the two had a detailed discussion about the 2025 writing plan. Sun Yuwei presented her organized topic directions, and Xu Mingyuan fully affirmed them, suggesting that she combine her essay collection work with column pieces, submit one in-depth essay per month, and clarified that the first essay's theme would be 'The Four Seasons of Green Lake' with a deadline of January 25. The whole conversation lasted about 45 minutes.

subevent.name: Compile communication notes and make a monthly manuscript submission plan.
subevent.description: After the communication ended, Sun Yuwei immediately organized the key points of her talk with Xu Mingyuan on her laptop, recording the confirmed topic direction, monthly submission dates, and specific manuscript format requirements into her writing plan. She also set an advance reminder on the 15th of each month to urge herself to complete the writing on time. She further broke down the writing steps for the first manuscript, “The Flow of Seasons at Green Lake,” and planned to complete the first draft before January 10.

name: Discussing column topics, organizing materials, and outlining the article
description: On February 13, in her study at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei discussed the first column topic with editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat, and they decided on Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street as the theme. Afterwards, she sorted through Qin Mingyuan's interview recordings and journal photos, selected usable material, planned the preliminary structure of the article based on this, and decided to use a mirrorless camera to take supplementary shots of Wenlin Street in the early morning and at dusk.

subevent.name: Communicated online with the editor about topic selection.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, at her home in Kunming, communicated online with Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Horizons, via WeChat to discuss the direction of the first topic for her column. Based on her recent interview material with Qin Mingyuan, the owner of Mingyuan Bookstore, she proposed the theme Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street. Xu Mingyuan expressed approval and put forward specific writing requirements.

subevent.name: Organized Qin Mingyuan's interview recording and journal photos.
subevent.description: At home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei reviewed the recording of her earlier interview with Qin Mingyuan, the owner of Mingyuan Bookstore, and flipped through her journal photos. She selected details related to the morning-and-evening atmosphere of Wenlin Street, such as the light at the bookstore entrance and Uncle Qin's daily activities, extracting verbal and emotional material for her article.

subevent.name: Planning the initial structure of the article
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, based on the topic direction confirmed with Xu Mingyuan and the organized materials, planned the structure of the first draft of the essay "Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street" on her laptop in the study. She listed the introduction, morning scene paragraphs, evening scene paragraphs, a close-up of the bookstore figure, and closing reflections, and marked the sensory details that still needed to be added.

subevent.name: Plan to take supplementary shots of the Wenlin Street scene.
subevent.description: While planning the article, Sun Yuwei realized that the existing journal photos were not enough to support the visual description of Morning and Evening, so she decided to use her mirrorless camera to shoot scenes on Wenlin Street in the early morning and at dusk within the next two days, to help render the atmosphere of the article. She wrote down the shooting times and camera placement ideas in her phone memo.

name: Viewed the contemporary art exhibition with Chen Sisi and had an in-depth exchange.
description: On Sunday, February 23, Sun Yuwei and her best friend Chen Sisi met at the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum to see the “Yunnan Young Artists Group Exhibition.” In the morning, Sun Yuwei confirmed the plans with Sisi via WeChat; in the afternoon, she took the bus to the museum and met Sisi at the entrance before going in together. While viewing the exhibition, Sisi, a gallery administrative assistant, interpreted the works from a professional perspective, while Sun Yuwei shared her literary reflections. The two had an in-depth discussion in front of the display boards, and the intellectual exchange gave Sun Yuwei a new understanding of the relationship between art and writing. In the evening, they tasted rose yogurt at a dessert shop next to the museum, where Sisi shared her curatorial insights and Sun Yuwei encouraged her to curate an exhibition combining literature and art in the future. They also agreed to attend an artist lecture together next time. After returning home that night, Sun Yuwei organized the day's notes, photos, and inspirations to accumulate material for her creative work.

subevent.name: Confirm the exhibition visit schedule
subevent.description: On the morning of February 23, Sun Yuwei contacted Chen Sisi via WeChat from her home in Kunming to confirm the exact time, location, and meet-up plan for viewing the “Yunnan Young Artists Group Exhibition” at the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum that afternoon, and she also looked up the exhibition materials in advance.
subevent.location: Home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Went to the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 23, Sun Yuwei took a bus from her home in Kunming to the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum and met Chen Sisi at the museum entrance at the agreed time; the two entered the museum together.
subevent.location: Kunming City, Yunnan Province - Kunming Contemporary Art Museum

subevent.name: Visited the exhibition and exchanged artistic views
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 23, Sun Yuwei and Chen Sisi carefully viewed the Yunnan Young Artists Group Exhibition at the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum. As a gallery administrative assistant, Chen Sisi used her professional knowledge to explain to Sun Yuwei the creative background, techniques, and artistic concepts of each work; Sun Yuwei, in turn, shared her feelings from the perspective of literature and writing. The two stopped in front of every work to discuss it, and the collision of ideas gave Sun Yuwei a new understanding of the relationship between art and writing.
subevent.location: Exhibition hall of Kunming Contemporary Art Museum, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Dessert shop conversation and plans for the next event
subevent.description: On the evening of February 23, after viewing the exhibition, Sun Yuwei and Chen Sisi went to a dessert shop next to the art museum and tasted rose yogurt. Chen Sisi shared her insights and interesting stories about curating exhibitions at the art museum, and Sun Yuwei encouraged her to try mounting an exhibition combined with literature in the future. When they parted, the two agreed to attend the museum's artist lecture together next time.
subevent.location: Dessert shop beside the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Return home and organize what I gained from the exhibition
subevent.description: On the evening of February 23, Sun Yuwei returned to her home in Kunming, organized the notes, photos, and inspirations from the day's exhibition visit, and recorded Chen Sisi's professional perspective and her own literary reflections in her journal, accumulating material for future creative work.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: A deep, heart-to-heart talk with my best friend at a café.
description: On the afternoon of March 30, Sun Yuwei met up with her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi at the Bookworm Café on Wenhua Lane. The three sat in a corner by the window. Sun Yuwei shared the joy of having her recent essays accepted and receiving the payment; Zhang Jing shared funny anecdotes from her teaching; and Chen Sisi recommended an upcoming contemporary art exhibition. They also exchanged books they had been reading recently and agreed to go browse bookstores together next time. The relaxed three-hour gathering made Sun Yuwei feel the warmth of friendship.

subevent.name: Meet up with a close friend and prepare to exchange books.
subevent.description: The day before, Sun Yuwei confirmed via WeChat with her best friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi a gathering on the afternoon of March 30 at the Bookworm Café on Wenhua Lane, and picked out two essay collections she had recently read as exchange gifts, packing them into a canvas bag.

subevent.name: Heading to Bookworm Café
subevent.description: At around 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei walked from home to Bookworm Cafe on Wenhua Lane, a journey of about 15 minutes. She arrived early, chose a corner seat by the window, ordered a brown sugar pearl milk tea, and waited for her two close friends.

subevent.name: Had a deep three-hour conversation with her best friend.
subevent.description: From 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM, Sun Yuwei met Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi in a window-side corner of Bookworm Café. Sun Yuwei shared her joy at having a prose piece recently accepted by Cultural Horizon and receiving payment; Zhang Jing complained about amusing incidents with her students and teaching pressure; Chen Sisi recommended an upcoming contemporary art exhibition at the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum. The three also exchanged books they had recently read and agreed to visit independent bookstores together the following week. During the afternoon, they kept refilling their drinks in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.

subevent.name: After returning home, wrote down her feelings about the gathering.
subevent.description: After getting home in the evening, Sun Yuwei took out her beloved journal and used a fountain pen to record the details and reflections from today's gathering with her best friend. She also pasted in the café's business card and a casual photo she had taken. She placed the book she had received from the book swap at her bedside, planning to start reading it next week.
subevent.location: Kunming - at the desk in the bedroom at home

name: Purchasing short-term accident insurance.
description: On February 25, following her mother's advice, Sun Yuwei bought a one-year comprehensive accident insurance policy for herself through a mobile app for 380 yuan. Considering her increasing frequency of field trips and her upcoming domestic cultural travel plans within the year, the insurance would provide basic protection. After purchasing, she backed up the electronic policy to her phone and cloud drive, and printed a paper copy to keep in her journal folder.

subevent.name: Discussing insurance matters with my mother
subevent.description: At home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei discussed with her mother, Li Xiulan, the recent increase in field trips for creative inspiration and the risks of planning domestic cultural trips. Her mother suggested she buy a one-year comprehensive accident insurance policy for basic protection.

subevent.name: Looked up and compared insurance products on her phone.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei browsed one-year comprehensive accident insurance products from multiple insurance companies on her mobile app, compared coverage amounts, premiums, and coverage scope, and finally chose a comprehensive accident insurance plan with a premium of 380 yuan.

subevent.name: Purchase insurance online
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei filled in the policyholder information and beneficiary information on the mobile app, confirmed it was correct, and used WeChat Pay to pay the 380 yuan premium, completing the purchase of a one-year comprehensive accident insurance.

subevent.name: Organize and save electronic insurance policies
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei saved the electronic insurance policy document she received to her phone album and backed it up to the cloud drive. She also printed a paper copy, folded it, and placed it carefully in the insurance section of her journal folder.

name: Thoroughly organize the wardrobe and donate old clothes
description: On the afternoon of the 24th, Sun Yuwei did a thorough cleanup of her wardrobe, folded winter clothes she no longer wore and ill-fitting garments, and cycled to drop them in the Red Cross used-clothing recycling bin. In her journal she wrote: 'Clothes move on, but memories never fade.'

subevent.name: Organize the wardrobe and sort the clothes.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 24, 2025, Sun Yuwei, in the bedroom of her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, opened the wardrobe and took out all the clothes, sorting them by season, frequency of wear, and fit, and filtering out winter clothes she no longer wore and old clothes that didn't fit.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Fold and pack clothes for donation
subevent.description: After sorting, Sun Yuwei folded the selected winter clothes and ill-fitting clothes one by one neatly, put them into a large eco-friendly bag, and prepared to take them to the Red Cross used-clothing recycling bin.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

subevent.name: Rode a bike to the recycling bin and dropped off clothes
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei carried a bag of clothes downstairs, got on her bicycle, and rode to the Red Cross used-clothing recycling bin near Renmin Middle Road in Wuhua District. She dropped the bag into the bin and took a photo to document it.
subevent.location: Community Used Clothing Recycling Point, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Record insights in the journal.
subevent.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk in the study, took out her beloved journal, and wrote the words, “Clothes flow, memories stay.” She then pasted in the photo taken during recycling and recorded her feelings about this act of letting go.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Revised and submitted the final draft of the graduation thesis and completed the academic procedures.
description: On June 5, Sun Yuwei revised the thesis format and wording according to the detailed suggestions of the defense committee, printed the final draft, then went to the office of the School of Literature at Yunnan University to submit it and sign for confirmation, formally completing all academic requirements for the undergraduate stage.

subevent.name: Revised the thesis according to the defense suggestions.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei, in her dormitory at Yunnan University, made final revisions and proofreading to the format and some wording of her graduation thesis based on the detailed suggestions from the defense committee, ensuring the thesis meets the submission requirements.
subevent.location: Yunnan University dormitory, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Printed the final draft of the paper.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei copied the revised electronic version of her paper to a USB drive, went to a print shop near the school, and printed and bound multiple copies of the final paper for submission and archiving.
subevent.location: Print shop near Yunnan University, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Submit the final manuscript and complete the academic formalities.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei took the printed and bound final version of her thesis to the office of the School of Liberal Arts at Yunnan University, submitted it to the academic affairs teacher, and signed the relevant documents to confirm, formally completing all undergraduate academic requirements.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - School of Literature, Yunnan University

name: Posted a long article sharing what she learned from the nonfiction workshop, sparking discussion among book friends
description: On the evening of June 15, Sun Yuwei published a long article titled Does Writing Need Methodology? on "Yuwei's Slow Notes," sharing what she had just learned from the nonfiction writing workshop that had just concluded. It sparked discussion among book friends, and she had an in-depth discussion with fellow book friend Yang Xiao about the boundaries of nonfiction writing.

subevent.name: Write the article "Does Writing Need Methodology?"
subevent.description: On June 15, 2025, during the day, Sun Yuwei was in her home study. Based on what she had just learned in the nonfiction writing workshop and combined with her own writing experience, she began writing a long article: Does Writing Need Methodology? She sorted out the core viewpoints from the workshop on nonfiction writing methods and the boundary between truth and fiction.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Publish a long article to “Yuwei Manlu”
subevent.description: On the evening of June 15, 2025, after finishing revising her article, Sun Yuwei published the long-form essay “Does Writing Need a Methodology?” on her personal WeChat official account, “Yuwei's Slow Record.” Soon after publishing, the article quickly received likes, comments, and shares from many readers and fellow book lovers.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Read and respond to book friends' comments
subevent.description: On the evening of June 15, 2025, Sun Yuwei checked reader messages and comments on the backend of “Yuwei Slow Record.” She replied to a discussion about the boundaries of nonfiction writing and had an in-depth exchange with her book friend Yang Xiao in the comment section, exploring the relativity of truth and fiction and the ethical responsibilities of writers.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Organize the ten core pieces of the essay collection's first draft and create a sample book
description: On the 21st, Sun Yuwei selected ten essays from her accumulated old drafts, confirmed them as the core of the first draft of the essay collection, and rearranged their order. On the 22nd, she printed and bound the essays into a booklet, hand-painted a scene of Green Lake as the cover, and made her first handmade sample book.

subevent.name: Ten Selected Core Essays
subevent.description: On the morning of the 21st, Sun Yuwei, in the study of her home in Kunming, carefully read and selected 10 essays from her accumulated old drafts that best represented her personal style and themes, as the core contents for the initial draft of the essay collection. She compared each piece's content quality, thematic fit, and completeness one by one, and finally determined the selected pieces.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Arranging the order of the articles
subevent.description: On the afternoon of the 21st, Sun Yuwei reordered the ten selected essays according to emotional progression and thematic logic, adjusted the layout of the chapters, and made them form a complete narrative thread. She used a notebook to write down the order and added a brief reason for each essay's placement.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Print the article and prepare binding materials.
subevent.description: On the morning of the 22nd, Sun Yuwei exported the arranged document of ten essays and printed it page by page on A4 paper with a home printer. After printing, she checked the layout and clarity of each page and prepared binding materials such as a hole punch, thread, and cardboard.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Hand-drew the cover and bound a sample copy.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of the 22nd, Sun Yuwei used watercolors to hand-paint a landscape of a corner of Green Lake at her desk as the cover. After the paint dried, she aligned the printed articles, punched holes, and sewed them together into a booklet, then pasted the painted cover onto cardboard to create the book cover, finally producing the first handmade sample copy of her essay collection.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: At my usual café, quietly commemorating the day my first column was published alone.
description: On the morning of March 15, Sun Yuwei took her newly purchased MacBook Air to Kafka Café on Wenlin Street, ordered a brown sugar pearl milk tea, and opened the first column article she had published four years earlier on her new computer. As she read it, she wrote a brief reflection on WeChat Moments. She recalled the anxious but excited version of herself from four years ago, and took a screenshot to save the article link. In the afternoon, she sent a voice message of thanks to her editor Xu Mingyuan, then recorded her current feelings and next writing plans in her journal.

subevent.name: Getting ready to head to the café
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei took her newly purchased MacBook Air from home, got her phone and journal ready, and went out to the Kafka Café on Wenlin Street in Kunming, planning to commemorate by herself the day her first column was published.

subevent.name: Arrived at the café and placed an order
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei arrived at the Kafka Café, found a seat inside, ordered her favorite brown sugar pearl milk tea from the staff, then opened her MacBook Air to review her first column article.
subevent.location: Kafka Café, Wuhua District, Kunming City

subevent.name: Read the column article and post a review on Moments
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used her MacBook Air to open the first column article she had published four years ago, read through the full text carefully, and recalled the nervousness and excitement of submitting it back then. She took a screenshot of the article link and wrote a short retrospective post on Moments to mark this special moment.
subevent.location: Kafka Café, Wuhua District, Kunming City

subevent.name: Sent editor Xu Mingyuan a voice message of thanks.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei sent a voice message via WeChat to Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision, thanking him for his guidance and support of her writing over the past four years and sharing how she felt when she reviewed her column article today.
subevent.location: Kafka Café, Wuhua District, Kunming City

subevent.name: Record mood and writing plan in the journal
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei took out the journal she carried with her and wrote down her feelings on the publication day of her commemorative column, as well as her writing plans for the coming period, including ideas for her essay collection and submission arrangements. Then she packed up her things, left the café, and went home.
subevent.location: Kafka Café, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Organize the outline and progress schedule for the essay collection
description: On January 22, after the final exams ended, Sun Yuwei used mind-mapping software at the desk in her home study to organize the complete outline of the essay collection 'Breathing at the Edge of the City', planning the themes, estimated word counts, and source materials for the 12 core essays, and synced the schedule into her journal, setting the goal of completing one essay per month and finishing the first draft during the summer vacation.

subevent.name: Preparing Creative Tools and Materials
subevent.description: After the final exams ended, at her desk in the home study, Sun Yuwei took out the writing notes, field-gathering materials, and reference books related to the essay collection “Breathing at the City's Edge” from the bookshelf, opened the mind-mapping software on her laptop, and prepared her journal and colored pens as preliminary preparations for organizing the outline.

subevent.name: Create a complete outline for the essay collection
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used mind-mapping software, taking "Breathing at the Edge of the City" as the central theme, and expanded branches for the 12 core essays one by one. For each essay she planned the topic title, estimated word count (about 2,000–3,000 words each), and main source material (such as visits to local bookstores, street observation notes, childhood memories), forming a clearly structured outline.

subevent.name: Synced the progress schedule into the journal and set goals
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei hand-wrote the planned creation schedule into her journal, including milestones such as completing one piece per month and finishing the first draft during summer vacation (July). She marked motivational words and decorative illustrations with colored pens on the journal pages to keep the plan clearly visible.

name: Start a regular skincare routine and establish a new self-care ritual.
description: Sun Yuwei booked basic facial skincare at a beauty salon on June 26, went there on the morning of June 28 to receive the service, and afterwards planned to have it once a quarter, establishing a self-care ritual.

subevent.name: Schedule a beauty salon care service
subevent.description: On June 26, Sun Yuwei contacted a reputable beauty salon in Wuhua District, Kunming by phone, booked a basic skin care treatment for the morning of June 28, and confirmed the service details and price.

subevent.name: Go to the beauty salon
subevent.description: On the morning of June 28, Sun Yuwei set out from her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, walking or taking public transportation to the beauty salon she had booked, buying daily skincare products on the way.
subevent.location: Kunming City, Wuhua District - from home to beauty salon

subevent.name: Received basic skin care treatment.
subevent.description: At the beauty salon, a beautician gave Sun Yuwei a complete basic skin care treatment, including cleansing, deep hydration, and soothing massage. The treatment lasted about 1.5 hours, and Sun Yuwei felt relaxed and her skin condition improved.
subevent.location: A comprehensive beauty salon in Wuhua District, Kunming City

subevent.name: Recording the caregiving experience and planning quarterly arrangements
subevent.description: After the treatment ended, Sun Yuwei returned home, recorded her detailed feelings and the effects of the first treatment in her journal, and set reminders in her phone calendar for the next treatment every quarter (September 28, December 28, March 28) to establish a regular self-care ritual.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Start a morning journal habit
description: On January 8, 2025, Sun Yuwei prepared her morning journal tools at home in Kunming and planned the format. On the morning of January 10, she wrote her first entry, recording her creative intentions and emotional temperature, accompanied by flower tea. On January 11, she fine-tuned the routine and changed the drink, solidifying the habit; she has done it every day since, accumulating material for her essay writing.

subevent.name: Preparing morning journal tools
subevent.description: In her study at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei took out a brand-new blank diary with a leather cover and a black gel pen from a drawer, and also selected rose tea from the tea cabinet, preparing the materials for the morning diary habit she was about to start. She also wrote on the flyleaf of the diary, 'Morning Essays — Starting January 10, 2025,' as an opening note, and planned the basic format for each daily record: date, weather, emotional temperature, creative intention, and free writing.

subevent.name: Write the first morning journal entry.
subevent.description: At 6:50 a.m. on January 10, 2025, at her desk at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei wrote her first morning diary entry in ten minutes according to the pre-planned format. She first recorded the day's weather as cloudy and marked her emotional temperature as 7/10, then wrote down the intention for a prose piece she planned to start that day: 'From the perspective of the elderly morning runners in Green Lake Park, capture the tranquility of the moment the city wakes up.' Then she did free writing, describing her anticipation and nervousness about developing this new habit. The whole process was accompanied by a cup of hot rose tea, as a fixed part of the opening ritual.

subevent.name: Adjust and solidify the morning journal routine.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 11, Sun Yuwei fine-tuned her morning diary routine in the study of her home in Kunming, referring to her experience on the first day. She changed the writing time from pure free writing to setting a creative intention for the first five minutes, followed by five minutes of diary-style recording. Meanwhile, she replaced the flower tea with brown sugar pearl milk tea as her drink, and decided to keep the diary on her bedside table so she could grab it as soon as she woke up. From then on, she would follow this routine every day to accumulate micro-level material for her prose writing.

name: Spring Festival flower arrangement decoration
description: On January 23, Sun Yuwei planned her route to the Dounan Flower Market at home and prepared flower arrangement tools. She then went to the market and, following Ikenobo-style flower arranging techniques, carefully selected wintersweet, pine branches, narcissus, and other flowers. After returning home, she created an arrangement celebrating the arrival of spring, decorated the living room, and took photos to remember the moment, savoring the festive mood.

subevent.name: Planning the flower arrangement outing and preparing tools
subevent.description: On the morning of January 24, Sun Yuwei planned the route to Dounan Flower Market in advance in her home study and prepared flower-arranging tools such as scissors, floral foam, and vases to ensure a smooth afternoon of creation.

subevent.name: Went to Dounan Flower Market.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 24, Sun Yuwei set off from home and took the subway or a taxi to Dounan Flower Market in Kunming, enjoying the scenery along the way and soaking in the festive atmosphere before the Spring Festival.
subevent.location: Kunming - Dounan Flower Market and en route.

subevent.name: Selecting flowers for the Spring Festival
subevent.description: At Dounan Flower Market, following the Ikenobo school of flower arrangement, Sun Yuwei carefully selected wintersweet for good fortune, pine branches for resilience, and narcissus for purity. She also bought a small amount of silver willow and green leaves for arrangements, and returned home once the flowers filled her basket.

subevent.name: Create a Spring Festival flower arrangement.
subevent.description: After returning home in the evening, Sun Yuwei spread old newspapers on the coffee table in the living room, took out the flower materials and tools, and used basic Ikenobo school flower-arrangement techniques to trim, fix, and arrange winter plum, pine branches, narcissus, and other materials, carefully creating an ikebana piece symbolizing good fortune for the new spring.

subevent.name: Decorate the living room and take photos as a memento.
subevent.description: After finishing the flower arrangement, Sun Yuwei placed it on the TV cabinet in the living room and adjusted its position so it harmonized with the indoor environment. She then used her phone to photograph the arrangement from several angles and shared the photos with her best friend Zhang Jing and her family, together savoring the ritual and festive atmosphere of the Spring Festival.

name: Sun Yuwei's complete Mingyuan Bookstore reading sharing session.
description: On January 18, 2025, Sun Yuwei prepared at home for the book-sharing event at Mingyuan Bookstore, sorting out her prose collection and reading reflections. On the afternoon of January 19, she went to Mingyuan Bookstore to attend the "2025 Reading Plan" book lovers' sharing session. She shared her own writing and participated in the discussion, exchanged contact information with other book lovers, and agreed on follow-up activities. After returning home, she organized her thoughts and thanked the bookstore owner.

subevent.name: Preparing content for the sharing session.
subevent.description: At her home study in Kunming, Sun Yuwei sorted selected excerpts from her essay collection 'Breath at the City's Edge,' reread 'A Writer's Notebook' to distill key insights, and drafted an outline for her speech, fully preparing for the sharing session at Mingyuan Bookstore.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore to attend the sharing session.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei set out for Mingyuan Bookstore in the afternoon. Upon arrival, she joined the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan and more than a dozen other book friends for the "2025 Reading Plan" reading sharing session.
subevent.location: Wenlin Street - Mingyuan Bookstore, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Shared the essay collection and reading reflections
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei introduced her in-progress essay collection “Breathing at the Edge of the City” to book friends at Mingyuan Bookstore, and shared her reflections on reading “A Writer's Notebook.” Her sharing sparked a lively discussion. Qin Mingyuan expressed appreciation for her chosen topic and suggested she pay more attention to the details of everyday street life.
subevent.location: Wenlin Street - Mingyuan Bookstore, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Exchange contact information and arrange follow-up activities.
subevent.description: After the sharing session, Sun Yuwei added several interested book friends on WeChat and agreed to visit Green Lake together in the future to find writing inspiration. She also briefly discussed her future writing plans with Qin Mingyuan.
subevent.location: Wenlin Street - Mingyuan Bookstore, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Return home to organize the takeaways from the sharing session.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei returned home, recorded the takeaways and inspiration from the sharing session in her journal, organized the information of the new book friends she had met, and sent a thank-you message to Qin Mingyuan.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Enjoying art-house films alone on Labor Day.
description: On the afternoon of May 3, Sun Yuwei went alone to Kunming Broadway Cinema to watch a newly released independent art film, Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains. During the film, she was deeply drawn to the delicate Jiangnan water-town imagery and the slow narrative rhythm. After the screening, she sat in the theater lounge and noted down her immediate feelings and associations in her journal, writing: 'A good film is like a lake, reflecting the ripples in one's own heart.'

subevent.name: Set off for the cinema.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 3, Sun Yuwei left her home on Renmin Middle Road in Wuhua District and took a bus to Kunming Broadway Cinema. She set off about 40 minutes early to make sure she had plenty of time to pick up her ticket and enter.

subevent.name: Watched the film Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 3, Sun Yuwei watched the independent arthouse film "Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains" alone in a screening room at Broadway Cinema in Kunming. She was deeply attracted by the delicate Jiangnan water-town imagery and slow narrative rhythm, and was immersed in the film's emotional atmosphere throughout.

subevent.name: Record journal reflections after watching the film
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 3, after the movie ended, Sun Yuwei sat down in the lounge of Broadway Cinema in Kunming, took out her journal from her bag, and recorded her immediate feelings and associations. She wrote: 'A good movie is like a lake, reflecting the ripples inside one's heart.' She also organized her appreciation notes on the film's composition and narrative rhythm.

name: Responding to reader criticism and adjusting the writing perspective
description: On the 18th, editor Xu Mingyuan forwarded a reader's critical letter that directly accused her article of being 'too petit bourgeois'; on the 19th, Sun Yuwei met with the editor for an in-depth discussion; on the 20th, she decided not to avoid her personal style, but to consciously incorporate more realistic perspectives into her subsequent writing to broaden the depth of her work.

subevent.name: Received a critical letter from a reader.
subevent.description: Editor Xu Mingyuan forwarded a reader's critical letter via WeChat, in which the letter directly accused Sun Yuwei's article of being "too petty-bourgeois." After reading the letter at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei conducted an initial self-reflection.

subevent.name: Had an in-depth online meeting with the editor.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei had an in-depth one-on-one conversation with editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat video, discussing the issues raised in the reader's critical letter, the persistence of her personal writing style, and possible directions for adjustment. Xu Mingyuan offered advice and encouraged her to try broadening her realistic perspective while maintaining her personal characteristics.

subevent.name: Decided to adjust the writing perspective
subevent.description: After the previous two days of reading, reflection, and the meeting with the editor, Sun Yuwei made a decision at her home in Kunming: not to avoid her personal style, but to consciously incorporate more realistic perspectives into her future writing in order to deepen her work. She recorded this decision in her journal and began outlining the next essay that blends realism.

name: Signed for the "Kunming Slices" column
description: On February 12, Sun Yuwei received a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan in the reading area of Mingyuan Bookstore, formally offering her a column at 300 yuan per 1,000 characters. She read the contract terms repeatedly, feeling both excited and anxious. Encouraged by her mother on the phone, she signed the electronic agreement. After signing, she saved a screenshot to her phone and stuck a small medal sticker in her journal to commemorate her transition from freelance writer to column author.

subevent.name: Discussed the contract signing with her mother on the phone.
subevent.description: After receiving the invitation, Sun Yuwei immediately called her mother, Li Xiulan, and explained in detail the column's writing requirements, remuneration standards, and cooperation agreement content. Her mother encouraged her on the phone to seize the opportunity, saying it was a recognition of her writing ability, and advised her to carefully confirm the copyright ownership terms. With her mother's support, Sun Yuwei became determined to sign.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming, Wuhua District - Mingyuan Bookstore - phone call

subevent.name: Sign the electronic agreement for the column
subevent.description: In the reading area of Mingyuan Bookstore, Sun Yuwei opened the electronic contract sent by editor Xu Mingyuan on her phone. After confirming each clause and having no objections, she signed the official agreement for the ‘Kunming Slices’ column using an e-signature app. Once the signing was complete, she saved a screenshot of the successful signing to her phone's photo album and replied to the editor immediately.

subevent.name: Record the contract-signing milestone in the journal.

name: After comparing prices, she bought a Kindle and imported e-books to prepare for travel reading.
description: On May 6, to reduce the weight of her travel luggage, Sun Yuwei compared prices for a Kindle Paperwhite online across platforms such as JD.com and Tmall, and then used her student discount to buy one for 788 yuan. She then imported e-book versions of essays, novels, and travel guides she had on hand and added notes. This budget-conscious purchase saved about 120 yuan. She posted an order screenshot along with a shopping guide on Xiaohongshu and received quite a few likes.

subevent.name: Compare Kindle prices online and place an order.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei compared prices of the Kindle Paperwhite in detail on platforms such as JD.com and Tmall, used her student discount to place an order for one at 788 yuan, completed the online payment, and saved about 120 yuan.

The counter sales assistant helped her check out.

name: Completed the third column draft and received praise from the editor.
description: From March 18 to 21, Sun Yuwei wrote the third article for the “Kunming Slices” column of “Cultural Horizon,” titled “Solar Terms at the Market,” using seasonal ingredients as a thread to depict Kunming's spring, drawing on her earlier fieldwork material from food markets. After sending it to editor Xu Mingyuan on the 21st, Xu replied that the piece “has both the flavor of daily life and a poetic quality,” and confirmed it would be included in the next issue.

subevent.name: Organized field notes and started writing
subevent.description: In her home study, Sun Yuwei sorted and categorized the seasonal ingredient notes she had recorded during her earlier field trips to Kunming's wet markets, mapped out the spring ingredient sequence according to the order of the solar terms, and started writing the first paragraph of the initial draft of Solar Terms in the Wet Market, completing an outline and opening of about 800 words.

subevent.name: Continued writing and revising the main body of the article.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei continued writing in the study at home, expanding on the outline from the previous day. Using seasonal ingredients such as shepherd's purse, spring bamboo shoots, and Chinese toon as examples, and weaving in personal memories and market observations, she wrote the main body of the article. In the afternoon, after completing about 1,500 characters, she made the first round of revisions, adjusting word order and paragraph structure to ensure the language was smooth and poetic.

subevent.name: Polish the ending and refine the details
subevent.description: In her study at home, Sun Yuwei wrote the ending of the article, closing the piece with a scene from Kunming's spring market and adding her personal reflections on the culture of the 24 solar terms. She then read through the full text three times, polished the wording sentence by sentence, checked for typos and punctuation, and added two fitting pictures selected from her field-trip photos. The final draft was completed, with a total of about 2,500 characters.

subevent.name: Sent the manuscript and received positive feedback from the editor.
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei sent the final draft of Solar Terms in the Food Market by email to Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision. In the afternoon, she received a WeChat reply from Editor Xu saying that the piece had the flavor of everyday life and also poetic quality, and confirming that the article would be published in the next issue's column. Sun Yuwei replied with thanks and took a screenshot to save the editor's praise, feeling satisfied.

name: Communicating with advisor about thesis progress

Professor Wu affirmed the value of the interview with Qin Mingyuan and provided reference materials on oral history methodology, suggesting that she continue to deepen her field research and combine academic study with writing practice.

name: Online shared reading of Invisible Cities and an attempt at prose rewriting

Yang Xiao suggested that she strengthen the use of metaphor in her essays. From the 11th to the 12th, she chose an old essay and tried rewriting it with metaphors to explore more diverse urban narratives.

subevent.name: Online group reading of 'Invisible Cities'
subevent.description: In front of the computer in the study of her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei had an online co-reading session via WeChat video with her reading buddy Yang Xiao, reading and discussing Calvino's *Invisible Cities* together. The two had an in-depth discussion on techniques of urban writing and literary metaphor, and Yang Xiao suggested that Sun Yuwei strengthen the use of metaphor in her prose.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Select an old article and think of a direction for rewriting
subevent.description: In her study at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei looked through her past prose works and selected an old piece suitable for metaphorical rewriting. subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Complete the metaphorical rewrite attempt of the essay

After finishing, she read through the full text and made appropriate modifications, resulting in the rewritten version.

name: Term paper discussion preparation, discussion, and organization.
description: On January 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei spent the morning in her dormitory preparing for the discussion of her term paper 'Narrative Strategies in Urban Cultural Essays,' including organizing her drafts, writing an outline, and printing the first draft. In the afternoon, she went to Professor Wu Mingyuan's office for an in-depth discussion, receiving literature recommendations and paper revision suggestions. After returning to the dormitory, she organized the key discussion points and planned follow-up research.

subevent.name: Pre-discussion preparation
subevent.description: On the morning of January 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei, at her desk in the Yunnan University dormitory, organized the draft and key questions for her term paper 'Narrative Strategies of Urban Cultural Prose,' wrote a discussion outline, and printed the paper's initial draft, preparing for the afternoon discussion with her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan.
subevent.location: Yunnan University dormitory, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Discuss the term paper with Professor Wu Mingyuan
