Professor Wu carefully reviewed Sun Yuwei's outline, offered revision suggestions, and recommended reference works such as "The Details of Literature" and "Cultural Geography." He affirmed Sun Yuwei's idea of combining essay collection creation with academic research and encouraged her to use the paper as a starting point to deepen her understanding of urban cultural narrative. Sun Yuwei carefully recorded her advisor's comments and consulted him on specific issues such as paper structure and case selection.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Office of Professor Wu Mingyuan, School of Humanities, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Discussion summary and follow-up planning
subevent.description: On January 5, 2025, at 15:40, after returning to the dormitory, Sun Yuwei immediately opened her laptop, organized the key points and reference list from the discussion into digital notes, updated her paper-writing plan, and set the research goals for the next stage (review the literature recommended by Professor Wu and revise the paper outline). She then wrote down the day's academic reflections in her journal and planned to go to the library the next day to borrow relevant books.
subevent.location: Yunnan University dormitory, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Complete record of the yoga headstand breakthrough
description: On the evening of July 9, 2025, Sun Yuwei tidied up her yoga mat in the living room of her home in Kunming and made a plan for the next day's headstand practice, placing the yoga mat against the wall in advance. At 6 a.m. on July 10, she warmed up for 10 minutes, then practiced headstands against the wall. After several adjustments, she succeeded in holding a stable headstand for 1 minute for the first time. While inverted, she felt the blood flow back and her view of the world re-form, and realized that "growth is not about conquering, but about gentle persistence." Afterwards, she did 10 minutes of relaxation poses. That morning, in her study, she recorded the experience in her journal with simple sketches, then turned it into a short essay published on her personal WeChat public account, as an important milestone on her path of practice.

subevent.name: Pre-sleep yoga preparation
subevent.description: On the evening of July 9, Sun Yuwei organized the yoga mat and props in her living room at home in Kunming, and wrote the next morning's practice plan in her phone's notes app, highlighting the steps and precautions for the headstand pose. She also placed the yoga mat against the wall in advance to prepare for the next day's wall-supported practice.

subevent.name: Morning yoga practice and headstand breakthrough
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on July 10, Sun Yuwei laid out her yoga mat in the living room. She first did a 10-minute full-body warm-up (activating her neck, shoulders, and core), then began practicing headstands against the wall. After several attempts to adjust her center of gravity and breathing, she succeeded for the first time in lifting both legs off the ground and holding the position steadily for 1 minute. While inverted, she felt blood flowing back and her vision rearranged, and a strong emotion surged inside her. She realized that "growth is not about conquering, but about persisting gently." After finishing the headstand, she continued with 10 minutes of relaxation poses to settle her heart rate.

subevent.name: Recording insights from a yoga breakthrough.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 10, Sun Yuwei, in her home study, recorded in detail the experience of her morning headstand breakthrough in her journal, including practice time, step-by-step details, and physical and mental insights, and added a simple sketch. She then turned the experience into a short article and published it on her personal WeChat official account, as an important milestone on her path of practice.

subevent.name: Attended online workshop and took notes
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Sun Yuwei attended the creative writing workshop 'Capturing Details in Urban Prose' held by Prose magazine via Tencent Meeting in her study. The featured guest, writer Chen Si'an, shared how to capture details from everyday city life and turn them into literary material. Sun Yuwei listened attentively throughout and took detailed notes on the key viewpoints and writing techniques.

subevent.name: Brief exchange with the guest speaker after class.
subevent.description: After the workshop ended, Sun Yuwei stayed in the meeting on her own initiative and had a brief exchange of about five minutes with writer Chen Si'an by raising her hand to ask questions. She asked how to transform personal emotional experience into public text. Chen Si'an gave specific suggestions and encouraged her to observe more and practice writing more. This exchange gave Sun Yuwei valuable creative inspiration.

subevent.name: Organizing notes and writing reflections.
subevent.description: The next morning, Sun Yuwei reorganized and integrated the notes from the previous day's workshop, adding her own thoughts and associations, and wrote a personal reflection of about 800 characters. She saved the organized notes and reflection in a writing material folder, planning to try out the techniques learned in the workshop in future writing.

name: Family Dinner Marking the End of Spring Festival
description: On the evening of February 2, her older sister Yutong was about to return to Shenzhen for work, so the whole family gathered for a hearty dinner. Sun Yuwei helped her mother prepare home-style dishes, used her mirrorless camera to capture the warm scenes of the family reunion, printed the photos and pasted them into her journal, and wrote a message with her best wishes for her sister.

subevent.name: Going to the food market to buy ingredients
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan went to the vegetable market in Wuhua District, Kunming, to buy ingredients for dinner such as vegetables, meat, mushrooms, and seasonings, preparing for the family dinner before her sister Sun Yutong returned to Shenzhen.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Prepare dinner dishes
subevent.description: From afternoon to evening, Sun Yuwei helped her mother Li Xiulan wash and prep ingredients in the kitchen at home, cooking home-style dishes, including Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles and mushroom hot pot—dishes that Sun Yutong likes—creating a warm family dinner atmosphere.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Family reunion dinner.
subevent.description: In the evening, the four of them—Sun Yuwei, her father Sun Mingyuan, her mother Li Xiulan, and her elder sister Sun Yutong—sat around the dining table at home, enjoying a hearty dinner, chatting while eating, sharing interesting holiday stories, and seeing off Sun Yutong, who was about to return to Shenzhen.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District home dining room.

subevent.name: Organize photos and paste them into the journal
subevent.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to her room, imported photos from her mirrorless camera into her computer, printed out a few of her favorites, and then pasted the photos onto the record page of her journal. She wrote a blessing with colored pens for her sister Sun Yutong as she returned to Shenzhen for work, completing the day's family memory journal.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Month-end financial review.
description: On the evening of January 30, at her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province, Sun Yuwei used a mobile bookkeeping app to review her overall income and expenses for January 2025, checking each income and expenditure item one by one. She confirmed that 82,000 yuan in writing fees had been credited, and that expenses such as the 5,000-yuan camera purchase, the 2,400-yuan annual yoga course fee, and about 1,800 yuan for dinners and New Year shopping were all correct.

subevent.name: View this month’s income and expense overview
subevent.description: On the evening of January 30, Sun Yuwei used a bookkeeping app on her phone at her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, to review the overall income and expenditure for January 2025. She checked the month’s total income and total expenses to prepare for a detailed review later.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

subevent.name: Check specific income and expense items.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei checked the specific entries in her bookkeeping app item by item: confirmed that the 82,000 yuan royalty had been credited, reviewed expenses such as 5,000 yuan for a camera purchase, 2,400 yuan for annual yoga course fees, and about 1,800 yuan for gatherings and New Year shopping, and calculated the accuracy of each amount.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

name: Sorted clothes for donation, shared thoughts on Douban, and then established a 'one in, one out' rule
description: During the day on April 26, 2025, Sun Yuwei sorted out about 15 old pieces of clothing at home and donated them to the community collection point. In the evening, she logged into Douban and posted in the 'Minimalist Life' group to share her organizing insights, then wrote down the 'one-in-one-out principle' in her journal to remind herself to be more cautious about buying clothes in the future.

subevent.name: Sort donated clothes
subevent.description: On April 26, 2025, during the day, Sun Yuwei, in the bedroom of her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, sorted out old clothes from her wardrobe that she no longer wore (including dated dresses, T-shirts she rarely wore, etc.), folded them neatly, and put them into storage bags. She sorted out about 15 pieces of clothing in total, then walked to the community charity clothing recycling bin near her residential area and completed the donation.
subevent.location: Home and community recycling point, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Share insights in the Douban Minimalism Group
subevent.description: On the evening of April 26, 2025, Sun Yuwei returned to her home study, opened her laptop and logged in to Douban, and posted a thread in the "Minimalist Life" group. The post recorded the day's clothing donation process and her reflections on "stuff hoarding" during tidying, and encouraged group members to try minimalist decluttering. The post included two comparison photos before and after tidying, and she then interacted with several group members in the comments section to exchange thoughts.
subevent.location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Set a 'one in, one out' rule in her journal
subevent.description: On the evening of April 26, 2025, after posting the sharing post, Sun Yuwei took out her journal (a loose-leaf notebook with a floral fabric cover) and solemnly wrote “one-in, one-out principle” in the blank space of the day’s diary page with a brown Sakura-brand gel pen, and drew a simple plus-minus symbol. She then pinned this principle onto the cork board in front of her desk, reminding herself that before purchasing clothes in the future, she must get rid of one similar item to keep the overall balance of her wardrobe.
subevent.location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Attending the flower arrangement flash event at Dounan Flower Market with Su Man
description: On March 21, Sun Yuwei and her close friend Su Man agreed to take part in a flower-arranging flash mob at Dounan Flower Market. On the 22nd, they went to the market together and used fallen flower material to create a large installation. The piece was photographed and covered by local media. After the report was published on the 23rd, Sun Yuwei shared it with family and friends, giving an initial demonstration of her floral creativity and social influence.

subevent.name: Scheduling a flash event with Su Man
subevent.description: The day before, Sun Yuwei confirmed with her best friend Su Man via WeChat the specific meeting time, location, and precautions for the March 22 flower arrangement flash-mob event at Dounan Flower Market, and discussed the personal tools to bring (such as scissors, thin thread, etc.), making sure both would arrive on time to participate in the creation.

subevent.name: Head to Dounan Flower Market to meet up
subevent.description: On the morning of March 22, Sun Yuwei set off from home and took the subway to Dounan Flower Market in Chenggong District, Kunming, where she met Su Man at the entrance. After briefly exchanging the event schedule, the two entered the designated area of the flower market flash-mob event together.

subevent.name: Participate in a pop-up flower arrangement creation
subevent.description: At the pop-up flower arranging event at Dounan Flower Market, Sun Yuwei and Su Man used discarded floral materials collected on site—fallen peach branches, fallen leaves, dried reeds, and so on—to collaboratively create a large installation artwork. The two conceived and built it while coordinating to fix the structure, and after about two hours they completed a three-dimensional floral installation themed 'Spring Revival,' which attracted other participants to stop and watch.

subevent.name: The work was documented with on-site photography
subevent.description: At the end of the flower arrangement pop-up event, local media reporters came to the site to take photos. Attracted by the works of Sun Yuwei and Su Man, they took multiple pictures of the installations and briefly interviewed the two about their creative concepts and the stories behind the floral materials used. Sun Yuwei was surprised but happy, and told the reporters about her original intention of using naturally fallen urban plant materials for eco-friendly creation.

subevent.name: Publishing and sharing the report
subevent.description: The next day, local media published a report on the Dounan Flower Market flower-arranging flash-mob event on their WeChat official account, which included photos of the floral installations created by Sun Yuwei and Su Man. When Sun Yuwei saw the report on her phone, she shared the link with her family and close friends' group chats, and took a screenshot to keep as a memento. The report received a small number of likes from local readers, giving an initial glimpse of her floral creativity and social impact.

name: Received the payment for her first column, recorded income and expenses for the first time, and shared the joy.
description: On August 10, Sun Yuwei logged into the magazine's backend in the morning to confirm that the column fee of 1,200 yuan had been remitted. At noon, she received the bank SMS notifying her of the deposit and verified it. In the afternoon, she recorded it as 'writing income' in her journal, then went over this month's expenses (yoga classes, running shoes, watercolor course enrollment, etc.) and found there was a slight surplus, initially forming a sense of income-expenditure balance. In the evening, she shared the joy of the writing income with her parents.

subevent.name: Check the status of the manuscript fee remittance
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei logged in to the submission portal of Cultural Vision magazine and her linked email from her phone at her home in Kunming, confirmed that the August column fee had been remitted by the finance department on August 9, and verified that the amount of 1,200 yuan was correct.

subevent.name: Confirm bank transfer received
subevent.description: Around 12:00 noon, Sun Yuwei received a bank SMS alert confirming that the 1,200 yuan manuscript fee had been successfully transferred into her personal savings account. She opened mobile banking to check the balance change and confirmed the amount matched her expectation.

subevent.name: Recorded writing income in the journal
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei sat at her bedroom desk and took out her latest journal. She opened the finance page, wrote the date and the note 'August column fee from Cultural Horizon' with a blue pen, recorded the amount as 1,200 yuan, drew a small symbol representing writing, and categorized it as 'writing income.'

subevent.name: Tally this month's expenses and summarize income and expenditure
subevent.description: After recording her income, Sun Yuwei turned to the expense page in her journal and checked this month's expenses item by item: yoga course renewal 800 yuan, new running shoes 369 yuan, watercolor class registration fee 450 yuan, and daily meals and miscellaneous expenses about 1,200 yuan. She calculated the difference between the month's total income and total expenses, found a small surplus, and gained a preliminary understanding of balancing income and expenses.

subevent.name: Sharing the joy of her manuscript income with family
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to mention to her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan at dinner that she had received the manuscript fee today and made a record. Both parents expressed happiness and encouragement. Her mother Li Xiulan suggested she try to develop a fixed bookkeeping habit in the future, while her father Sun Mingyuan reminded her to rest well outside of writing.

name: Balcony garden renovation and reading corner arrangement
description: On the morning of July 18, Sun Yuwei noticed that the potted plants on the balcony at home had withered, and on a whim discussed renovating the space with her mother, Li Xiulan. The two decided to remove the dead plants, add new flowers, and set up a reading corner. In the afternoon, the mother and daughter cleared out the withered potted plants from the balcony and swept the floor. Afterwards, they went to Dounan Flower Market and bought a pot of blue plumbago, a pot of mint, and some potting soil. Back home, they transplanted the new plants, brought in a small round rattan table and cushions, and arranged a reading corner. Sun Yuwei placed her journal and a few essay collections on the table. In the evening, she watered the new plants to settle their roots and sat in the reading corner for a trial read, while her mother brought over fruit and they enjoyed the evening sky together.

subevent.name: Decided to tidy up the balcony and make a plan.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 18, after getting up, Sun Yuwei saw that the potted plants on the balcony at home had withered, and on a whim discussed renovating the balcony with her mother, Li Xiulan. After discussion, the two decided to remove the dead plants, add new flowers, and set up a reading corner. Her mother supported the plan, and Sun Yuwei briefly planned a shopping list and a layout scheme.

subevent.name: Cleaned up the dead potted plants on the balcony.
subevent.description: In the afternoon of July 18, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan cleaned the balcony together. They emptied the dead potted plants along with the soil, then washed and stored the flowerpots. The two swept up the fallen petals and dust on the floor, making space to set up new plants and a reading corner.
subevent.location: Balcony at home, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Go to the flower market to choose new plants.
subevent.description: After cleaning up, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan went to Dounan Flower Market in Kunming. As planned, they selected a pot of blue plumbago and a pot of mint, and paid after comparing prices. They also bought new nutrient soil and a small flower shovel.

subevent.name: Set up a reading corner on the balcony
subevent.description: After returning from the flower market, Sun Yuwei and her mother transplanted the newly purchased blue plumbago and mint into balcony pots, then brought out a small round rattan table and two cushions, setting up a cozy reading corner in the corner of the balcony. Sun Yuwei placed the notebook she often uses for journaling and several essay collections she has been reading recently on the small round table. Her mother, Li Xiulan, helped while smiling and praising.
subevent.location: Balcony at home, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Evening flower watering, tidying up, and rest
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei watered the newly planted blue snowflakes and mint to settle the roots, and cleaned up the remaining dead leaves. She sat in the newly arranged reading corner, flipped through a few pages of an essay collection, and enjoyed the atmosphere of the renovated balcony. Her mother Li Xiulan brought fruit from the kitchen, and they enjoyed the evening sky together.
subevent.location: Balcony at home, Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Bought a MacBook Air, starting a new phase of digital writing
description: On the afternoon of March 20, after careful comparison, Sun Yuwei used the writing fees and column advance she had saved up to buy a silver MacBook Air (M2 chip, 16GB RAM, 512GB storage) at an Apple authorized reseller in Kunming. She deliberately chose the version with pinyin printed on the keyboard so she could write late at night. When she got home that evening, she opened Pages on the new computer and wrote her first document, "Tool Worship," recording the ritual shift from pen and paper to keyboard. The old notebook was neatly placed in a drawer as a backup. The expense of nearly 10,000 yuan made her wince, but it also made her feel that her writing career had entered a new stage.

subevent.name: Online comparison and decision-making
subevent.description: On the morning of March 20, in her home study, Sun Yuwei repeatedly compared the performance and prices of the MacBook Air M2 and the MacBook Pro across platforms such as Apple's official website, JD.com, and Zhihu. After consulting tech reviewers' evaluations and user reviews, she finally decided to buy a silver MacBook Air (M2 chip, 16GB RAM, 512GB storage, pinyin-engraved version) and confirmed that a local Apple authorized reseller in Kunming had it in stock.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Went to the dealer to purchase.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 20, Sun Yuwei brought her bank card and ID card and walked to the Apple Authorized Reseller store on Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming. She told the salesperson her configuration requirements, inspected the device, paid the full amount with her debit card (about 9,999 yuan), activated the device on the spot, set up the system, checked that the keyboard engraving was correct, and then returned home with the silver MacBook Air.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - Apple Authorized Reseller store

subevent.name: Use the new computer to write reflections on creative work
subevent.description: After dinner on March 20, Sun Yuwei returned to her desk in the bedroom, opened her silver MacBook Air, and launched Pages for the first time. She began writing an essay titled "Tool Worship," documenting how her sense of ritual and creative psychology changed from using pen and paper and an old laptop to switching to a new MacBook. As she wrote, she familiarized herself with the feel of the new keyboard. After about two hours, she completed the first draft, saved it, and synced it to iCloud.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Sorting out the old laptop.
subevent.description: Late at night on March 20, Sun Yuwei wiped her old laptop clean, plugged it in to charge fully, closed the screen, and carefully put it into the desk drawer, storing it properly as a backup machine. She reminded herself to buy a protective case and a docking station next week, and planned to migrate the writing materials from the old computer to her new MacBook over the weekend.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: First deposit into the travel fund.
description: On January 31, Sun Yuwei decided to set up a travel fund account and looked up relevant information; on February 1, she transferred 2,000 yuan into the account via mobile banking, then recorded the deposit in her journal and made a list of travel destinations.

subevent.name: Decided to set up a travel fund.
subevent.description: After the semester ended, Sun Yuwei decided to set up a dedicated travel fund account for this year's domestic cultural trips. She checked information about opening a small-amount installment savings account through the online banking app, and planned to transfer part of her royalties into it every month.

subevent.name: Transferred money into the first travel fund.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used the mobile banking app to transfer 2,000 yuan from her personal savings account to a dedicated travel fund account. After confirming the transfer was successful, she checked the balance of the fund account.

subevent.name: Record savings in the journal and plan the destination
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei took out her journal, recorded the details of depositing the first 2,000 yuan into her travel fund, and wrote a list of possible travel destinations, including Hangzhou, Dali, Chengdu, etc., expressing her aspiration for a cultural trip within the year.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - desk in the bedroom at home

name: First yoga practice
description: On January 6, I attended my first yoga class in life. Under the guidance of instructor He Lu, I completed the basic Sun Salutation. Although my hands and feet trembled slightly, I recorded this experience in my journal with an illustration, starting my yoga and meditation practice.

subevent.name: Attended the first yoga class of my life.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei went to Kunming Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center, where under the guidance of instructor He Lu she tried yoga for the first time, learning and completing the basic Sun Salutation sequence. During the session, her hands and feet trembled slightly, but with He Lu's encouragement she persevered through the class and felt an initial relaxation of body and mind.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Recording yoga experiences through journaling and illustrations.
subevent.description: After class, Sun Yuwei returned home, took out her treasured journal, and drew a simple sketch of herself practicing Sun Salutation with colored pencils. Beside it, she recorded in detail how she felt in her first yoga class, including her body's reactions and inner changes, thus starting her journey into yoga and meditation.

name: Weekend movie: 'Soul'
description: On Saturday evening, February 7, Sun Yuwei went alone to an independent cinema in Wuhua District for a re-release screening of *Soul*. She bought brown sugar bubble tea near the cinema and, while watching, was drawn into the warm story about the meaning of life, her eyes growing moist. After the show, she bought a postcard at the convenience store next to the cinema, wrote down her thoughts about the film, and pasted the postcard into her journal after returning home.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: On the evening of February 7, Sun Yuwei was in her bedroom at home choosing clothes. She brought her journal and pen, preparing to go to an independent cinema in Wuhua District to watch the movie Soul. She confirmed the cinema's location and showtime, and took her phone and wallet.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: On the way to the cinema
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei walked or took the bus from home to an independent cinema in Wuhua District, passing familiar streets along the way and feeling expectant. She had planned her route in advance to make sure she arrived before the movie started.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - street/bus

subevent.name: Buy milk tea and enter
subevent.description: After arriving near the cinema, Sun Yuwei first went to a nearby milk tea shop and bought a brown sugar pearl milk tea, then picked up her ticket and entered. Holding the milk tea and movie ticket, she found her seat and waited for the movie to start.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province - independent cinema and the milk tea shop beside it.

subevent.name: Watching the movie Soul
subevent.description: On the evening of February 7, 2025, Sun Yuwei watched a re-release of the movie Soul in the screening hall of an independent cinema in Wuhua District. Immersed in the warm story about the meaning of life, she was deeply moved by the plot, her eyes moist, sipping milk tea and feeling the film's healing power.
subevent.location: Screening room of an independent cinema, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: After the event ended, she bought postcards and wrote down her reflections.
subevent.description: After the movie ended, Sun Yuwei walked out of the cinema and went to the convenience store next door, where she picked out a postcard. Standing by the counter, she took out the pen she carried with her and wrote down her thoughts about the film, recording the lines and emotions in the movie that touched her heart the most.
subevent.location: Convenience store next to the cinema, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Going home to work on her journal
subevent.description: After finishing the movie, Sun Yuwei returned home and went to her bedroom. She took out the postcard she had written that evening and her journal, carefully pasted the postcard into the journal, and added some stickers and text as decoration, fully recording this movie-watching experience as a memory of life.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Received the notice and the advance payment for the first draft of the essay collection.
description: On July 6, Sun Yuwei received a WeChat notification at home from editor Xu Mingyuan, saying that the 3000 yuan advance for the first draft of her essay collection Slow Travel Notes would be transferred on July 8. On July 8, after receiving the transfer, she immediately moved it into her dedicated dream savings card and wrote in her journal: 'The first money of freedom, deposited into my dream account.'

subevent.name: Received notification of manuscript payment
subevent.description: At home, Sun Yuwei received a message on WeChat on her phone from the editor Xu Mingyuan, notifying her that the advance payment of 3,000 yuan for the manuscript of her essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes' would be paid via bank transfer on July 8. She was happy and planned to deposit the money into a dedicated dream savings card.
subevent.location: Home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Received manuscript payment and recorded it in the journal
subevent.description: On July 8, Sun Yuwei received a 3,000 yuan manuscript advance from editor Xu Mingyuan in her bank account. She immediately transferred the money to her dedicated dream savings card via mobile banking and recorded the income in detail in her journal, writing that it was her first freely earned money and was deposited into her dream account. She then briefly planned the future use of the funds, intending to use them as a fund for later cultural travel.
subevent.location: Home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Received the Putonghua Proficiency Certificate (Level 2A)
description: On May 14, Sun Yuwei received her Grade 2A Putonghua proficiency certificate by mail; the score report showed that both reading aloud and speaking were at the lower bound of Grade 1B. She took a photo and sent it to the family group chat, and her mother was very gratified. The certificate provides qualification support for future podcast interviews, cultural lectures, and other activities.

subevent.name: Receive the courier delivery of the Mandarin certificate.
subevent.description: At her home at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei received the package containing the Mandarin Proficiency Test certificate from the postal courier on the morning of May 14 and signed to confirm receipt.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

subevent.name: Open the package and check the certificate and transcript
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei sat at her desk, imported the photos of the thin mist taken yesterday into her computer, and did light post-processing in Lightroom, adjusting the color temperature and contrast to create a 'cool mist' mood. During a break in editing, she saw her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, repost her article on his Moments with the comment 'the student who best knows how to make words breathe', and warmth arose in her heart. She carefully composed a reply: 'Teacher Wu, thank you for your affirmation. It means a lot to me. After listening to Teacher Chen's lecture yesterday, I thought even more about how to capture those fleeting everyday moments of poetry in words—just like this morning's mist over the Western Hills: it seems to be everywhere, yet is truly hard to put into words. I will continue to work hard and let my words truly breathe.' After that, she took out the five pages of lecture shorthand notes she recorded yesterday in the School of Chinese Language and Literature at Yunnan University, marked the key points with a highlighter, and copied the brilliant insights about 'the poetry of everyday life' into her inspiration notebook. She realized that the misty scene of the Western Hills happened to be a visual footnote to that insight.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Take a photo and share the good news in the family group chat
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei took a photo of her Putonghua certificate with her phone and sent it to the family WeChat group that included her parents and older sister, adding a message sharing that she had received the Second Class A certificate. Her mother, Li Xiulan, saw it, felt very gratified, and replied with congratulations.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Video call with cousin Shen Wei to ask for advice on insurance planning
description: On the evening of August 20, Sun Yuwei had a video call with her cousin Shen Wei. Besides sharing updates on their lives, she specifically asked her cousin, who was preparing for the financial planner exam, for advice on social insurance and commercial insurance arrangements for freelancers. Her cousin suggested that she first arrange flexible-employment social insurance and then add a million-yuan medical insurance policy.

subevent.name: Scheduling a video call time
subevent.description: During the day on August 20, 2025, Sun Yuwei contacted her cousin Shen Wei via WeChat, agreed to have a video call that evening, and briefly said she wanted to ask about insurance planning.

subevent.name: Video call with my cousin to ask about insurance.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 20, 2025, Sun Yuwei had a video call with her cousin Shen Wei at home. Besides catching up on each other's news, Sun Yuwei mainly asked her cousin, who was preparing for the financial planner certification exam, for advice on social insurance and commercial insurance arrangements for freelancers. Her cousin suggested that she first enroll in social insurance for flexible employment and then add a million-yuan medical insurance policy. The call lasted about forty minutes.

subevent.name: Organize insurance advice
subevent.description: After the video call, Sun Yuwei recorded in detail in her journal her cousin’s advice on configuring flexible-employment social insurance and million-yuan medical insurance, and listed the application procedures and product information she needed to look up later. She planned to schedule time for insurance consultation.

name: Purchased an entry-level drawing tablet and began exploring digital illustration.
description: On the afternoon of June 28, Sun Yuwei went to the digital mall, compared options, and bought an entry-level drawing tablet. After returning home and installing the driver, she used the pressure-sensitive pen to draw her first digital sketch—a seagull standing on the stone railing of Green Lake, planning to use it as a cover for her social media posts. The nearly 500 yuan expense made her both excited and nervous.

subevent.name: Compared and bought a graphics tablet at the digital mall.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 28, Sun Yuwei carefully compared several entry-level drawing tablets at multiple stores in Baiteng Digital Plaza, checking pen pressure sensitivity, drawing area size, and bundled software. She finally chose a cost-effective tablet from a domestic brand and bought it for 498 yuan. When paying, she felt both excited and nervous — this was the first time she had spent a relatively large amount on digital drawing.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - Baiteng Digital Plaza

subevent.name: Go home to install drivers and test the drawing tablet
subevent.description: On the evening of June 28, Sun Yuwei returned home, unpacked the drawing tablet, connected the USB cable to her laptop according to the manual, and downloaded and installed the corresponding driver software from the official website. After the driver was installed successfully, she opened the drawing software to test the smoothness and sensitivity of the pressure pen, confirming that all functions were normal.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Draw the first digital sketch.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 28, Sun Yuwei used her new graphics tablet in drawing software to create her first digital sketch—a seagull standing on the stone railing of Green Lake, based on a photo she had taken earlier. She planned to refine the image a little and use it as the cover for her social media article. After finishing the sketch, she saved the file and shared a photo of it to her close friends' group chat.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Complete the final-stage course of the nonfiction writing workshop.
description: From June 1 to June 13, Sun Yuwei completed the final stage of the online nonfiction writing workshop. She attended the online classes on time every Wednesday and Saturday evening, completed her assignments on schedule, systematically mastered story structure and interview techniques, and brought new methods to her column writing.

subevent.name: Attended the first Wednesday online course
subevent.description: On the evening of Wednesday, June 4, 2025, Sun Yuwei, in the study of her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, attended the first class of the final phase of the nonfiction writing workshop via online conferencing software. The course was taught by the workshop mentor and focused on story structure. Sun Yuwei listened attentively and took notes, actively asking questions and interacting in the discussion area.

subevent.name: Completed the first homework assignment
subevent.description: On June 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei spent the daytime at home completing the course assignment—writing a short story based on the story structure outline she had learned. She first organized her course notes, then outlined the story, and finally finished it on her computer and submitted it to the online platform.

subevent.name: Attend the first Saturday online course
subevent.description: On the evening of Saturday, June 7, 2025, Sun Yuwei logged into the online meeting on time for the second session of the nonfiction writing workshop. The class focused on interviewing techniques; the instructor used case analysis and mock interview drills to help participants master the methods. Sun Yuwei participated throughout and took down the key points.

subevent.name: Completed the second homework assignment.
subevent.description: On June 8, 2025, Sun Yuwei designed an interview outline based on the interview techniques she learned in Saturday's class, and conducted a brief mock interview exercise. She compiled the process into a written transcript and submitted it as an assignment. She revised it repeatedly at home to ensure the quality of the assignment.

subevent.name: Attended the second Wednesday online course.
subevent.description: On Wednesday evening, June 11, 2025, Sun Yuwei attended the final online course. The session was a course summary: the instructor reviewed the key points of the stage and gave feedback on assignments submitted by students. Sun Yuwei's assignment was selected for discussion as an example, and she listened carefully to the instructor's feedback and suggestions for improvement.

subevent.name: Complete the final course assignment
subevent.description: From June 12 to 13, 2025, Sun Yuwei worked on the final assignment for her workshop—writing a complete nonfiction story that required integrating story structure and interviewing techniques. She chose to write about someone close to her. After conceptualizing, recalling interview material, writing, and making multiple revisions, she submitted the final draft to the online platform on the afternoon of June 13, marking the successful completion of that stage of the course.

subevent.name: Confirmed the topic and interviewed my mother.
subevent.description: In her home study, Sun Yuwei considered topics for a nonfiction story and decided to use her mother Li Xiulan's career as a Chinese language teacher as material. She interviewed her mother Li Xiulan by phone for about 40 minutes, asking in detail about her mother's early teaching years, a few students who had left a deep impression, and her insights from teaching. She used a voice recorder to capture key story details and emotional expressions, building a pool of material for later writing.

subevent.name: Writing and revising the first draft of the story
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study and, based on the recording of the previous day's interview, began writing the first draft of a nonfiction story using the story structure (scene setting, character portrayal, conflict and turning points) learned in the workshop. She wrote concentratedly for about three hours and completed a draft of about 2,500 characters. Then, after a short break, she read it through from the beginning, made the first revisions to awkward sentences and missing details, and added more vivid dialogue and scene descriptions.

subevent.name: Final polish and online submission.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei opened the draft again and made a second round of careful revisions, focusing on grammatical errors, punctuation, and whether the rhythm of the story was smooth. She asked her mother Li Xiulan to listen over a WeChat call as she read part of the text aloud, to make sure the emotional expression was accurate. Once she was satisfied, she exported the final draft to PDF, uploaded it through the online platform designated by the workshop, and attached a brief statement about her creative process, marking the successful completion of the course assignment.

name: Completed the first draft of the interview article and sent it to the editor for review.
description: From April 29 to 30, Sun Yuwei organized the recordings and notes from the joint interview she and Xu Mingyuan conducted with the old wutong zouyin craftsman on April 27, and wrote a draft nonfiction interview article of about 3,000 words. On the evening of April 30, she sent it by email to Xu Mingyuan for review, with suggestions for accompanying images.

subevent.name: Organizing interview recordings and notes
subevent.description: At her home study, Sun Yuwei used her computer and notebook to replay the audio recording of the joint interview with Xu Mingyuan on April 27 with the old craftsman of silver-inlaid black copper, while organizing her interview notes. She extracted key information, quotes, and details, categorized the material by theme, and prepared to write the first draft.

subevent.name: Drafting the first part of the interview article.
subevent.description: In her home study, Sun Yuwei began writing the first draft of a nonfiction interview article based on the organized materials. Following the narrative structure she had conceived, she wrote the article's opening, background introduction, and excerpts of the old craftsman's personal stories from the interview, completing about 1,500 words. During the process, she referred to the verbatim quotes in the recordings and the detailed descriptions in her notes.

subevent.name: Complete and polish the first draft of the interview article.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei continued writing the rest of the first draft in her home study, including a detailed description of the craft of black copper inlaid with silver, the current challenges of passing it down, and the concluding reflections. After finishing, she read through the whole text to polish it, adjusted the rhythm of the sentences, checked the accuracy of the quotations, and made sure the roughly 3,000-character manuscript was fluent and professional.

subevent.name: Send the first draft to the editor for review.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 30, in her home study, Sun Yuwei sent the completed and polished first draft of the interview article as a Word document attachment to Xu Mingyuan, editor of 'Cultural Vision'. In the email body, she briefly explained the article's structure and writing ideas, and attached several suggested accompanying images with shooting notes, asking Editor Xu to review and give feedback.

name: Watch an art film alone and write a reflection
description: On the evening of March 17, Sun Yuwei watched the newly released Japanese literary film [Perfect Days] alone at Broadway Cinema in Wuhua District. The film tells the story of a cleaner who finds beauty and meaning in daily life. After the screening, deeply moved, she wrote nearly a thousand characters of reflections in a small notebook at a café next to the cinema, recording the film's interpretation of the poetry of everyday life, and planned to integrate this observational perspective into her own prose writing.

subevent.name: Going to Broadway Cinema.
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei set out from her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, and walked or took public transportation to Broadway Cinema in Wuhua District, planning to watch the newly released Japanese art film Perfect Days.
subevent.location: Broadway Cinema, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Watch the movie "Perfect Days"
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei watched the newly released Japanese art film Perfect Days alone in a screening hall of Broadway Cinemas. The film tells the story of a cleaner who finds beauty and meaning in daily life. During the screening, she was deeply touched and moved by the film's delicate poetic portrayal of everyday life.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - Broadway Cinema Screening Hall

subevent.name: Writing a reflection at the café
subevent.description: After the movie, Sun Yuwei sat down in a quiet café beside Broadway Cinemas, took out the small notebook she carried with her, and carefully wrote nearly a thousand characters of reflections. She recorded in detail the film's interpretation of the poetry of everyday life and thought about how to incorporate this observational perspective into her own prose creation.
subevent.location: Cafe next to the cinema, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: After finishing her reflections, Sun Yuwei left the café and returned to her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming. Once home, she settled her thoughts, put away her reflection notes, and prepared for further writing that night.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

name: Successfully mastered Downward Dog in yoga class.
description: In the yoga class on the 13th, under He Lu's guidance, Sun Yuwei successfully completed Downward-Facing Dog for the first time. Although her body was still slightly shaking, He Lu praised her for noticeably improved core strength, marking a new stage in her yoga practice.

subevent.name: Set out for the yoga studio.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei changed into yoga clothes at her home in Kunming, took her yoga mat and water bottle, and walked to the Jingxin Yoga Studio in Panlong District. After arriving, she greeted the instructor He Lu and prepared to start the class.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Practiced yoga and successfully mastered the downward-facing dog pose.
subevent.description: In the yoga class, He Lu focused on guiding Sun Yuwei in Downward-Facing Dog, correcting the force angles of her arms and legs. After multiple attempts, Sun Yuwei completed a standard Downward-Facing Dog for the first time. Her body swayed slightly but remained stable, and He Lu praised her on the spot.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

name: Family reunion from Lunar New Year's Eve to Spring Festival
description: From January 28 to 31 (New Year's Eve to the third day of the New Year), older sister Sun Yutong came home from Shenzhen for the Spring Festival. On New Year's Eve, the whole family ate a reunion dinner, watched the Spring Festival Gala, and stayed up late to see the new year in. On the first day of the New Year, Sun Yuwei and her sister visited the Cuihu Temple Fair, tasted snacks, and took New Year photos. On the second day, the whole family went to visit relatives. During the Spring Festival, Sun Yuwei also used her spare time to record her Spring Festival experiences in her journal.

subevent.name: Family Reunion on Chinese New Year's Eve
subevent.description: On New Year’s Eve, Sun Yuwei gathered with her father Sun Mingyuan, mother Li Xiulan, and older sister Sun Yutong at their home in Wuhua District, Kunming, to enjoy a carefully prepared New Year’s Eve dinner together (including local dishes such as Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles and mushroom hot pot). After dinner, the family sat in the living room watching the CCTV Spring Festival Gala and stayed up together until the early morning, chatting about family matters and sharing their lives and work over the past year. The atmosphere was warm and joyful.
subevent.location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: On the first day of the Lunar New Year, visit the Cuihu Temple Fair
subevent.description: On the morning of the first day of Chinese New Year, Sun Yuwei and her elder sister Sun Yutong went to Cuihu Park in Kunming to attend the Spring Festival temple fair. At the fair, they tasted various local snacks (such as flower cakes and tanghulu), watched folk performances, and took many New Year-themed photos as souvenirs, feeling the strong festive atmosphere and local culture.
subevent.location: Green Lake Park, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Visit relatives on the second day of the Lunar New Year.
subevent.description: On the second day of the Chinese New Year, Sun Yuwei went with her father Sun Mingyuan, mother Li Xiulan, and older sister Sun Yutong to visit relatives in Kunming (her maternal grandmother's home) to pay New Year calls. They had lunch with her uncle, aunt, and younger male cousin, exchanged New Year gifts, and Sun Yuwei and her sister also played with their cousin. The whole family was joyful and harmonious, and they did not return home until dusk.
subevent.location: At a relative's home in Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: On the third day of the Lunar New Year, organize the Spring Festival journal records.
subevent.description: On the third day of the Lunar New Year, Sun Yuwei used her spare time at home in Wuhua District, Kunming, to organize into her journal the sights, experiences, and feelings from the Spring Festival period—from New Year's Eve to the third day—such as family gatherings, temple fair visits, and visiting relatives. She recorded the warm moments of the 2025 Spring Festival with words and illustrations, as a personal memory keepsake.
subevent.location: Study at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Writing the second column piece titled Flowers and Life at the Dounan Flower Market.
description: From February 26 to 27, Sun Yuwei wrote her second column, 'Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market'. On the morning of the 26th, she went to Dounan Flower Market to gather material, chatted warmly with flower growers, and used her mirrorless camera to capture the colors and bustle of the market. After returning home, she combined her own flower arrangement insights, spent two days polishing the manuscript, and submitted it on the evening of the 27th. The editor praised her observational skills and encouraged her to continue digging deeper into the stories behind the flower market.

subevent.name: Preparing field-trip gear
subevent.description: After getting up early on the morning of the 26th, Sun Yuwei checked the batteries and memory cards of her mirrorless camera, brought along a notebook and pen, and made material preparations for an inspiration-gathering trip to Dounan Flower Market.

subevent.name: Went to Dounan Flower Market to gather creative inspiration.
subevent.description: On the morning of the 26th, Sun Yuwei went alone to the Dounan Flower Market in Kunming. She strolled through the market, talked warmly with several flower farmers, learned about the flower varieties and trading conditions, and took many photos with her mirrorless camera to record the colors and bustle of the market.

subevent.name: Organized the fieldwork materials.
subevent.description: After returning home from Dounan Flower Market, Sun Yuwei imported the photos she had taken into her computer, reviewed her conversation notes with the flower farmer, and, combined with her insights from studying Ikenobo flower arrangement, began to sort out her ideas for the article.

subevent.name: Wrote the first draft of the column.
subevent.description: On the evening of the 26th, Sun Yuwei began writing the first draft of her column “Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market” in her home study, using delicate prose to depict the vivid scenes of the flower market, incorporating her personal flower arrangement experiences, and continued writing until late at night.

subevent.name: Revise and finalize the column article.
subevent.description: During the daytime on the 27th, Sun Yuwei repeatedly revised and polished the first draft she had completed the night before, refining the language and structure to make the content vivid and accurate, until the final version was completed in the afternoon.

subevent.name: Submitted the column manuscript and received feedback from the editor.
subevent.description: On the evening of the 27th, Sun Yuwei submitted the finalized column article by email to editor Xu Mingyuan. She soon received a reply from the editor, who praised her powers of observation and encouraged her to keep digging into the stories behind the flower market.

name: Social insurance automatic deduction: embarking on financial independence.
description: On July 31, 2025, Sun Yuwei used mobile banking to set up automatic monthly debit on the 15th for flexible-employment social insurance and enabled SMS reminders. From August 1, she began consciously managing her personal income and expenses, using an expense-tracking app to create a budget and ensure social insurance deductions did not affect her daily life. This basic security made her more calm and composed in her creative work, and also marked her smooth transition from student to independent member of society.

subevent.name: Set up automatic social security deduction and bank reminders
subevent.description: On July 31, 2025, Sun Yuwei used the mobile banking app to set up automatic monthly debit on the 15th for flexible-employment social insurance, enabled SMS alerts, and confirmed that her bank account balance was sufficient.

subevent.name: Launch independent financial management
subevent.description: Starting on August 1, 2025, Sun Yuwei began deliberately managing her personal income and expenses, setting a monthly budget, and using an expense-tracking app to record every expenditure, ensuring that fixed expenses such as social insurance deductions would not affect her daily life and strengthening her sense of financial control.

name: Ikenobo flower arrangement practice
description: On February 8, 2025, Sun Yuwei went to Dounan Flower Market to buy roses and eucalyptus leaves. The next afternoon, she practiced Ikenobo flower arrangement on her balcony, completed a rikka arrangement, photographed it for her journal, and wrote down her creative reflections.

subevent.name: Going to Dounan Flower Market to buy floral materials
subevent.description: On the morning of February 11, Sun Yuwei went to the Dounan Flower Market in Kunming. At the flower stall, she carefully selected a bunch of fresh long-stemmed roses and a bundle of eucalyptus leaves as materials for the afternoon flower arrangement practice. She carefully checked the freshness of the flowers, briefly exchanged care tips with the stall owner, paid, and took the bus home.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City - Dounan Flower Market

subevent.name: Practiced the Ikenobo school's Rikka flower arrangement
subevent.description: On her flower arrangement workbench on the balcony, Sun Yuwei spread out a waterproof mat and took out the newly bought roses and eucalyptus leaves. Following the Ikenobo school textbook, she first trimmed off excess branches and leaves with scissors, cutting the ends of the stems at a 45-degree angle. Then she used a kenzan to secure the stems, repeatedly adjusting the angles of the main and secondary branches so that the overall composition showed the distinctive asymmetrical balance of rikka. After about 40 minutes of focused work, she completed a minimalist rikka arrangement, with the spaces among the flower materials arranged in pleasing variation.

subevent.name: Record the flower arrangement piece and reflections in the planner.
subevent.description: After finishing the flower arrangement, Sun Yuwei took still-life photos of the work with her phone from multiple angles and selected the best one. She returned to the study, pasted the photo onto the journal page with washi tape, and neatly wrote beside it in fountain pen the date of creation, the names of the flowers used, and a reflection of about 100 characters, recording her insights when adjusting the angles of the flower branches and her appreciation of the tranquility of flower arrangement. After completing the journal, she cleaned the tools and put them away, and moved the work in the vase to the living room coffee table for the family to enjoy.

name: To lull myself to sleep, I picked up the newly purchased 'Miguel Street' and softly read the opening lines of the first chapter. The room had only the warm yellowish glow of the bedside lamp, and outside the window everything was silent. After reading for a few minutes, drowsiness crept in, so I closed the book, turned off the light, and immersed myself in the quiet night, gradually falling asleep. I expect to fall asleep before 23:00.
description: On June 25, Sun Yuwei's Xiaohongshu account “Yuwei's Slow Notes” surpassed 1000 followers, and she took a screenshot to mark the occasion. In the afternoon, a publishing house editor sent her a private message asking about publication interest. She politely declined, saying she wanted to first focus on completing the essay collection “Notes on Slow Travel”.

subevent.name: Discovered that Xiaohongshu followers surpassed 1,000
subevent.description: On the morning of June 25, Sun Yuwei opened Xiaohongshu in her study at home in Kunming and found that her account 'Yuwei's Slow Record' had surpassed 1,000 followers. Many users in the comment section praised her photos and journal layouts for being soothing. She felt very happy and encouraged, and took a screenshot to save the moment.

subevent.name: Politely decline the publishing invitation
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 25, a publishing house editor contacted Sun Yuwei via a direct message on Xiaohongshu, asking if she would be willing to publish her journal as a book. After careful consideration, Sun Yuwei politely replied and declined, saying she wanted to focus on completing her own essay collection Slow Travel Notes first and did not want to be distracted.

name: Labor Day family trip to the flower market
description: On May 2, during the Labor Day holiday, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan went to Dounan Flower Market together to pick seasonal peonies and lisianthus. As they browsed, the mother and daughter discussed flower arrangement combinations. After returning home, they trimmed the branches together and arranged the new flowers in the living room and beside Sun Yuwei's desk. She took photos of the arrangements with her phone and sent them to the family group chat. Her sister Sun Yutong liked them and said, “It has the flavor of spring.” The outing relaxed both body and mind and added vitality to the home.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan packed their going-out items at home (123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming), brought shopping bags and mobile phones, and prepared to head to Dounan Flower Market, while discussing the flower varieties they wanted to buy.

subevent.name: Went to Dounan Flower Market.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei set out from home with her mother Li Xiulan, took Metro Line 2 and then transferred to a bus to go to Dounan Flower Market in Chenggong District, Kunming. On the way, the mother and daughter chatted and shared their expectations for flower arranging.

subevent.name: Picking out flowers at the flower market
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her mother were in the main trading hall of Dounan Flower Market, carefully comparing peonies and lisianthus at different stalls. Based on her flower arranging needs, Sun Yuwei chose pink-and-white peonies and light purple lisianthus. Her mother also gave color-matching suggestions, and the mother and daughter discussed combinations as they strolled.

subevent.name: Purchasing and checkout
subevent.description: After selecting a stall, Sun Yuwei and her mother bargained with the flower farmer and paid. They bought a large bunch of peonies and a bundle of lisianthus, paying about 70 yuan in cash. The farmer helped wrap the flowers simply, and the mother and daughter took the flowers with satisfaction.

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her mother took a bus and then the subway home with the newly bought flower materials, carefully protecting the flowers from being crushed on the way. When they got home, they temporarily placed the bouquet on the dining table.

subevent.name: Trim the flower branches and arrange the living room
subevent.description: The mother and daughter trimmed the flower stems together at the kitchen sink, cutting the roots diagonally and removing excess leaves. Sun Yuwei arranged peonies and lisianthus in two clear glass vases and placed them on the living room coffee table and next to the TV cabinet, while her mother helped adjust their positions.
subevent.location: Kunming - kitchen and living room at home

subevent.name: Set up the desk and took photos.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used the leftover flowers to set up a small flower arrangement corner on her desk, took close-up photos of her work with her phone, and took three photos total including the vase in the living room, ready to share in the family group chat.

subevent.name: Sharing with family group and interaction
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei posted photos of her flower arrangements to the WeChat family group called “Sun Family Cottage,” with the message “Labor Day flower market haul~.” A few minutes later, her sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, replied with a like and commented, “It has a hint of spring.” Her mother also responded cheerfully in the group, and the three chatted briefly online.

name: My sister's heartwarming gift
description: On January 13, her sister Sun Yutong sent a package from Shenzhen containing a set of premium stationery and a fountain pen, with a card reading 'For the future writer.' On January 15, she received the package and was deeply moved after opening it, then tried out the new fountain pen and thanked her sister.

subevent.name: Elder sister sent the package
subevent.description: Sun Yutong wrote “For the Future Writer” on the greeting card, packed the paper goods, fountain pen, and card, and sent them by courier from Shenzhen to Sun Yuwei's home in Kunming.

subevent.name: Open package and read card
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei returned to her room and opened the package, revealing a set of premium paper and a fountain pen. She read the card her sister had attached—“To the future writer”—and was deeply moved.

subevent.name: Try out the new fountain pen and reply with thanks
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei couldn't wait to dip the new fountain pen in ink and try it out. She wrote a few lines on paper, feeling the smooth flow of the nib. Then she expressed her thanks to her elder sister via WeChat and shared the joy of receiving the gift.

name: Insights from organizing the workstation
description: On the morning of July 2, Sun Yuwei found that the piles of books, cables, and drafts on the new desk at Mingyuan Bookstore made it hard for her to concentrate on writing. She planned a tidy-up approach, then cleared away the clutter, sorted the books, untangled the cables, and archived the drafts. Once the desk was clean and orderly, she felt at ease and immediately started writing. She experienced the positive effect of the physical environment on creative flow and realized that freelancing needs a physical anchor to gather and focus the mind.

subevent.name: Planning the organizing scheme.
subevent.description: After finding her desk cluttered, Sun Yuwei quickly assessed the types and number of items on the desk and decided to organize them by area into three categories: books, cables, and draft paper. At the same time, she thought about how to use the existing bookshelf and storage boxes to optimize the space.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Mingyuan Bookstore (independent bookstore)

subevent.name: Cleaning and sorting
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 2, Sun Yuwei began tidying up her workstation: first she threw away clutter and waste paper, then sorted scattered books into frequently used and rarely used categories and placed them on the bookshelf, then used cable ties to organize the charging cables, network cables, and other cords on the desk, and finally filed the loose drafts into document boxes by project. The whole process took about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Mingyuan Bookstore (independent bookstore)

subevent.name: After organizing things, began writing
subevent.description: After tidying up the workstation, the desk was clean and orderly again. Sun Yuwei felt relaxed and focused, so she sat down and began the day's writing work, experiencing the positive effect of the physical environment on creative flow.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Mingyuan Bookstore (independent bookstore)

name: Reading and organizing literature for the graduation thesis.
description: From February 10 to 13, Sun Yuwei conducted literature searches, intensive reading, and note organization around her graduation thesis topic, 'Independent Bookstores and Urban Cultural Spaces.' On the 10th, she borrowed relevant literature from Yunnan University Library; from the 11th to the 12th, she intensively read Henri Lefebvre's 'The Production of Space' and other works, accumulating nearly 10,000 characters of notes and summarizing oral history methods; on the 13th, at home, she organized her notes, used a mind map to sort out the theoretical framework, and formed a practical guide, providing support for her research.

subevent.name: Pre-reading preparation and document borrowing
subevent.description: On February 10, Sun Yuwei searched the Yunnan University library retrieval system for academic literature on independent bookstores and urban cultural spaces, including relevant chapters of Lefebvre's *The Production of Space* and papers by local scholars. She wrote down the list of books to borrow and the electronic copies of papers, went to the library stacks to check out the print books, downloaded the electronic resources, organized the reading materials, and brought them back to the dormitory to prepare for the next two days of intensive reading.

subevent.name: First day of focused reading and note-taking
subevent.description: On February 11, Sun Yuwei took prepared reference materials to the self-study area of Yunnan University Library and spent the whole day concentrating on reading the core passages about "production of space" in Chapter 3 of Lefebvre's The Production of Space, as well as local scholar Li Moumou's paper "The Construction of Urban Cultural Space in Independent Bookstores." While reading, she took notes on her laptop and in a handwritten notebook, mainly recording key theoretical terms, research methodologies, and viewpoints suitable for citing in her paper. By the end of the day, she had completed about 5,000 words of notes and initially clarified the structure of the theoretical framework.

subevent.name: The second day was spent on intensive reading and synthesizing oral history.
subevent.description: On February 12, Sun Yuwei continued her second day of intensive reading at the Yunnan University Library. In the morning, she focused on reading the remaining ethnographic research papers about independent bookstores; in the afternoon, she focused on summarizing application cases of oral history methods in cultural space research. She extracted the interviewing techniques, analytical frameworks, and coding methods used in several papers, made a memorandum of key operational points for oral history, and wrote it into her notes. That day she completed about 5,000 more characters of notes, bringing the cumulative total to nearly 10,000 characters. She also summarized the main application patterns of oral history methods in this field, providing direct reference for the design of her fieldwork.

subevent.name: Organizing notes after reading and drafting an outline
subevent.description: On February 13, Sun Yuwei systematically organized nearly 10,000 characters of notes from her reading over the previous two days in her home study. Using mind-mapping software, she sorted out the theoretical framework of her thesis, noted the cross-references and clashes of ideas among the sources, and compiled the key operational points of the oral history method into a separate practical guide document. She also made a list of literature to read and search for later. Finally, she saved the organized materials into a dedicated thesis folder, laying the groundwork for writing the proposal and literature review.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Began professional skin care and developed sun-protection awareness.
description: On the morning of March 29, inspired by recommendations on Xiaohongshu, Sun Yuwei made an appointment at a skin care studio in Wuhua District for basic cleansing and hydration treatment. The beautician reminded her that ultraviolet rays in Kunming are strong and recommended using SPF50 sunscreen daily. She immediately bought a bottle of sunscreen lotion and decided to apply it right after her morning yoga practice, incorporating skin care into her morning health routine. This experience marked her shift from passive skin care to active image management.

subevent.name: Consulted Xiaohongshu and decided to try professional skincare
subevent.description: On the morning of March 29, Sun Yuwei browsed Xiaohongshu on her phone in her bedroom at home. She saw a recommended post about basic cleansing and hydrating skincare, and after being persuaded, she decided to try professional skin care that day. She then searched for well-reviewed skin management studios in Wuhua District.

subevent.name: Received basic cleansing and moisturizing care and sun protection advice.
subevent.description: At Yuerong Skin Management Studio, Sun Yuwei lay on the beauty bed, and the beautician performed makeup removal, deep cleansing, hydrating mask, and other skincare procedures. During the treatment, the beautician reminded her that Kunming has strong UV rays and recommended applying SPF50 sunscreen every day before going out. Sun Yuwei listened carefully and noted down the product recommendations.
subevent.location: Treatment room, Yuerong Skin Care Studio, Wuhua District, Kunming City

subevent.name: Bought sunscreen on the spot.
subevent.description: After the treatment, Sun Yuwei became interested in the sunscreen recommended by the beautician. She tried a sample in the studio's product display area, found the texture light and refreshing, and directly bought an SPF50 sunscreen, paying by mobile phone.
subevent.location: Front desk of Yuerong Skin Care Studio, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Going Home to Sort Out the Morning Skincare Routine
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei returned home, put the newly bought sunscreen on the bedside table, and wrote a new morning routine in her journal: apply sunscreen immediately after morning yoga, then go out. She took a photo and posted it on WeChat Moments to document this skincare awakening.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Attended a three-day intensive Ikenobo flower arrangement workshop and received a certificate of completion.
description: From June 25 to 27, Sun Yuwei attended a three-day intensive workshop held by the Kunming Ikenobo Ikebana Branch, at a flower arrangement classroom near Dounan Flower Market. The course went from theory to practice, learning the basic conventions of the three flower styles: rikka, shoka, and free style. She practiced every day from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., using nearly 40 flower stems. Her fingers were pricked by the needle frog many times, but her enthusiasm did not fade. At the end of the workshop, she created a work titled "Sound of Summer" using pomegranate branches and lotus flowers as the main materials, and earned praise from the instructor Su Man. After the workshop, she pasted the certificate into her journal and wrote: "Ikebana is subtraction, and also a pruning of the heart."

subevent.name: Workshop Preparation and Tool Shopping
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei went to a flower material shop at Dounan Flower Market to buy basic ikebana tools such as a kenzan, scissors, and a suiban, and confirmed the exact location of the Ikenobo ikebana class and class precautions in advance. At the flower market, she ran into Su Man, a fellow ikebana enthusiast, and they briefly exchanged information about the workshop schedule.
subevent.location: Flower vessel shop and floral design classroom near Dounan Flower Market, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Intensive workshop day one: learning and practicing Rikka
subevent.description: From 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei attended the first day of a three-day intensive Ikebana workshop at a flower arranging classroom near the Dounan Flower Market in Kunming. The course was taught by Su Man, a branch instructor of Ikenobo, and covered the basic rules of rikka, including material selection and fixing techniques for the main branch, secondary branch, and guest branch. Sun Yuwei practiced with about 15 flower stems. Her finger was pricked by the kenzan for the first time, but her enthusiasm for learning was unaffected.
subevent.location: Flower arrangement classroom near Dounan Flower Market, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Intensive Workshop Day 2: Ikebana Study and Practice
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei continued attending the full-day workshop from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. at the same venue. That day's class focused on the basic form of Seika, emphasizing the natural posture of plants and asymmetrical aesthetics. Sun Yuwei practiced three Seika arrangements using different vases, using about 15 flower stems, and gradually got used to operating the kenzan. Instructor Su Man gave her individual guidance on adjusting the flower stem angles during the lunch break.
subevent.location: Flower arrangement classroom near Dounan Flower Market, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Intensive Workshop Day 3: Freestyle Flower Arrangement and Completion
subevent.description: On the last day of the workshop, the morning was spent learning the basic composition of free-style flower arrangements, and the afternoon was spent on the graduation piece. Sun Yuwei used pomegranate branches and lotus flowers as the main materials to create a work called 'Sound of Summer,' which received high praise from the instructor Su Man. She used about 10 stems of flower material to add details and cut her finger on the kenzan again, but her excitement did not fade. After the class ended at 4 p.m., Su Man awarded each student an Ikenobo Ikebana completion certificate. Sun Yuwei kept the certificate safe and planned to paste it into her journal when she got home.
subevent.location: Flower arrangement classroom near Dounan Flower Market, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Post-workshop organization and journaling
subevent.description: At home in her study, Sun Yuwei sorted through the leftover floral materials and the completion certificate brought back from the three-day workshop. She took a photo of her work 'Sound of Summer,' taped the certificate into her journal, and recorded in detail each day's learning insights and flower arrangement standards. At the end of the journal, she wrote: 'Ikebana is subtraction, and also a pruning of the heart.' Then she photographed her study notes and shared them with her best friend Zhang Jing and her college roommate group on WeChat.

name: Purchase personal commercial accident insurance
description: On July 27, on the advice of her close friend Zhang Jing, Sun Yuwei bought a comprehensive accident insurance policy for herself through an online platform with an annual premium of 500 yuan, covering accidental medical treatment and hospitalization allowance. Thinking back to being bitten by a dog a month ago, she felt that having extra protection was more reassuring.

subevent.name: Discussing insurance advice with her best friend
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei talked with her close friend Zhang Jing over WeChat at home. Drawing on her own experience buying insurance, Zhang Jing suggested that Sun Yuwei get a commercial accident insurance policy for herself and recommended several cost-effective products. The two discussed the coverage of accident insurance (accidental medical treatment, hospitalization allowance, etc.) and the annual premium. Sun Yuwei decided to take the advice and began looking into purchasing it.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province
