subevent.name: Online search and comparison of insurance products.
subevent.description: At home, Sun Yuwei used her laptop to log on to multiple insurance platforms and third-party comparison websites. She entered information such as age and occupation, and screened out several comprehensive accidental injury insurance plans. She carefully compared the benefits (accidental medical coverage limit, number of hospitalization allowance days, deductible, etc.) and annual premiums, paying special attention to whether accidental medical coverage included dog bites. In the end, she chose a comprehensive accident insurance policy with an annual premium of 500 yuan.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Completed online insurance payment
subevent.description: On the page of the selected product, Sun Yuwei filled in her basic personal information (name, ID number, contact information, etc.), carefully read the insurance contract terms, and confirmed the application. She paid the 500 yuan premium via WeChat Pay, and the system generated a successful application page showing the policy number and coverage period (effective from 0:00 the next day).
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Health adjustment initiated after the medical check-up
description: On February 24, after reviewing her physical examination report, Sun Yuwei discussed it with her mother and decided to gain weight and improve her diet. In the morning, the mother and daughter went to the supermarket to buy high-protein foods, fruits and vegetables, nuts, and other ingredients. In the afternoon, they worked together to create a detailed weight-gain meal plan and stuck it on the refrigerator. In the evening, Sun Yuwei set up a diet-tracking page in her journal and began recording every day. From February 24 to 28, she ate according to the meal plan and kept records, and every evening she walked for half an hour with her mother around the neighborhood.

subevent.name: Review the physical examination report and discuss it with my mother.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 24, Sun Yuwei carefully read her physical examination report at home in Kunming, focusing on the underweight and nutritional advice sections. She then discussed the report with her mother, Li Xiulan, in the living room. Together they determined the goals of gaining weight and improving her diet, and planned to develop a specific meal plan that day.

subevent.name: Go to the supermarket with my mother to buy weight-gain ingredients.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 24, Sun Yuwei went to the Carrefour supermarket near Wuhua District, Kunming, with her mother Li Xiulan. According to the preliminary plan of the weight-gain diet, they selected high-protein foods (such as eggs, chicken breast, milk), fresh vegetables and fruits (broccoli, tomatoes, bananas), and snacks such as nuts and whole-wheat bread, to prepare for regular additional meals later.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District Carrefour Supermarket

subevent.name: Develop a weight-gain meal plan
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 24, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan made a detailed weight-gain diet plan together in the kitchen of their Kunming home, deciding on the contents of three meals and two snacks a day, increasing protein and fruit and vegetable intake. For example, adding milk and eggs to breakfast, ensuring meat and a variety of vegetables at lunch and dinner, having fruit or nuts as an afternoon snack, and drinking a glass of warm milk before bed. They wrote the diet plan on a sticky note and stuck it on the refrigerator.

subevent.name: Set up a diet log page in the journal
subevent.description: On the evening of February 24, Sun Yuwei set up a dedicated food diary page in her journal. She designed a table format with columns such as date, three meals, snack, water intake, and exercise (walking), and decorated it with cute stickers, planning to make daily records from that day on.

subevent.name: Daily meal logging and evening walk
subevent.description: From February 24 to 28, Sun Yuwei used a table in her journal to record her three meals and two snacks every day. At about 17:30 in the evening, she took a half-hour walk with her mother Li Xiulan around the community garden or the surrounding streets in Wuhua District, Kunming, to improve her posture and aid digestion. During the walks, the mother and daughter exchanged their feelings about the day, and Sun Yuwei also observed the physical changes after the dietary adjustments.
subevent.location: Kunming - Wuhua District, home and residential community

name: Accompanied her heartbroken best friend to Fuxian Lake to clear her mind, and wrote a healing work of flash fiction.
description: On July 14, after learning that her best friend Zhang Jing had gone through a breakup, Sun Yuwei set aside her work and accompanied her to Fuxian Lake. During the day they walked along the lake and confided in each other; at night, at the guesthouse, she wrote a flash fiction piece, 'The Star at the Bottom of the Lake,' especially for Zhang Jing. On the morning of the 15th, they returned to Kunming, and in the afternoon she went to the hospital for her fourth rabies vaccine shot. After reading it, Zhang Jing smiled through tears and felt deeply understood and healed.

subevent.name: Learned that her best friend had broken up and decided to accompany her.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 14, 2025, Sun Yuwei received a phone call at her home in Kunming from her close friend Zhang Jing. She learned that Zhang Jing was emotionally distraught because her boyfriend had broken up with her. Sun Yuwei immediately set aside the freelance article she was writing, decided to accompany Zhang Jing out that day to help her feel better, and called to comfort her. They agreed to meet downstairs at Zhang Jing's apartment in an hour and go to Fuxian Lake together.

subevent.name: Set off with her best friend for Fuxian Lake.
subevent.description: At noon on July 14, 2025, Sun Yuwei took some simple luggage and a notebook and went to the ground floor of Zhang Jing's home to meet her. The two took a car that Sun Yuwei had ordered on a ride-hailing platform, set off from Kunming city center, and drove about 1.5 hours to Fuxian Lake. On the way, Sun Yuwei quietly listened to Zhang Jing pour out the details of her breakup, constantly comforting her, and suggested staying by the lake for a night, which Zhang Jing agreed to.
subevent.location: Along the route from Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to Fuxian Lake, Yuxi City

subevent.name: Walking along Fuxian Lake and confiding
subevent.description: Around 2 p.m. on July 14, 2025, Sun Yuwei and Zhang Jing arrived at the shore of Fuxian Lake and checked in at a lakefront guesthouse. Then the two walked along the lakeside boardwalk. As they walked, Zhang Jing talked about the pain and self-doubt after her breakup. Sun Yuwei stayed with her patiently, shared passages from healing essays she had read, and encouraged her to write down her emotions. In the evening, they sat on a stone bench by the lake watching the sunset, and Zhang Jing gradually calmed down.
subevent.location: Fuxian Lake Lakeside, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Writing a healing flash fiction piece, “The Star at the Bottom of the Lake,” at the guesthouse.
subevent.description: On the night of July 14, 2025, Sun Yuwei and Zhang Jing returned to their guesthouse room. Zhang Jing fell asleep first because she was exhausted. Sun Yuwei sat at the desk by the window and, inspired by the night's lake view and her best friend's experience, wrote a flash fiction piece, 'The Star at the Bottom of the Lake', overnight, telling the story of a star that sinks to the bottom of a lake and is finally illuminated by moonlight, weaving in fragments of their daytime conversation. After finishing, she softly read the manuscript to the half-asleep Zhang Jing, who smiled through tears, feeling deeply understood.
subevent.location: A guesthouse by the shore of Fuxian Lake, Yuxi City, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Return from Fuxian Lake to Kunming
subevent.description: On the morning of July 15, 2025, Sun Yuwei and Zhang Jing had breakfast together at the guesthouse. Zhang Jing was in excellent spirits and thanked Sun Yuwei again for her company. After checking out, they took a ride-hailing car back to Kunming. On the way, Zhang Jing repeatedly read the electronic manuscript of "The Star at the Bottom of the Lake" on her phone and shared it with other friends. They arrived in downtown Kunming around 11 a.m. and went their separate ways.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Yuxi City to Kunming City - en route

subevent.name: Went to the hospital to receive the fourth dose of rabies vaccine
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 15, 2025, Sun Yuwei left home and walked to the outpatient department of the Wuhua District Center for Disease Control and Prevention in Kunming to receive the fourth dose of the rabies vaccine (earlier, after being scratched by a stray cat, she had followed the doctor's advice to receive the full course of the vaccine). After the injection, she was observed for half an hour with no adverse reactions. The doctor reminded her of the next vaccination time. Sun Yuwei paid the vaccine fee in full and returned home.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - Center for Disease Control and Prevention

name: A Xiaohongshu post received a private message from a publishing house editor and launched preliminary collaboration.
description: On March 10, Sun Yuwei published her first photography and text work, "The Color Atlas of the Food Market," on "Yuwei's Slow Notes," integrating content from last month's food market field trip. She received a direct message from editor Zhang Qiming of Shanghai Bluebird Press, who expressed interest and invited collaboration. Sun Yuwei replied the same day and established WeChat contact. On March 12, they had their first online communication, discussing the possibility of expanding the work into an illustrated book on urban food market culture.

subevent.name: Edited and published a Xiaohongshu piece, 'A Color Atlas of the Vegetable Market'.
subevent.description: In her home study, Sun Yuwei used Xiaohongshu's photo-and-text editing feature to combine photos taken during last month's food market visit with her own written narrative into her first photography-plus-text work, A Color Atlas of the Food Market, and published it to her Xiaohongshu account "Yuwei Slow Notes" at around noon that day. During the process, she made subtle adjustments to the photo tones and wrote a caption of about 300 characters.

subevent.name: Received a private message from the publishing house editor.
subevent.description: At around 3 pm that day, while browsing Xiaohongshu on her phone, Sun Yuwei found a private message in her inbox from a user named "Shanghai Qingniao Press - Zhang Qiming". In the message, Editor Zhang expressed strong interest in her work "A Color Guide to the Wet Market", saying it had a unique street-level narrative perspective, and asked whether she would be willing to expand it into an illustrated book about urban market culture, inviting Sun Yuwei to discuss cooperation details further via WeChat.

subevent.name: Replied to the editor and established contact.
subevent.description: After receiving the private message, Sun Yuwei was pleasantly surprised and carefully read the editor's comment. She immediately replied to the editor via Xiaohongshu's message box, expressing her gratitude and sharing her WeChat ID. About half an hour later, the other party passed her WeChat friend request, and they exchanged greetings on WeChat and agreed to have a more detailed online call two days later to discuss the possibility of collaboration. In WeChat, Sun Yuwei briefly introduced her writing background and creative direction.

subevent.name: First communication with the publishing editor about working together.
subevent.description: As scheduled three days earlier, at 8 p.m. on March 12, 2025, Sun Yuwei had about a 40-minute WeChat voice call with Zhang Qiming, an editor at Shanghai Qingniao Publishing House. Editor Zhang introduced in detail the press's editorial direction and collaboration model, and suggested that Sun Yuwei organize an outline for a collection containing observations of wet markets in 10 different cities around the theme of “Chinese wet market culture,” and provide a sample chapter. Sun Yuwei noted the requirements and said she would submit her initial concept within a week. The call had a friendly atmosphere, and both sides agreed to continue the conversation next week.

name: Pre-Spring Festival family cleaning and New Year shopping
description: From January 24 to 27, Sun Yuwei and her family did a thorough pre-Spring Festival cleaning and bought New Year goods. On the 24th, she made a list with her mother, Li Xiulan, and checked the cleaning tools; on the 25th, they cleared out old books and journaling tools from the study and came across her childhood reading notes; on the 26th, the whole family washed windows and doors; on the 27th, they went to the market together to buy Spring Festival couplets, ingredients for flower cakes, dried wild mushrooms and other New Year goods. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, handled the heavy work. The family was busy but warm, preparing to welcome the Lunar New Year.

subevent.name: Preparing for a thorough clean-up and making the Chinese New Year shopping list
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan sat in the living room of their home in Wuhua District, Kunming, and together made a Spring Festival shopping list, including couplets, ingredients for flower cakes (rose jam, flour, etc.), dried wild mushrooms, and more. They also checked the condition of the cleaning tools at home and confirmed that items such as window squeegees and glass cleaner were missing. Sun Yuwei wrote down the list in her notebook, while her mother called neighbors to ask for recommendations on cleaning products and New Year goods sellers with good value. After work, Sun Yuwei's father Sun Mingyuan confirmed that he would be ready for the heavy tasks the next day, such as moving furniture and cleaning high places.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Clear out old books and journaling tools from the study.
subevent.description: From 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan focused on clearing out old books and journaling tools in the study of their Kunming home. Sun Yuwei sorted the books on the bookshelves, discarded unneeded old magazines and outdated notebooks, and wiped down the bookcases; her mother organized journaling supplies such as stickers, stamps, and colored pens, and threw away damaged stationery. During the process, Sun Yuwei came across a reading notebook from fifth grade, sighed at how time had passed, and shared the reading notes she had written as a child with her mother. At noon, her father Sun Mingyuan helped move the heavy boxes of books to the balcony for temporary storage. The whole study was refreshed, and the waste was sorted and discarded.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Scrub all the doors, windows, and glass throughout the house
subevent.description: All day, Sun Yuwei, her mother Li Xiulan, and her father Sun Mingyuan split the work of scrubbing and cleaning all the doors, windows, and glass in the house. Father Sun Mingyuan was responsible for using an extension pole to clean the high exterior windows and the balcony sliding door; Sun Yuwei scrubbed the inside of the bedroom and study windows; and mother Li Xiulan cleaned the kitchen and bathroom windows. The three worked together using squeegees, cloths, and specialized cleaning solution, changing the water several times. At noon, the family had a simple meal; in the afternoon, they continued cleaning the remaining windowsills and screens. By evening they had finished wiping everything down, and the house was bright and spotless, ready to welcome the New Year.
subevent.location: Various rooms at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Purchase Spring Festival couplets and festive New Year food ingredients.
subevent.description: From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., Sun Yuwei, along with her mother Li Xiulan and father Sun Mingyuan, went to the Zhuanxin Vegetable Market in Wuhua District, Kunming, and the nearby New Year goods stalls to do shopping. First they bought Spring Festival couplets and Fu character posters, then purchased ingredients for flower cakes (including rose paste, flour, lard, etc.) and dried wild mushrooms (porcini, matsutake, etc.). Sun Yuwei helped carry bags, her mother was responsible for selecting ingredients and bargaining, and her father carried the heavier rice and cooking oil. After the shopping was done, the family of three returned home fully loaded. Once home, they stored the dried mushrooms and flower cake ingredients in separate categories, and put away the couplets until New Year's Eve for posting. At noon, they had a simple meal of crossing-the-bridge rice noodles at a small eatery near the market.
subevent.location: Zhuanxin Market and Chinese New Year goods stalls, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Experience your first outdoor hike, exploring nature and physical fitness
description: On August 27, Sun Yuwei accepted an invitation from her childhood friend Zheng Yu, who had returned to Kunming, to go hiking together in Xishan Forest Park. This was her first outdoor hike in a year, about 6 kilometers with an ascent of 400 meters. Along the way her legs were sore, but when she looked down at Dianchi Lake from the summit, she felt an unprecedented sense of openness. Zheng Yu taught her to adjust her breathing rhythm. After descending, she recorded the experience and decided to hike at least once a month.

subevent.name: Heading to Xishan Forest Park
subevent.description: At 8:15 a.m., Sun Yuwei left home and took a dedicated bus line to Xishan Forest Park. About 40 minutes later, she arrived at the entrance and met up with her childhood friend Zheng Yu, who had been waiting there early. The two took a photo together at the gate, checked the park map, and decided on a hiking route: from the foot of the mountain up the stone steps of Thousand-Step Cliff to Dragon Gate, about 6 kilometers in total with an elevation gain of 400 meters.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Xishan District - Xishan Forest Park entrance

subevent.name: Climbing the stone steps of Xishan.
subevent.description: At about 9:20 a.m., Sun Yuwei and Zheng Yu began climbing up the stone steps. At first Sun Yuwei kept a fast pace, but after half an hour her legs gradually grew sore and weak, and her breathing became rapid. Seeing this, Zheng Yu taught her to adjust her breathing rhythm: inhale for two steps, exhale for two steps. Sun Yuwei practiced as instructed and gradually adapted to the pace. Along the way, they often stopped to admire the wild rhododendrons and ancient trees by the roadside and chatted about what was going on in each other's lives.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Xishan District - Xishan Forest Park Hiking Trail

subevent.name: Overlooking Dianchi Lake from the mountaintop.
subevent.description: At 11:10 a.m., Sun Yuwei and Zheng Yu successfully reached the Dragon Gate Observation Deck at an altitude of about 2,300 meters. Overlooking from the platform, the entire Dianchi Lake stretched out with vast blue waves, set off by the blue sky and white clouds, offering an extremely broad view. Sun Yuwei felt an unprecedented sense of openness and clarity, and the soreness in her legs from before disappeared completely. The two sat down on a bench on the observation deck, took out nuts and water to replenish their energy, and Zheng Yu took photos of Sun Yuwei with his phone. Sun Yuwei briefly wrote down her feelings at the moment in her journal.
subevent.location: Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - Xishan Longmen Observation Deck

subevent.name: Hiking back down the mountain
subevent.description: At 11:50 a.m., Sun Yuwei and Zheng Yu went down the mountain along another gentler slope. During the descent, Sun Yuwei felt slight pressure on her knees, and Zheng Yu reminded her to control her pace and take small, slow steps. Around 1 p.m., the two returned to the entrance at the foot of the mountain and each had a bowl of cold rice noodles at a nearby snack shop for lunch. Afterward, Zheng Yu took a taxi home, while Sun Yuwei took the bus back to the city.
subevent.location: Snack shop at the foot of Xishan Forest Park, Xishan District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: 500 Miles Music Festival experience
description: On July 19, her best friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi dragged Sun Yuwei to the Wubaili Music Festival by Dianchi Lake under the pretext of 'the last craziness after graduation.' The live rock music and crowded crowd made her extremely uncomfortable. Most of the time she sat on the lawn in the distance wearing noise-cancelling headphones and doodling in her journal. In the evening, during the performance of the band Miserable Faith, she was briefly shaken by the power of the collective singing. Although she did not like it, she honestly wrote in her diary: 'This is the edge of my world, but it does exist.' Afterwards, she felt even more grateful for her quiet daily life.

subevent.name: Persuaded by her best friend to join the music festival
subevent.description: On the morning of July 19, 2025, Sun Yuwei was writing in her home study when she received a WeChat call from her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi. Using “the last wild fling after graduation” as an excuse, the two strongly urged her to go with them to the Wubaili Music Festival, held beside Dianchi Lake that afternoon. Sun Yuwei was reluctant, but unable to withstand their persistent coaxing, she finally agreed to go. She packed a simple backpack with noise-cancelling headphones, her journal, and a pen.
subevent.location: Sun Yuwei's home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Heading to the music festival venue.
subevent.description: At about 1 p.m. on July 19, 2025, Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi gathered downstairs at Sun Yuwei's home, and the three took a ride-hailing car to the Wubaili Music Festival venue by Dianchi Lake in Kunming. On the way, Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi excitedly discussed the lineup, while Sun Yuwei wore headphones and looked out the window with mixed feelings.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - in a ride-hailing car on the way to Dianchi Lake

subevent.name: Feeling unwell at the music festival and spending time alone
subevent.description: From the afternoon to the evening of July 19, 2025, after the three entered the venue, Sun Yuwei found herself surrounded by the blaring rock music and the jostling crowd and felt extremely uncomfortable. She told her close friends and left the crowd alone, walked to a distant lawn, sat down, put on her noise-canceling headphones, took out her journal, and doodled and recorded her observations. Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi watched the performance in the crowd, occasionally sending her WeChat messages to check on her.
subevent.location: Outdoor lawn of the Five Hundred Li Music Festival at Dianchi Lake, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: In the evening, blown away by Miserable Faith's performance
subevent.description: On the evening of July 19, 2025, when the band Miserable Faith came on stage, the sound of the audience singing along swept across the venue. Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi pulled Sun Yuwei to the edge of the crowd to experience it. She was shaken by the power of thousands of people singing together, and felt a momentary stir in her heart. Although she did not like this style of music, at that moment she acknowledged the real existence of this experience.
subevent.location: The edge of the stage area of the Five Hundred Li Music Festival at Dianchi Lake, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: After returning home, write in the diary and reflect
subevent.description: On the evening of July 19, 2025, the three of them took a taxi back to the city. After returning home and washing up, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk, opened her diary, and honestly recorded her experience at the music festival that day: "This is the edge of my world, but it truly exists." She wrote down the moment she was shaken by the choir and became more clearly aware of how much she cherished and was grateful for her quiet daily life.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - Sun Yuwei’s home study

name: Visiting a bookstore with her mother and sharing progress on the essay
description: On the morning of July 8, Sun Yuwei invited her mother, Li Xiulan, to go with her to Mingyuan Bookstore. The mother and daughter spent a quiet and warm morning in the bookstore's reading area. Sun Yuwei showed her mother the preliminary layout of her essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes' and shared the takeaways from the revision meeting with editor Xu Mingyuan. Li Xiulan carefully looked through the manuscript and offered encouragement and suggestions. The two also picked out several new books together. This interaction made Sun Yuwei feel the importance of family support on her writing path.

subevent.name: Invite mother to come along
subevent.description: On the morning of July 8, 2025, while having breakfast at home (123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province) with her mother Li Xiulan, Sun Yuwei invited her mother to go together in the morning to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street. Li Xiulan gladly agreed, and after a brief tidy-up, the two got ready to go out.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

subevent.name: Heading to Mingyuan Bookstore.
subevent.description: At around 9 a.m. on July 8, 2025, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan set out from home on foot, walked along Renmin Middle Road, turned onto Wenlin Street, and arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore about 15 minutes later. Along the way, the mother and daughter chatted about recent life in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
subevent.location: Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Sharing essay progress at the bookstore.
subevent.description: From 9:30 to 11:00 am on July 8, 2025, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan sat down in a corner of the reading area at Mingyuan Bookstore. Sun Yuwei took out the manuscript layout of her essay collection "Slow Travel Notes" from her canvas bag, showed her mother the initially completed structure and selected essays, and gave a detailed account of what she had gained from the online editing meeting with editor Xu Mingyuan the previous day. Li Xiulan put on her reading glasses and carefully went through every page, offering encouragement and suggestions on some chapters, and also asked about the publishing plan. The bookstore owner, Qin Mingyuan, came over briefly to say hello and recommended two newly arrived essay collections. The whole exchange was quiet and warm, and Sun Yuwei felt her mother's understanding and support.
subevent.location: Reading Area, Mingyuan Bookstore, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Choosing new books
subevent.description: On July 8, 2025, from 11:00 to 11:30 AM, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan selected books together in the new arrivals section of Mingyuan Bookstore. Sun Yuwei chose a collection of essays by a Japanese essayist and a new book by a local writer, while Li Xiulan picked two new books on family education. The mother and daughter recommended books to each other and quietly exchanged expectations about the contents as they browsed. At checkout, Qin Mingyuan gave Sun Yuwei a member discount, and Sun Yuwei paid with her own manuscript fee income. The two then left the bookstore with the new books and walked back home.
subevent.location: Cashier Area, Mingyuan Bookstore, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Discussed the column topic with the editor and submitted a new essay
description: On August 14, Sun Yuwei discussed the topic for the next column with Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision, via WeChat. Drawing on the Kunming local chronicles she had recently consulted at the Yunnan Provincial Library, she settled on an essay themed [Memories of Everyday Life in Kunming's Old Streets]. On August 16, she completed the first draft and sent it to Editor Xu, who gave positive feedback on its historical perspective and only suggested adjusting the rhythm of some sentences. On August 18, Sun Yuwei revised and formally submitted the final draft, and the essay was scheduled to be published in early September.

subevent.name: Discussing column topics with the editor.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei communicated with Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Horizon, via WeChat about the topic for the next column. Combining this with the Kunming local chronicles she had recently consulted, she ultimately confirmed the direction of writing an essay themed "Memories of Everyday Life in Kunming's Old Streets."

subevent.name: Completed the first draft and sent it to the editor
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei finished the first draft of her essay The Everyday Memories of Kunming's Old Streets and sent it to editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat. After reading it, Xu Mingyuan praised it, saying the historical perspective was unique, and only suggested adjusting the rhythm of some sentences for greater fluency.

subevent.name: Revise and submit the final draft
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei adjusted the rhythm of the sentences in the prose draft according to Xu Mingyuan's revision suggestions. After completing the revisions, she formally submitted the final version to Editor Xu via WeChat. The article was scheduled to be published in early September.

name: Sent a Mother's Day gift and had a warm phone call
description: On May 9, Sun Yuwei carefully selected and packaged flower cakes and a new book in Hangzhou as Mother's Day gifts, and sent them by courier that day to her mother Li Xiulan in faraway Kunming. On Mother's Day, May 11, though she was in Hangzhou, she had a warm video call with her mother on WeChat. Her mother was overjoyed to receive the gifts and laughingly said, "This is the best gift." The mother-daughter bond grew deeper through understanding.

subevent.name: Preparing a Mother's Day gift
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei carefully picked out a new book (the essay collection “Here and Now”) at an independent bookstore in Hangzhou, and bought Kunming-style flower cakes at a specialty shop. After returning home, she wrapped the flower cakes and the new book in gift paper by hand, attached a greeting card with a blessing message, and prepared to send them as a Mother's Day gift to her mother Li Xiulan, who lives in Kunming.

subevent.name: Send Mother's Day gift
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei took the wrapped gifts to an SF Express pickup point in Hangzhou, filled in the shipping address as her home in Kunming, paid the shipping fee, and successfully sent the flower cakes and new book. She confirmed that the delivery was expected to arrive within 2-3 days, ensuring her mother would receive it before Mother's Day.

subevent.name: Had a warm phone call with her mother on Mother's Day.
subevent.description: On Mother's Day, Sun Yuwei, who was in Hangzhou, contacted her mother Li Xiulan, who was at home in Kunming, via WeChat video call. Her mother had already received the gift and was very happy. The two chatted about family matters over the phone, and her mother said with a laugh, “The fact that you thought of sending me a gift is the best gift of all.” Sun Yuwei expressed her longing and gratitude for her mother, and their mother-daughter bond grew deeper through mutual understanding. The call lasted about 30 minutes.

name: Accepted an in-depth interview with the podcast "City Light Voice".
description: On August 26, Sun Yuwei prepared interview content in her home study, practiced reading aloud, and confirmed the outline. On the afternoon of August 28, she went to the recording studio of Kunming Radio Station for a two-hour in-depth interview with host Chen Chen, sharing her creative journey, bookstore observations, and urban writing, and reading excerpts of her prose; the recording went smoothly. Afterwards, she returned to her home in Wuhua District, shared the experience with her mother, and organized the audio. After the podcast went live on August 29, she gained more than 200 followers on Xiaohongshu; listeners' comments were moving, and she shared her joy with her editor, feeling the warmth of the audio medium.

subevent.name: Prepare interview content and scripts.
subevent.description: In her home study, Sun Yuwei sorted through her notes on her writing process, chose excerpts from her essay collection 'Watching from Behind the Glass' to read on the podcast. She practiced her Mandarin pronunciation repeatedly to ensure a smooth and natural reading, and confirmed the key questions in the interview outline with the host via WeChat.

subevent.name: Head to the recording studio of Kunming Radio Station.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 28, Sun Yuwei left her home in Wuhua District and took a taxi to Kunming Radio Station. She carried a canvas bag containing manuscript drafts of her essay collection and a notebook, and wore her favorite white shirt. She felt a little nervous but full of anticipation.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City - Kunming Radio Station

subevent.name: Conduct an in-depth podcast interview.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei had a two-hour in-depth face-to-face interview with host Chen Chen in the recording studio. The host asked questions about her creative journey, observations of independent bookstores, and urban writing. She shared behind-the-scenes stories from writing her essay collection and read aloud excerpts from 'The Vigil Behind the Glass.' Because her Mandarin was standard and fluent, the recording went smoothly, and the host praised her clear, expressive voice. Throughout the interview, sound engineer Xiao Liu was in charge of the equipment.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City - Kunming Radio Station recording studio

subevent.name: Returned home after the interview.
subevent.description: After the interview, Sun Yuwei briefly exchanged pleasantries and said goodbye to the host and the sound recorder, then took a taxi back to her home in Wuhua District. Once home, she told her mother about the interview experience and organized the audio recordings from the interview to keep as a memento.

subevent.name: Podcast launch and social media feedback
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei's interview program went live on the 'City Light Voice' podcast. The next day, she found her Xiaohongshu follower count had increased by more than 200. Many listeners commented that they remembered the street corners they had ignored. She shared the good news with her editor Xu Mingyuan, and at the same time felt the warmth of audio media, bringing new attention to the column collaboration.

name: Family tomb-sweeping and a warm dinner during the Qingming Festival
description: During the Qingming Festival period, Sun Yuwei and her parents went one day early (April 3) to flower shops and grocery stores in Wuhua District, Kunming, to buy fresh flowers, incense candles, and other tomb-sweeping supplies. The next day (April 4), the family of three set out from home and went to a suburban cemetery to hold a tomb-sweeping ceremony to honor their ancestors. After the ceremony, the three went to a nearby Yunnan cuisine restaurant for a meal. During the meal, her father recalled old memories, and her mother asked about Yuwei's studies and career. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious. The whole event reflected family collaboration and familial support.

subevent.name: Purchase grave-sweeping supplies.
subevent.description: The day before Qingming Festival, Sun Yuwei went with her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan to flower shops and grocery stores near Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, to carefully choose white chrysanthemums, incense candles, and fruit offerings for the ancestor worship. Yuwei personally picked out flowers in the shop, her mother discussed arrangements with the shopkeeper, and her father was in charge of buying incense, candles, and joss paper. The family worked together smoothly, fully preparing for the Qingming grave-sweeping the next day.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District Flower Shop and Grocery Store

subevent.name: Set out for the cemetery.
subevent.description: On the morning of Qingming Festival, Sun Yuwei set out from her home on Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, with her parents. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, drove the family car to a cemetery on the outskirts of Kunming. Along the way, her father talked about how he followed his elders to sweep tombs during Qingming Festival when he was young, while her mother reminded Yuwei of the proper etiquette for the memorial visit. Yuwei stared at the spring scenery outside the window, feeling calm and solemn.
subevent.location: Kunming City - on the way from home to a suburban cemetery

subevent.name: Tomb-sweeping ceremony and remembrance
subevent.description: After arriving at the cemetery, the family of three held a tomb-sweeping ceremony in front of their ancestors' headstones. Sun Yuwei placed carefully chosen chrysanthemums in front of the graves. Her mother, Li Xiulan, lit incense and candles, while her father, Sun Mingyuan, burned spirit money and quietly spoke about the family's recent news. The three of them bowed together in tribute and took turns sharing warm memories of their late grandparents and other deceased loved ones. In the solemn atmosphere, Yuwei felt the weight of family continuity and the warmth of kinship.

subevent.name: Dining at a Yunnan restaurant
subevent.description: After the tomb-sweeping, it was just noon, and the family drove to a well-known, long-established Yunnan restaurant near the cemetery. On the way, her father suggested trying the restaurant's signature crossing-the-bridge rice noodles and mushroom hot pot, and her mother agreed. In the car, Yuwei went through the photos she had taken during the tomb-sweeping that day and discussed the lunch menu with her parents. After arriving, the three entered the restaurant and sat down.
subevent.location: Kunming - Yunnan restaurant near the suburban cemetery

subevent.name: Warm family dinner and conversation.
subevent.description: In a Yunnan restaurant, the family of three sat down for a meal and ordered Yunnan specialties such as Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles, mushroom hot pot, and braised dried beef. During the meal, her father Sun Mingyuan recalled his experiences working at the Cultural Bureau in his youth, while her mother Li Xiulan asked about Yuwei's graduation thesis progress and freelance writing, and offered suggestions about her future career direction — suggesting she consider obtaining a teacher qualification certificate or entering a cultural institution. Yuwei listened attentively, actively shared her thoughts, and deeply felt the warmth and support of her family. The whole meal lasted about two hours, with a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Kunming - Yunnan restaurant near the suburban cemetery

name: Get the second dose of the HPV vaccine
description: On the afternoon of October 24, Sun Yuwei received her second HPV vaccine shot on time. A mild soreness lasted for one day. She pasted the labels from both vaccine packages onto the health page of her journal and briefly noted her feelings: 'The body is the temple of the soul; regular maintenance is a ritual.' The third dose was scheduled for February of the following year, and she had already set a reminder.

subevent.name: Get the second dose of the HPV vaccine
subevent.description: At the vaccination room of the community health service center, after the nurse verified her information, Sun Yuwei received the second dose of the HPV vaccine. She stayed for 30 minutes of observation after the injection, during which no adverse reactions occurred. After the shot, her arm felt slightly sore and swollen for about a day.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: Recorded vaccine information in her journal
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei tore off the packaging labels from the second vaccine dose she received that day and the first dose earlier, pasted them into the health record page of her journal, and wrote in pen: "The body is the temple of the soul; regular upkeep is a ritual." At the same time, she set a reminder in her phone calendar for the third dose (February next year).
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Received the payment from Southwest Literature and treated relatives and friends to a meal to share the joy.
description: On March 25, Sun Yuwei received a 1000 yuan manuscript fee from Southwest Literature. That evening, she treated her parents and her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi to steam pot chicken to celebrate, sharing the joy of seeing her article published. Although the fee was small, it was an important step in the rewards of creative writing.

subevent.name: Confirm that the manuscript fee has been credited to her account
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei checked the mobile banking app and confirmed that the 1,000 yuan manuscript fee from Southwest Literature had arrived in her account. Filled with a sense of accomplishment, she decided to invite family and friends to dinner that evening to share the joy.

subevent.name: Invite relatives and friends to a gathering
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei contacted her father Sun Mingyuan, mother Li Xiulan, and close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi via WeChat and phone, telling them the good news that she had received a 1,000 yuan contribution fee, and invited them to dine together that evening at a well-known steamed chicken pot restaurant in Kunming to celebrate.

subevent.name: Book a table at the steam pot chicken restaurant.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei called the Fuzhao Lou steam pot chicken restaurant in Wuhua District, Kunming, to book a private room. She confirmed dinner at 6 PM for five guests (herself, her parents, Zhang Jing, and Chen Sisi), and shared the restaurant's address with everyone.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Fuzhao Lou Steam Pot Chicken Restaurant

subevent.name: Went to the restaurant and celebrated with a group dinner
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei set out from home with her parents for the Fuzhao Lou Steam Pot Chicken Restaurant, where they met up with Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi, who had arrived earlier. After they were seated, the five of them enjoyed specialty dishes such as steam pot chicken in the private room, chatting happily about the joy of having her article published. Sun Yuwei settled the bill with the 1,000 yuan payment for her article that had just arrived, and the atmosphere was warm and cheerful.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Fuzhao Lou Steam Pot Chicken Restaurant

name: Going home to visit parents, with warm family memories.
description: On June 22, Sun Yuwei set out from her dormitory at Yunnan University, bought flower cakes and Pu-erh tea as gifts, and took a bus back home. After arriving, she greeted her parents in the living room and gave them the gifts. The three of them chatted about recent news. That evening, her father brought out an old photo album, and the family of three sat together on the living room sofa looking through the photos, recalling the past, with warm affection flowing.

subevent.name: Preparing gifts for going home
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei packed her backpack in the dormitory at Yunnan University and went to a nearby pastry shop to buy the flower cakes her mother liked and the Pu'er tea her father loved as visiting gifts.

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei carried the gifts and took the bus from school back to her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, arriving in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Kunming City - home on Renmin Middle Road

subevent.name: Exchanged greetings with parents and gave them gifts.
subevent.description: After arriving home, Sun Yuwei warmly greeted her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan in the living room, and gave the flower cakes and Pu'er tea she had bought to her mother and father respectively. The three of them chatted about recent life.
subevent.location: Kunming - living room of home on Renmin Middle Road

subevent.name: The whole family flipped through old photo albums and recalled past memories.
subevent.description: That night, her father, Sun Mingyuan, took out several old photo albums from the study. The three of them sat together on the living room sofa, looking through photos of Sun Yuwei as a child and chatting about funny stories from the past, with warmth flowing through the family atmosphere.
subevent.location: Kunming - living room of home on Renmin Middle Road

name: Sun Yuwei was hired as the resident florist at the yoga studio and completed her first planning.
description: From June 4 to 20, 2025, after initial communication with He Lu, the owner of the yoga studio, and preparing her portfolio and service plan, Sun Yuwei officially signed a resident florist employment agreement on June 18, with course fees waived and a small amount of compensation. She celebrated on the day of signing, then on June 20 planned her first floral landscape design, marking the successful monetization of her interest.

subevent.name: Preliminary communication with He Lu about the appointment.
subevent.description: After the yoga class, Sun Yuwei spoke with the yoga studio owner, He Lu. He Lu formally proposed hiring her as a resident florist, and the two had a preliminary discussion on details including the job responsibilities, a monthly floral landscape design, waiving the yoga class fee, and a small amount of compensation.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Preparing the employment contract and floral design proposal
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei organized her flower arrangement portfolio in her home study and drafted a brief service description for floral landscape design, listing the flower material types and design styles she can provide, in preparation for officially signing a contract.

subevent.name: Formally signed the appointment agreement
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei went to Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center and officially signed a resident florist employment agreement with the owner He Lu. The agreement stipulated that she would design a flower arrangement landscape for the yoga center once a month, explicitly waived all yoga course fees, and additionally provided a small monthly payment.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Celebrating the successful appointment
subevent.description: After the formal appointment ended, Sun Yuwei shared her joy on WeChat Moments, recording this moment of turning her interest into income, and went with He Lu to an independent café near the yoga studio to exchange creative ideas about combining flower arranging and yoga.
subevent.location: Kunming - café near Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Planning the first floral landscape design
subevent.description: At home in her study, Sun Yuwei conceived and planned her first floral landscape design based on the yoga studio's spatial style and He Lu's needs, including selecting seasonal flowers, deciding on the color scheme, and setting the budget, making full preparations for the first execution in July.

name: Warm weekend family dinner
description: On Sunday, July 20, Sun Yuwei, to thank her parents for their constant support, carefully selected the Four Treasures of the Study to give to her father and personally cooked his favorite mushroom hot pot. In the evening, the family sat around and enjoyed the meal, and her parents looked deeply gratified. She wrote in her diary: “It turns out that my pace of growing up has finally caught up with their aging figures.”

subevent.name: Going Out to Select and Purchase the Four Treasures of the Study
subevent.description: To thank her father for his support, Sun Yuwei went alone in the morning to a time-honored Four Treasures of the Study shop in Wuhua District, Kunming. She carefully chose a set of high-quality writing brushes, ink sticks, Xuan paper, and an inkstone as a gift. After carefully comparing different brands and materials, she finally selected a Duan inkstone and Huzhou writing brushes, and asked the shop assistant to wrap them in a brocade box.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District Cultural Supplies Store

subevent.name: Go to the market to buy mushroom hot pot ingredients
subevent.description: After buying the Four Treasures of the Study, Sun Yuwei went on the way to the nearby farmers' market. Based on her memory of the flavors her father liked, she bought fresh local mushrooms such as termite mushrooms, porcini mushrooms, and bamboo fungus, as well as hot pot ingredients including free-range chicken, ham, and vegetables, and picked out a special dipping sauce. She chatted with the stall owner about how to handle the mushrooms to ensure the ingredients were fresh.

subevent.name: Go home to prepare ingredients and cook a mushroom hot pot.
subevent.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei got busy in the kitchen. She carefully washed the mushrooms, cut up the free-range chicken and ham, simmered stock in a clay pot, and prepared the dipping sauce. Along the way, she drew on techniques her mother had taught her, and even called her mother to confirm the cooking time. After about two hours of preparation, the mushroom hot pot finally gave off a rich aroma.

subevent.name: Presenting father with the Four Treasures of the Study
subevent.description: Before dinner, Sun Yuwei personally gave her father Sun Mingyuan the wrapped Four Treasures of the Study, and expressed gratitude for her parents' long-standing support of her studies and writing. Her father was pleasantly surprised, opened it on the spot, examined it carefully, and praised his daughter for her good taste. Her mother Li Xiulan smiled contentedly at the side. Her father put the gift away carefully and said he would use this set for calligraphy practice from now on.

subevent.name: The whole family sat around enjoying a mushroom hot pot dinner.
subevent.description: At seven in the evening, the family sat around the dining table, enjoying the mushroom hot pot cooked by Sun Yuwei herself. Her parents praised her cooking as they ate; her father especially loved the umami of the broth. During the meal, the three chatted about everyday matters, including Sun Yuwei's recent column articles and graduation plans, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere. The meal lasted about an hour.

name: Start keeping a food diary and adjust nutritional structure
description: On August 6, on the advice of her yoga partner He Lu, Sun Yuwei began using a mobile app to record her daily diet. She found that she often skipped protein at breakfast and mostly ate rice noodles for lunch, with insufficient vegetable intake. Starting August 10, she adjusted to adding eggs and fruit to breakfast, pairing lunch with a serving of stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and ensuring a daily water intake of 1.5 liters. By the end of the month, she clearly felt more energetic in the afternoon; although her weight had not increased, her body shape was more proportionate.

subevent.name: Recording and analyzing initial dietary intake
subevent.description: On August 6, 2025, on the advice of her yoga partner He Lu, Sun Yuwei began downloading and installing a diet tracking app on her phone. That day she recorded breakfast (only a bowl of rice noodles) and lunch (rice noodles without vegetables), and found that protein and vegetables were severely insufficient. Over the next three days (August 7 to August 9), she insisted on recording immediately after every meal, including breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks. Her diet still centered on rice noodles, lacked vegetables, often lacked protein at lunch, and daily water intake was less than 1 liter. On the evening of August 9, she organized and recorded the data from these days, marked the nutritional gaps of each meal, and clarified the direction for adjustment.

subevent.name: Install a diet-tracking app and record the first day's meals.
subevent.description: On August 6, 2025, on the advice of her yoga partner He Lu, Sun Yuwei downloaded and installed a diet tracking app on her phone at her home in Kunming. After installation, she began recording that day's breakfast (a bowl of rice noodles) and lunch (rice noodles with a few side dishes, no vegetables). Through the app's analysis, she found that her protein and vegetable intake was seriously insufficient and initially realized that her dietary structure was unbalanced.

subevent.name: Continue recording and observing your diet
subevent.description: On August 7, 2025, Sun Yuwei insisted on using the app to record immediately after every meal. She recorded breakfast (rice noodles), lunch (rice noodles with a small amount of meat), dinner (rice noodles with vegetables), and a snack (flower cake). The data summary showed that her all-day diet still centered on rice noodles, vegetable intake remained insufficient, lunch lacked adequate protein, and her total water intake for the day was less than 1 liter. Sun Yuwei marked these nutritional gaps in the app.

subevent.name: Day three diet record and analysis
subevent.description: On August 8, 2025, Sun Yuwei continued strictly keeping her food diary. She recorded breakfast (rice noodles with an egg), lunch (rice noodles with a small amount of vegetables and tofu), dinner (mushroom hotpot takeout with various mushrooms and a little vegetables), and a snack (brown sugar boba milk tea). The app showed that her vegetable intake had improved slightly that day, but her protein was still insufficient and the drink was high in sugar. In the record, she added a note about the need to increase high-quality protein and reduce sugar intake.

subevent.name: Record and analyze the fourth day's diet.
subevent.description: On August 9, 2025, Sun Yuwei continued to record her diet in real time throughout the day (breakfast: rice noodles with vegetables; lunch: rice noodles with chicken leg; dinner: crossing-the-bridge rice noodle set meal; snack: flower cake). That evening, at her home in Kunming, she compiled all the diet record data from the previous four days (August 6 to August 9) and used an app to generate a preliminary analysis report. She noted the nutritional gaps in each meal one by one, summarizing the main problems: too many rice noodles as the staple, insufficient vegetables and protein, low water intake, and high-sugar snacks. She identified the adjustments she needed to make: increase vegetable and protein intake, ensure at least 1.5 liters of water per day, and reduce high-sugar snacks, and she planned to gradually improve in her subsequent meals.

subevent.name: Implement dietary structure adjustments
subevent.description: Starting August 10, 2025, Sun Yuwei began following a new meal plan based on her earlier dietary analysis. Each day, she added a boiled egg and a seasonal fruit (such as an apple or banana) to breakfast; for lunch, she replaced the main dish with rice noodles or rice and made sure to include a plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables (such as broccoli, water spinach, or choy sum); dinner remained light. She also set a water-drinking alarm to ensure a daily intake of 1.5 liters. She continued to use the app to log every meal and checked her nutritional intake every night, gradually adjusting to the new habits. During this period, she reviewed her weekly food diary every Sunday and made small adjustments to the menu to avoid monotony.
subevent.location: Kunming City - home and university cafeteria

subevent.name: Started following the new diet plan
subevent.description: On the morning of August 10, Sun Yuwei officially began implementing her adjusted diet plan based on previous dietary analysis results. She first set a daily water reminder alarm on her phone (target: 1.5 liters), then went to a nearby supermarket to buy ingredients for the coming week: eggs, seasonal fruit (apples, bananas), broccoli, water spinach, choy sum, and so on. For breakfast that day, she followed the plan and had a boiled egg with an apple; for lunch at the Yunnan University cafeteria, she chose rice noodles with stir-fried seasonal vegetables (broccoli); for dinner at home, she kept it light, eating only a bowl of millet porridge and a small portion of mixed cucumber salad. She installed a diet tracking app and logged her three meals and water intake for the day.
subevent.location: Kunming - home, supermarket, and university cafeteria

subevent.name: Daily diet adjustment and tracking
subevent.description: From August 10 to August 30, Sun Yuwei followed the adjusted diet plan every day. Each breakfast consistently included a boiled egg and a seasonal fruit (alternating between apple and banana); lunch was at the Yunnan University cafeteria or at home, with rice noodles or rice as the main dish, and she always paired it with a serving of stir-fried seasonal vegetables (such as broccoli, water spinach, or choy sum, changing the type daily); dinner remained light, consisting mainly of porridge, soup, or a small amount of vegetables. She used a diet recording app to log the food types and portions of every meal, and every night before bed she checked the day's nutritional intake ratio (protein, carbs, fat) to ensure it was roughly balanced. She also relied on a water-drinking alarm reminder, bringing her daily water intake to 1.5 liters. She gradually adapted to the new habits, and when the cafeteria menu was occasionally monotonous, she would flexibly choose prepared dishes from home.
subevent.location: Kunming City - home and university cafeteria

subevent.name: First Week Diet Review and Menu Fine-Tuning
subevent.description: August 17 was a Sunday. In the evening, Sun Yuwei spent about 30 minutes reviewing the first week (August 10-16) of diet tracking app data. She looked at screenshots of each day's nutrition ratios and found that her lunch vegetable choices were somewhat monotonous (water spinach three days in a row), and that she occasionally couldn't resist snacks at dinner. She decided that starting the next week, she would plan her lunch vegetable varieties in advance, increase the frequency of choy sum and broccoli, and add a small serving of nuts at 4 p.m. to ease hunger before dinner and avoid snacks. She recorded the adjustment plan in her journal.

subevent.name: Second-week diet review and menu tweaks
subevent.description: August 24 was a Sunday. In the evening, Sun Yuwei again reviewed her diet records for the second week (August 17-23). She found that the vegetable rotation at lunch worked well, but she was beginning to tire of the fruit-and-egg combination at breakfast. She decided that starting next week she would swap the breakfast fruit for kiwi or dragon fruit, and try changing boiled eggs to steamed egg or egg drop soup for variety. She also noticed that the portion of rice noodles at lunch was too large, so she decided to reduce the noodles and increase the vegetables. She recorded these adjustments in her journal and planned to implement them in the third week.

subevent.name: End-of-month health assessment and summary.
subevent.description: On August 31, 2025, after completing the last day of diet logging, Sun Yuwei summarized and evaluated the overall effect of this month's dietary adjustments. She reviewed the nutrition statistics charts in the app and compared the changes before and after the adjustment: breakfast protein intake reached the target, vegetable intake increased to more than 200 grams per day, and water intake remained stable at 1.5 liters. She clearly felt more energetic in the afternoons than before, and the drowsiness during afternoon classes disappeared. Although her weight had not changed significantly, she felt her figure looked more proportionate in the mirror. In the evening, she planned to record her summary and reflections in her journal and planned to continue the new eating habits into September.

name: Purchased floral materials and completed the Ikenobo flower arrangement piece titled Late Spring Whispers.
description: On April 18, Sun Yuwei went to Dounan Flower Market in Kunming in the morning and selected purple irises, white daisies, and pothos leaves. In the afternoon, on her balcony, she created a flower arrangement using Ikenobo style techniques, with irises as the main branch, daisies as the guest branch, and pothos leaves filling in. After completing the piece, she named it "Murmurings of Late Spring." She then photographed it and shared it in the flower arrangement hobby group, received praise from Su Man, and finally cleaned up her tools and placed the arrangement in the living room.

subevent.name: Prepare flower arrangement materials.
subevent.description: On the morning of April 18, Sun Yuwei went to Dounan Flower Market in Kunming, where she bought seasonal purple irises, white daisies, and green pothos leaves, and checked whether the flower containers, flower scissors, kenzan, and other tools at home were complete.

subevent.name: Created the flower arrangement "Late Spring Whispers".
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 18, on her balcony at home, Sun Yuwei used Ikenobo-style flower arrangement techniques, using irises as the main branch, daisies as the guest branch, and pothos leaves as filler. She trimmed them carefully, adjusted angles and heights, and finally completed an arrangement full of late-spring mood, naming it “Late Spring Whispers.”

subevent.name: Clean and organize the flower arranging tools.
subevent.description: After the flower arrangement sharing session, Sun Yuwei cleaned the vases, discarded the trimmed branches and leaves, put away the flower shears and kenzan, and placed the finished arrangement on the living room coffee table as decoration.
subevent.location: Kunming City - home balcony and living room

name: Social security planning discussion and policy lookup
description: During dinner on July 10, Sun Yuwei discussed post-graduation social security issues with her parents. Her mother reminded her that although income from freelance writing was acceptable, she needed to plan her own medical care and pension. She decided to pay social insurance as a flexible worker. The next morning (July 11), she checked the flexible-employment social insurance policy on the official website at home and recorded the relevant information.

subevent.name: Family dinner discussion on social insurance
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Sun Yuwei had dinner with her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan in the dining room of their home in Wuhua District, Kunming. At the table, her mother Li Xiulan reminded Sun Yuwei that although her freelancing income was stable, after graduation there would be no employer paying social insurance, so she would need to plan her medical and pension insurance herself. Sun Yuwei agreed, and after thinking it over, decided to pay social insurance as a flexibly employed person. She immediately said she would start preparing the relevant materials. The three then had an initial discussion about the social insurance contribution base, the application process, and other related matters.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home dining room

subevent.name: Looked up social insurance policies for flexible employment online
subevent.description: On the morning of July 11, Sun Yuwei, in her study at home in Wuhua District, Kunming, used a laptop to check the specific policies for flexible workers participating in basic old-age insurance and medical insurance for urban workers on the official website of the Kunming Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau and its WeChat public account, including contribution base, rates, application location, and the list of required documents. She recorded the key information in her journal and took screenshots to save the web pages.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Comprehensive physical examination
description: On February 20, after repeated persuasion from her mother, Li Xiulan, Sun Yuwei booked a comprehensive physical examination at Kunming First People's Hospital for February 22 through an online platform. The night before the examination (February 21), she fasted as required and prepared her documents. On the morning of February 22, accompanied by her mother, she completed a complete blood count, liver function tests, kidney function tests, thyroid ultrasound, and bone density measurement; the process went smoothly. On February 24, she picked up the report herself. It showed a low BMI and mild iron-deficiency anemia, and the doctor advised her to strengthen her nutrition. She pasted the report into her journal and drew a fork and an apple to remind herself to eat well.

subevent.name: Schedule a physical examination
subevent.description: Under repeated urging from her mother Li Xiulan, Sun Yuwei booked a comprehensive physical examination package for the morning of February 22 through the online booking platform of Kunming First People's Hospital. The package included blood routine, liver function, kidney function, thyroid ultrasound, and bone density test.

subevent.name: Preparation before the physical exam.
subevent.description: To ensure accurate health checkup results, Sun Yuwei, reminded by her mother Li Xiulan, began fasting on the evening before the checkup (drinking only a small amount of plain water), and prepared in advance the ID documents, medical insurance card, and appointment confirmation information needed for the checkup.

subevent.name: Comprehensive physical examination process
subevent.description: In the morning, accompanied by her mother Li Xiulan, Sun Yuwei went to the Physical Examination Center of Kunming First People's Hospital. Following the appointment process, she completed in turn a complete blood count, liver function test, kidney function test, thyroid ultrasound, and bone density test. She was a little nervous when having blood drawn, but with the nurse's reassurance it went smoothly. The whole checkup took about two hours.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Kunming First People's Hospital

subevent.name: Pick up the physical exam report
subevent.description: Three days later, Sun Yuwei went alone to the First People’s Hospital of Kunming to pick up her physical examination report. The report showed that all indicators were basically normal, but her body mass index was low (BMI 17.2) and she had mild iron-deficiency anemia. The doctor advised her to strengthen her nutrition, eat regularly, and gain weight moderately.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Kunming First People's Hospital

name: Get the second dose of the HPV vaccine
description: Early on August 24, Sun Yuwei went to the community health service center as scheduled, received an intramuscular injection in her left upper arm, and stayed for observation for half an hour. The nurse reminded her that the second dose should be two months later. When she got home, she marked October 24 in her journal calendar and wrote down 'Love yourself, don't wait.'

subevent.name: Go to the community health service center.
subevent.description: After getting up in the morning, Sun Yuwei checked the appointment information and the required documents (ID card and medical insurance card), and then walked / took the bus from her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, to the booked community health service center.
subevent.location: Community Health Service Center near Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Vaccination registration and informed consent
subevent.description: After arriving at the community health service center, Sun Yuwei filled out an informed consent form at the vaccination window. The nurse verified her personal information and first-dose vaccination record, confirming that this was the second dose of the HPV vaccine injection.
subevent.location: Community Health Service Center near Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Completed the second vaccine dose
subevent.description: The nurse gave Sun Yuwei an intramuscular injection in her left upper arm, completing the second HPV vaccine dose. The injection went smoothly, with no special discomfort.
subevent.location: Community Health Service Center near Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Remain under observation for 30 minutes
subevent.description: After the vaccination, Sun Yuwei rested for 30 minutes in the observation area of the community health service center to watch for any allergic or adverse reactions. During this time, the nurse told her that the interval between the first and second doses was two months, and reminded her of the next vaccination time. After 30 minutes with no abnormalities, Sun Yuwei left.
subevent.location: Community Health Service Center near Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Journaling after returning home
subevent.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei took out her journal, marked the October 24 date on the calendar page, wrote "Love yourself, don't wait" as a reminder for the next (third dose) vaccination, and recorded her feelings about this vaccination.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Attend the Saturday gathering of the 'Ink and Breath' writing group.
description: On the Saturday afternoons of October 18 and 25, Sun Yuwei attended the regular gatherings of the offline writing group "Ink and Breath." On the 18th, she shared the editorial feedback after submitting "Slow Travel Notes," and group members gave suggestions on the manuscript structure; on the 25th, she read her new work "Wrinkles Under the Shutter," which resonated with and encouraged creators from different industries, further strengthening her sense of belonging in the local creator community.

subevent.name: Attend the October 18 gathering of the 'Ink and Breath' writing group
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, Sun Yuwei went to the second-floor activity area of ‘Mingyuan Bookstore’ on Wenlin Street in Kunming to attend the regular in-person gathering of the ‘Ink and Breath’ writing group. She shared with the eight members present (including bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan, freelance writer Song Wen, and several local literature enthusiasts) the feedback she had received from editor Xu Mingyuan on “Slow Travel Notes”, which she had previously submitted to “Cultural Horizon” magazine. The members discussed the manuscript's structural adjustments, narrative pacing, and supplementary details for about 90 minutes, offering Sun Yuwei revision suggestions from multiple perspectives. After the gathering ended, she briefly exchanged recent creative plans with several members at the bookstore entrance.
subevent.location: Kunming - Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street

subevent.name: Attend the October 25 gathering of the 'Ink and Breath' writing group
subevent.description: On a Saturday afternoon, Sun Yuwei again went to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street in Kunming for the regular gathering of the “Ink and Breath” writing group. Six people attended this gathering. She took the initiative to read aloud her recent short essay “Wrinkles Under the Shutter,” which used old photos she had taken as a thread to explore memory and aging. After the reading, the group members—including a new member who works in photography and a retired teacher—gave positive feedback, saying the essay was sincere in emotion and moving in detail, and shared their own experiences with family images. The resonance among creators from different fields deeply encouraged Sun Yuwei and further strengthened her sense of belonging and creative confidence in the local creator community. After the gathering, she sat with Qin Mingyuan in the bookstore and discussed the possibility of holding a small reading-sharing session in the future.
subevent.location: Kunming - Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street

name: Completed and submitted the new short story 'Alleyway'.
description: On August 25, Sun Yuwei combined the inspiration she had recently accumulated with the material she collected during walks by Green Lake and completed a short story titled ‘Lane Entrance’ set against the old lanes of Kunming, telling of two generations’ vigil amid the city’s transformation. She submitted the piece to the literary magazine ‘Green City’ (the magazine where her literary friend Yang Xiao worked), and mentioned her friendship with Yang Xiao in the submission letter. On August 30, Yang Xiao replied that the manuscript had been received, saying the initial review would take about two weeks, and praised her delicate capture of urban memory.

subevent.name: Write the first draft of a short story.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 25, 2025, in the study of her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei focused on completing the first draft of the short story "The Alleyway," blending recent inspirations with material gathered during her walks around Green Lake. Set in an old Kunming alley, the story follows two generations keeping watch amid the city's transformation.

subevent.name: Revise, polish, and finalize
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 25, 2025, Sun Yuwei repeatedly revised and polished the first draft, adjusted paragraph structure, and refined the language, finally completing the final version and preparing the document format required for submission.

subevent.name: Send submission email to Qingcheng Magazine
subevent.description: On the evening of August 25, 2025, Sun Yuwei sent the finalized short story "Alleyway" along with a standard submission letter (mentioning her friendship with fellow writer Yang Xiao) by email to the official submission inbox of the literary magazine Qingcheng.

subevent.name: Received a reply email from Yang Xiao.
subevent.description: On August 30, 2025, Sun Yuwei received a reply email in her inbox from Yang Xiao, editor of Qingcheng magazine. Yang Xiao confirmed receipt of the manuscript “Alleyway,” said the initial review would take about two weeks, and praised Sun Yuwei’s delicate capture of urban memory.

name: Mother joined the morning yoga routine, creating a new family tradition.
description: On the morning of March 4, her mother, Li Xiulan, responding to Sun Yuwei's yoga habit, joined her for their first morning practice together. Mother and daughter laid out yoga mats in the living room and corrected each other's postures. It gradually became a daily routine, and her younger sister joked on a video call from afar that it was “our family's new tradition.” Yoga became an emotional bond between mother and daughter.

subevent.name: Mother decided to join morning yoga.
subevent.description: Mother Li Xiulan took the initiative to suggest practicing yoga with Sun Yuwei either the previous evening or that morning. Sun Yuwei welcomed it, and the two agreed to practice together in the living room the next morning.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: First mother-daughter morning yoga practice
subevent.description: At 6:30 on the morning of March 4, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan spread out yoga mats in the living room and practiced basic yoga poses following a mobile app. It was her mother's first time, and her movements were unfamiliar. Sun Yuwei patiently corrected her posture. The two encouraged each other and completed a 30-minute practice in a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Younger sister witnesses the new tradition through a video call.
subevent.description: At around 9 a.m., her younger sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, contacted her via WeChat video. Sun Yuwei and her mother shared photos and feelings from their morning yoga session. Sun Yutong smiled and said, “Our family’s new tradition.” The sisters agreed to practice together whenever they go home.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Morning yoga became a daily family routine.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan started a consistent morning yoga practice in the living room at home. After a week of mutual encouragement and correcting each other's postures, it gradually became a new family tradition.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Morning Yoga Day 1
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei and her mother, Li Xiulan, spread out yoga mats in their living room and began a 30-minute morning yoga practice. Sun Yuwei led her mother in reviewing the spinal twists and Cat-Cow pose learned last week. Her mother’s movements were a bit stiff, and Sun Yuwei patiently corrected her. The two completed their first family yoga session in a relaxed atmosphere.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Morning Yoga Day 2
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, the mother and daughter continued practicing yoga in the living room at home. Today Li Xiulan's balance had improved; she could independently complete Tree Pose and hold it for 15 seconds. Sun Yuwei encouraged her from the side and shared breathing techniques. After practice, the two prepared breakfast together, chatting about yoga insights while they worked.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Morning yoga, Day 3
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, the yoga practice continued. Today Sun Yuwei introduced a new pose—Warrior I. Li Xiulan found it a bit difficult but persisted. Sun Yuwei played soft light music on her phone as background, and the two synchronized their breathing in the morning light. After the practice, both felt refreshed and cheerful.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Morning Yoga Day 4
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, the mother and daughter practiced as usual. Today, Li Xiulan took the initiative to ask to practice half fish pose to relieve shoulder and neck fatigue, and Sun Yuwei, based on her own experience, helped her adjust to an appropriate intensity. During the practice, the two frequently exchanged physical sensations, laughter was constant, and the atmosphere at home was warm.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Morning yoga day 5
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, morning yoga has gradually become a habit. Today Sun Yuwei recorded a short video to capture the moment of mother and daughter practicing together.
