Li Xiulan tried One-Legged King Pigeon Pose for the first time; although she could not fully get into it, her willingness to try moved Sun Yuwei. After the practice, the two shared a cup of hot tea.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Day 6 of morning yoga
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, after a week of persistence, Li Xiulan's movements had become noticeably more fluid, and the two completed Sun Salutation A in sync. Sun Yuwei noticed that her mother's expression was more relaxed and focused, and felt the inner changes brought by yoga. After the practice, they chatted in the living room about how to maintain this habit going forward.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

subevent.name: Day 7 of morning yoga
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, it was the last morning yoga session of the week. Mother and daughter reviewed the seven days of practice together, and Sun Yuwei led her mother through a complete relaxation sequence. After the practice, Li Xiulan took the initiative to propose keeping at least three morning yoga sessions a week from now on. Sun Yuwei readily agreed, and the two agreed to carry on this family tradition.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home living room.

name: After her sister returned to Shenzhen, mother and daughter tidied up and found comfort in family affection.
description: On February 3, 2025, her elder sister Sun Yutong returned to Shenzhen. In the early morning, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan saw her sister off at the door of their Kunming home, helping with luggage and saying goodbye with words of care; their mother was somewhat sad. In the morning, the mother and daughter tidied the sister's room together—stripped and washed the sheets and quilt covers, put books back in place, and wiped the furniture. When their mother held a hair clip her sister had left behind and stared blankly, Yuwei comforted her and put the clip away. In the evening, their mother sat on the living room sofa feeling low. Yuwei reassured her that her sister would soon come back again and suggested they look through the family photo albums together in the evening; her mother readily agreed. At night, the mother and daughter sat side by side in the living room, flipping through three photo albums. Her mother told the stories behind the old photos while Yuwei listened attentively. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious; her mother's sadness dissipated, and the two chatted until late at night before going back to their rooms to rest.

subevent.name: Saw my older sister off as she returned to Shenzhen.
subevent.description: Early in the morning, at home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan saw off her older sister Sun Yutong. Her sister was pulling her suitcase, ready to head to Kunming Changshui International Airport. Sun Yuwei helped carry the luggage to the door, and her mother reminded her sister to take care of her health and diet in Shenzhen. The sisters hugged goodbye and agreed to meet again after the Spring Festival. Yuwei and her mother watched as her sister got into the car and left. Her mother felt a little wistful, and Yuwei put her arm around her mother's shoulders and comforted her softly.
subevent.location: Home entrance, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Tidying up her older sister’s room
subevent.description: In the morning, at Sun Yuwei's home, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan began tidying up the bedroom where her older sister Sun Yutong had lived. The two took off the sheets and quilt covers and put them into the washing machine, put the books and magazines scattered on the floor back in place, and wiped down the desk and wardrobe. When her mother held a hair clip that her sister had left behind and was briefly dazed, Sun Yuwei noticed and said with a smile that her sister was very forgetful, then took the clip and put it safely in a drawer. The room was tidied up and looked as clean as before.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District - Sun Yutong's room at home

subevent.name: Comforting mother and suggesting looking through the family photo album.
subevent.description: In the evening, after tidying up, her mother Li Xiulan sat on the sofa staring blankly out the window, feeling down. Sun Yuwei noticed her mother's sadness, walked over and sat beside her, and softly said that her sister would be back soon, perhaps even during the May Day holiday. To distract her mother, Yuwei suggested they look through the family photo album together that evening and recall the happy times the family had shared. Her mother's eyes lit up, she nodded, and got up to brew two cups of hot tea in the kitchen.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - sofa in the living room at home

subevent.name: Looking through the family photo album together.
subevent.description: In the evening, in the living room of their Kunming home, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan sat side by side on the sofa with three thick family photo albums spread out in front of them. Sipping tea, the mother and daughter flipped through the albums. Pointing at one old photo after another, the mother told the stories behind them—photos of Sun Yuwei and her sister as children at Green Lake Park, the family's trip to Dali, and more. Sun Yuwei listened attentively, asking questions from time to time. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious, and her mother's melancholy completely faded. The two talked late into the night before going back to their own rooms.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Column piece 'Morning on Wenlin Street' praised by editor; article fee increased.
description: On June 1, Sun Yuwei submitted her column article “Morning on Wenlin Street.” After reviewing it, editor Xu Mingyuan, impressed by its keen observation and rich details, sent a WeChat message on June 6 praising her “remarkable progress” and raised the payment to 350 yuan per 1,000 characters.

subevent.name: Submit the column manuscript to editor Xu Mingyuan
subevent.description: After finishing the manuscript, Sun Yuwei sent the column piece "Morning on Wenlin Street" by email to Xu Mingyuan, an editor at Cultural Horizons, along with a brief greeting and notes on the writing.

subevent.name: Editor Xu Mingyuan reviews the manuscript
subevent.description: Editor Xu Mingyuan carefully reviewed Sun Yuwei's column draft "Morning on Wenlin Street" in his study at his Beijing home. Finding it observant and rich in detail, he decided to praise it and raise the rate to 350 yuan per 1,000 characters.

subevent.name: Received the editor's praise and a notice of an increased manuscript fee.
subevent.description: Editor Xu Mingyuan contacted Sun Yuwei via WeChat, praised the significant progress in her column piece 'Morning on Wenlin Street,' and informed her that the payment rate would be raised from 300 yuan to 350 yuan per 1,000 characters. Sun Yuwei received the message at home in Kunming, replied to thank the editor for the recognition, and expressed her intention to keep working hard.

name: Wrote the first column article, “Morning and Dusk on Wenlin Street”
description: On the morning of February 17, Sun Yuwei went to Wenlin Street to observe and gather inspiration. After returning home, she wrote and revised repeatedly, finalizing the manuscript late at night. On the morning of the 18th, she submitted the manuscript to editor Xu Mingyuan. The editor quickly replied, suggesting only two wording adjustments. Sun Yuwei made the changes immediately and submitted it again, greatly encouraged.

subevent.name: Morning sketching and observation on Wenlin Street
subevent.description: At six in the morning on February 17, Sun Yuwei went alone to Wenlin Street in Kunming, strolling and observing the early-morning scene: elderly people exercising, shops opening one after another, and subtle changes in the street. Combining the old street stories she had heard earlier from Qin Mingyuan, the bookstore owner, she absorbed the changes in the streets and lanes with her heart and gathered first-hand material for her column.

subevent.name: Focus on writing and repeatedly revising the draft
subevent.description: After the fieldwork, Sun Yuwei returned to the study at home and focused on writing the first essay of 'Slices of Kunming', 'Mornings and Evenings on Wenlin Street'. She depicted what she saw and felt with delicate strokes, but during the writing process she was dissatisfied with the style and structure several times, scrapped the draft and started over, revising and polishing repeatedly, engaging in intense creation from morning until evening.

subevent.name: Finalized late at night
subevent.description: Late on the night of February 17, after a whole day of multiple revisions, Sun Yuwei finally finalized the content of “Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street.” She checked the full text with satisfaction and, after confirming there were no mistakes, saved the document and decided to submit it the next day.

subevent.name: Submit the manuscript to the editor
subevent.description: On the morning of February 18, Sun Yuwei emailed the finalized Morning and Dusk on Wenlin Street to Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Horizons magazine, and told the editor via WeChat that the manuscript had been submitted and was awaiting feedback.

subevent.name: Received the editor’s revision suggestions and adjusted accordingly
subevent.description: Soon after submission, editor Xu Mingyuan replied via WeChat, affirming the manuscript and only suggesting adjustments to two word choices. Sun Yuwei immediately revised it accordingly and resubmitted the final version. Receiving the editor's quick approval greatly encouraged her.

name: Had a debate with her mother about writing topics, and they ultimately understood each other.
description: On the evening of September 12, Sun Yuwei had a two-hour debate with her mother at home about whether she should turn to weightier historical and cultural themes. Her mother believed her writing could handle more substantial subjects, but she insisted on capturing the breath of everyday city life. The debate ended with her mother conceding: “Your pen, your decision.” This deep exchange helped the mother and daughter better understand each other's expectations and concerns.

subevent.name: Debate with her mother over writing topics
subevent.description: After her mother raised the topic, Sun Yuwei and her mother had a two-hour debate at home over “whether she should shift to more serious historical and cultural subjects.” Her mother thought her writing could take on weightier themes, while Sun insisted on writing about the breath of everyday urban life. Both expressed their views, and the atmosphere was warm and respectful.
subevent.location: Kunming City - home living room (123 Renmin Middle Road)

subevent.name: The mother gave in and they reached a mutual understanding.
subevent.description: After two hours of debate, her mother Li Xiulan finally conceded and said, "Your pen, your decision," expressing respect for her daughter's choice. Mother and daughter thus came to better understand each other's expectations and concerns, and their relationship grew closer.
subevent.location: Kunming City - home living room (123 Renmin Middle Road)

name: Came up with the idea of seasonal tidying and planned a decluttering checklist
description: On April 23, continuous rainy weather made Sun Yuwei feel her wardrobe was crowded. She first had the idea of tidying up in the afternoon, in the evening browsed articles on minimalist living to plan categories, and at night wrote a detailed decluttering checklist in her journal. After reviewing and polishing it late at night, she pasted the list on the inside of the wardrobe and officially decided to practice minimalism.

subevent.name: Had the urge to tidy up.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 23, while tidying her desk in the bedroom of her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei felt gloomy because of the continuous rainy weather. When she opened the wardrobe and found clothes piled up and crowded, she suddenly had the idea of doing a seasonal tidy-up and reducing her possessions, and decided to plan it carefully in the evening.

subevent.name: Collecting materials and brainstorming.
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei sat in the home study, browsing articles and community posts about minimalist living on her phone for inspiration, and preliminarily conceived in her mind the categories of clothing to deal with (such as off-season clothes, old clothes not worn for years, etc.).

subevent.name: Listed a load-lightening checklist in the journal
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei took out her beloved journal, sat at her desk, and, according to the categories she had conceived during the day, wrote down the specific decluttering tasks one by one, including: storing away winter clothes, donating or discarding unworn T-shirts and jeans, and clearing out outdated accessories, forming a detailed “decluttering checklist”.

subevent.name: Organize and post the list
subevent.description: Late at night, Sun Yuwei checked the decluttering checklist to make sure nothing was missed, decorated the page in her journal with colored pens, then tore out the page and stuck it on the inside of the wardrobe as a clear reminder of the actions to take the next day, officially deciding to embrace a minimalist lifestyle.

name: Learn basic personal finance knowledge and try small-scale systematic fund investing
description: On August 25, after a video call with her cousin Shen Wei to ask about insurance planning, Sun Yuwei was inspired to start systematically learning about personal finance. She read several introductory articles on finance and opened a regular fund investment account on Alipay, automatically investing 200 yuan each month into a low-risk bond fund. Although the amount was small, it marked her shift from conservative money management to active financial management.

subevent.name: Video-called my cousin to ask for advice on insurance planning.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei had a WeChat video call with her cousin Shen Wei, who works in Hangzhou, and consulted in detail about personal insurance planning, including the selection of medical insurance and critical illness insurance and the budget. Shen Wei patiently answered and recommended several entry-level insurance products. Sun Yuwei carefully noted the key points. This exchange inspired her to systematically learn about personal finance.

subevent.name: Read introductory personal finance articles.
subevent.description: After the video call with Shen Wei ended, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk in the bedroom and used her phone to search for and read several introductory personal finance articles, covering basic concepts such as fund types, regular investment strategies, and risk control. She focused on learning the features of bond funds and took summary notes in her notebook, laying a theoretical foundation for future practice.

subevent.name: Opened a recurring investment account and set up a regular investment plan.
subevent.description: After learning the basics, Sun Yuwei opened a regular fund investment account in the Alipay app. After comparing and screening, she chose a low-risk bond fund and set up a plan to invest 200 yuan per month. She carefully read the agreement terms, confirmed, and completed the setup. This move marked her financial mindset shifting from conservative to proactive management.

name: Walked and talked with my father by Green Lake.
description: On the evening of October 9, Sun Yuwei went for a walk in Cuihu Park with her father, Sun Mingyuan. The two strolled slowly along the lake, and her father asked about her recent writing and submissions, encouraging her to keep creating. He also shared amusing stories from his days working at the Cultural Bureau. Yuwei felt her father's quiet affection. They chatted for nearly an hour on a lakeside bench, with moonlight shining on the lake—a warm atmosphere.

subevent.name: Went out with my father to Cuihu Lake.
subevent.description: At around 6 p.m., Sun Yuwei and her father Sun Mingyuan set out from their home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, and walked to the nearby Green Lake Park. Walking along the familiar streets, her father asked about her recent studies, and Sun Yuwei answered briefly; the atmosphere was relaxed.
subevent.location: From Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, to Cuihu Park

subevent.name: Walk with Dad along Green Lake.
subevent.description: After arriving at Green Lake Park, Sun Yuwei strolled slowly along the lakeside path with her father Sun Mingyuan. The late autumn evening scenery at Green Lake was pleasant, with the lake sparkling and egrets occasionally flying past. As they walked, her father shared amusing stories from his days working at the Cultural Bureau; Yuwei listened quietly, responding occasionally, and felt a relaxed side of her father. The walk lasted about 30 minutes.

subevent.name: Having a heart-to-heart talk on a lakeside bench
subevent.description: After the walk, the two sat down on a lakeside bench to rest. Her father asked Sun Yuwei in detail about her recent submission to Cultural Vision magazine and her writing progress. Sun Yuwei truthfully said she was writing an essay about the old streets of Kunming and mentioned the creative block she had hit. After hearing this, her father encouraged her to keep writing and not to rush for success, and shared how he had handled work pressure when he was young. The two chatted under the moonlight for nearly an hour, in a warm and natural atmosphere, and Yuwei felt warmth and support in her heart.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Lakeside bench at Green Lake Park

subevent.name: Returned home after a walk with her father
subevent.description: After the heart-to-heart talk, it was getting late. Sun Yuwei and her father got up and walked back home along the same route. On the way, they talked about the weekend family dinner plans, and her father reminded her to add clothes as the weather was turning colder. After arriving home, Yuwei said goodnight to her father, then went back to her own room to organize her thoughts from today's walk, preparing to use them as writing material.
subevent.location: Kunming - Green Lake Park to 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District

name: Digital painting attempts and the turn to journal sticker creation.
description: Between July and August, Sun Yuwei spent weekends learning basic digital painting courses on Bilibili, practicing about 2-3 hours per week. She found herself slow to master layers and color management, and her creative efficiency was far lower than with hand drawing. In late July, she adjusted her goal: she gave up the expectation of becoming an illustrator and instead used the drawing tablet to make simple stickers and cover images for her journal. In early August, she successfully designed her first set of 'Grass and Trees' series stickers; after printing and pasting them into her journal, she felt relaxed and satisfied. This experience helped her better understand her creative boundaries and preferences.

subevent.name: Study the basic digital painting course.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei spent weekends at her home in Kunming following a basic digital painting course through Bilibili videos. She practiced about 2-3 hours each week, mainly learning basic techniques such as layer management and color control, and painted using a newly purchased drawing tablet. Because she was unfamiliar with the software, her creative efficiency was far lower than hand drawing, and her progress was rather slow.

subevent.name: Learn the basics of digital painting for the first time.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei opened a digital painting basics course video she had saved on Bilibili on the computer in her study at her home in Kunming, followed the tutorial to install and become familiar with the basic interface of painting software (such as Procreate or Photoshop), and tried using her newly purchased graphics tablet to draw simple lines and shapes. Since she was not yet skilled with digital painting tools, her operations were somewhat clumsy, and it took about 2 hours.

subevent.name: Learn layer management techniques.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei studied digital painting layer management in her home study in Kunming on Saturday afternoon. Through Bilibili course videos, she learned how to create, merge, and adjust layer order, and use layer masks for non-destructive editing. She practiced drawing simple geometric shapes on her graphics tablet, tried coloring in separate layers, and practiced for about 2.5 hours, gaining a preliminary grasp of basic layer usage.

subevent.name: Comprehensive drawing practice and summary
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei practiced digital painting comprehensively in her home study in Kunming on a Sunday afternoon. Referring to the last lesson of a Bilibili course, she chose a landscape photo to copy, comprehensively applying layer management, color control, and drawing tablet pen pressure techniques. After completing the work, she compared it with her hand-drawn draft, recorded insights on using the software, and organized her study notes. The whole practice process took about 2 hours.

subevent.name: Adjusting the creative direction
subevent.description: After three weeks of learning digital painting, Sun Yuwei realized that she was slow to master layers and color management and that it was hard to reach the level of an illustrator. After reflecting carefully at home in Kunming that day, she decided to give up the expectation of becoming an illustrator and instead use her existing drawing tablet to make simple stickers and cover images for her journal, adjusting her creative goal toward something practical and easy to achieve.

subevent.name: Designed and completed the "Plants and Trees" sticker series.
subevent.description: At home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei used her drawing tablet to create the first set of 'Grass and Trees' series stickers, including simple patterns such as leaves, vines, and grass. After completing the designs with drawing software, she printed the stickers onto self-adhesive paper using the home printer connected to her computer, then cut them out and pasted them into her journal. Seeing the finished products made her feel relaxed and satisfied, and this experience helped her better understand her creative boundaries and preferences.

name: Yoga sharing from the Hangzhou trip: preparation, morning practice, and review
description: On May 7, 2025, Sun Yuwei organized her travel yoga gear at home in Kunming. From May 8 to 12, she did morning yoga by West Lake in Hangzhou every early morning, practiced a variety of poses, took photos, and posted them on Xiaohongshu with the caption "Poetry and faraway places," receiving many likes. After returning to Kunming on May 13, she organized her yoga notes and published a summary post.

subevent.name: Preparing yoga gear before the trip
subevent.description: At her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei organized her travel yoga gear, including a foldable yoga mat, comfortable sportswear, and a phone stand. She downloaded a guided morning yoga audio and prepared for her daily morning practice during the Hangzhou trip from May 8 to 12.
subevent.location: Home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Morning yoga by West Lake on May 8.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei did morning yoga at 6:30 a.m. by West Lake in Hangzhou. She chose a quiet lakeside platform and practiced postures such as Mountain Pose and Tree Pose, focusing on her breath and feeling the humid West Lake air merge with nature. Afterward, she took photos and posted them on Xiaohongshu with the caption “Poetry and the Faraway,” and received many likes.
subevent.location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province - by West Lake

subevent.name: Morning yoga by the West Lake on May 9
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei practiced morning yoga by the West Lake in Hangzhou, doing poses such as Warrior Pose and Cat-Cow Pose in the morning mist. She recorded the moment and shared it on Xiaohongshu, continuing the theme of mind and body cultivating together with the landscape.
subevent.location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province - by West Lake

subevent.name: Morning yoga by West Lake on May 10
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei did morning yoga by West Lake in Hangzhou. With the lakeside birdsong and breeze, she practiced balancing postures and breathing techniques, then took photos and posted them on Xiaohongshu to share her healthy travel lifestyle with her fans.
subevent.location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province - by West Lake

subevent.name: Morning yoga by West Lake on May 11
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei practiced morning yoga at 6:30 by West Lake in Hangzhou, doing Sun Salutations in the morning sun and feeling the connection between body and nature. She recorded a short video, added a caption, and posted it on Xiaohongshu, receiving a lot of engagement.
subevent.location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province - by West Lake

subevent.name: Morning yoga by West Lake on May 12
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei did the final morning yoga of this trip by West Lake in Hangzhou, practicing seated meditation and stretching, reviewing the five days of practice, taking photos as souvenirs, and posting on Xiaohongshu, summing up the "poetry and distance" journey.
subevent.location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province - by West Lake

subevent.name: Organizing yoga records after the trip
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei returned to her home in Kunming, organized the yoga photos and videos taken during the trip, selected the best material and edited it into a series collection, wrote down her reflections, and posted a summary on Xiaohongshu, reflecting on the experience of five days of morning yoga and inner cultivation amid mountains and waters.
subevent.location: Home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: First reunion after graduation with college roommate Zhao Xiaowen.
description: On the afternoon of July 12, Sun Yuwei met her college roommate Zhao Xiaowen, who was also in Kunming, at the Old Place Cafe on Nanqiang Street. The two recalled the tension of their graduation defense and their promise to reunite every June. Zhao Xiaowen gave her a hand-drawn photo album she had made herself as a graduation gift. They talked about their current lives, encouraged each other, and strengthened a friendship that extended beyond campus.

subevent.name: Prepare and confirm the gathering.
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei prepared at home for her afternoon get-together with Zhao Xiaowen. She picked out a comfortable dress and took a signed copy of her own essay collection from the bookshelf as a return gift. At the same time, she used WeChat to confirm with Zhao Xiaowen that they would meet at Old Place Cafe on Nanqiang Street at 3 p.m.

subevent.name: Meeting with Zhao Xiaowen at a café
subevent.description: At 3 p.m., Sun Yuwei met Zhao Xiaowen at the Old Place Café on Nanqiang Street. They ordered their favorite drinks and recalled the tense moment of their thesis defense and the promise to reunite every June. Zhao Xiaowen gave Sun Yuwei a hand-painted photo album filled with photos and handwritten blessings from their four years of college; Sun Yuwei gave Zhao Xiaowen a copy of her essay collection. They talked about their current lives: Zhao Xiaowen was interning at a publishing house, while Sun Yuwei continued freelance writing and her studies. They encouraged each other and their friendship grew stronger.
subevent.location: Kunming - Old Place Cafe on Nanqiang Street

subevent.name: Returned home after the gathering.
subevent.description: Around 6 p.m., Sun Yuwei and Zhao Xiaowen reluctantly parted outside the cafe and agreed to meet again next time. Sun Yuwei walked home, savoring today's warm gathering. After arriving home, she carefully stored the hand-painted album and recorded this unforgettable first meeting in her journal.

name: Received an unexpected writing payment and donated it to the Independent Bookstore Alliance Fund.
description: Early in the morning of October 20, 2025, Sun Yuwei checked her mobile banking in her bedroom at home and confirmed receipt of an 800 yuan contribution fee from Literary News. She then immediately went to the living room and donated the full 800 yuan through the mobile donation page to the Independent Bookstore Alliance Fund, choosing to donate anonymously and adding the note ‘Support independent bookstores’. The entire process was completed before breakfast.

subevent.name: Check the notification that the manuscript fee has arrived.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 20, 2025, Sun Yuwei woke up in her bedroom at home and habitually opened her mobile banking app, only to find that the 800 yuan contribution fee from the Literature Gazette had arrived. She carefully checked the transfer record and remarks, confirming that this money was the fee for an old article that had been accepted last month on the recommendation of editor Xu Mingyuan.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Donated the full amount to the Independent Bookstore Alliance Fund.
subevent.description: After Sun Yuwei confirmed the manuscript fee had arrived, she immediately opened the donation page for the Independent Bookstore Alliance Fund on her phone and donated the full 800 yuan in manuscript fees she had just received. She chose to donate anonymously and left the words “Support independent bookstores” in the remarks field. The entire donation was completed before breakfast and took about five minutes.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Advanced yoga: successfully completed a headstand without the wall
description: During the evening yoga class on October 15, encouraged by He Lu, Sun Yuwei tried a headstand away from the wall for the first time. She took a deep breath, tightened her core, slowly lifted her legs, and held it successfully for three seconds before toppling sideways. She tried three times in a row; although the falls were clumsy, on the last attempt she stayed steady for five full seconds. He Lu smiled and helped her up, saying, 'This is a brave exploration! Next you can practice the slow-lift headstand.' This breakthrough greatly boosted her confidence in yoga.

subevent.name: Going to the yoga studio
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei rode a shared bicycle to Kunming Jingxin Yoga Life Center, silently reciting the key points of the headstand in her mind along the way, feeling both expectant and nervous.

subevent.name: First attempt at a headstand away from the wall
subevent.description: Encouraged by He Lu, Sun Yuwei moved to the center of the classroom, took a deep breath, tightened her core, and slowly lifted her legs to try a headstand away from the wall. The first two attempts ended with her falling sideways after holding for three seconds, with He Lu standing by to spot and guide her. On the third attempt, she adjusted her center of gravity and successfully held the position for five seconds before slowly lowering down.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: After-class communication and confidence building
subevent.description: After class, He Lu smiled and helped Sun Yuwei up, praised her for exploring bravely, and suggested that she try practicing a slow lift into a headstand next. Sun Yuwei was deeply encouraged and felt her confidence in yoga greatly increase. The two agreed to continue advanced practice next week.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

name: First yoga meditation experience and planning
description: On February 9, Sun Yuwei signed up for the meditation special experience class at Jingxin Yoga Studio through the WeChat official account. On February 10, she went to the yoga studio to attend the class. Under the guidance of instructor Zhao Lihua, she tried seated meditation for the first time and experienced the inner peace that came from focusing on her breath. After the class, she found her shoulders and neck relaxed. After returning home, she recorded her feelings in her journal and resolved to keep practicing. On February 11, she further developed a meditation plan: download a guiding app, join a check-in community, set a fixed weekly practice time, and tell her friends so they could supervise each other.

subevent.name: Sign up for a meditation trial class
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, at home, checked the details of the meditation special experience class through the Jingxin Yoga Life Studio's WeChat official account, filled in the registration information, paid the course fee online, and confirmed the spot and class time (February 10 at 3 p.m.).

subevent.name: Going to the yoga studio
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei changed into her yoga clothes ahead of time, brought her water bottle and towel, and walked 15 minutes from home (No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming) to Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio, arriving at 2:45 p.m. She checked in at the front desk and received a meditation mat.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Attended a meditation trial class.
subevent.description: Under the guidance of yoga instructor Zhao Lihua, Sun Yuwei and 12 other students sat in a circle in the meditation room. Teacher Zhao first explained the meditation breathing technique, then guided everyone to sit quietly with their eyes closed for 5 minutes. Sun Yuwei's mind was full of distracting thoughts at first, but she gradually focused on her breath and experienced a brief sense of inner calm. After class, she shared her feelings with Teacher Zhao and noticed that her shoulders and neck were noticeably relaxed.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Post-Class Notes and Reflection
subevent.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei recorded her feelings from the meditation trial class in detail in her journal in the study, including the mental fluctuations during sitting meditation and the bodily sensation of relaxed shoulders and neck. She also wrote down her resolution: “Incorporate meditation into daily practice, at least twice a week, 10 minutes each time.” At the same time, she set a reminder in her phone's memo app.

subevent.name: Developing a meditation practice plan
subevent.description: Based on what she gained from the trial class, Sun Yuwei searched on her smartphone and downloaded a guided meditation audio app (such as "Tide"), joined an online meditation check-in community, set Tuesday and Saturday afternoons as fixed meditation time, and told her yoga partner He Lu, agreeing to keep each other accountable.

name: Organized mother's old photos and discussed the National Day family portrait plan with my sister via video call.
description: On May 5, unable to reunite with her mother on Mother's Day, Sun Yuwei spent the afternoon alone in her study at her home in Kunming, sorting through her mother's old photos, making a digital album, and planning a Republic-style family portrait. In the evening, she video-called her older sister Sun Yutong, who was in Shenzhen, via WeChat. Together they looked through the photos and recalled the past, chose a Republic-style photo studio, agreed to take the family portrait during the National Day holiday, and decided to save up separately to share the cost.

subevent.name: Organizing Mother's photos and drafting the plan.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 5, Sun Yuwei was alone in her study at home in Kunming, selecting old photos of her mother from over the years from the photo album, including family group photos and personal candid shots, and carefully organized them into a digital album to display in a video. At the same time, she preliminarily thought about the budget range, style preference (leaning toward the Republic of China style), and possible locations for taking a family portrait during the National Day holiday, fully preparing for the video discussion with her sister in the evening.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Video-called her older sister to discuss the family portrait plan
subevent.description: On the evening of May 5, Sun Yuwei connected with her elder sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen, through a WeChat video call. The two felt guilty for not being able to go home together for Mother's Day, so Sun Yuwei showed the old photos of their mother that she had sorted out that afternoon. The sisters looked through them and recalled warm memories. Later, they discussed the plan to take a make-up family portrait for their mother during the National Day holiday, and finally chose a well-reviewed Republic-era style photo studio as the location, agreeing to fulfill this wish during the National Day holiday (early October 2025). To show their sincerity, the sisters decided to start saving for the cost separately from now on and share the expenses. The whole video call lasted about an hour and a half, with a warm and expectant atmosphere.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: Took part in the Xishan hiking activity in Kunming.
description: On Saturday, April 17, Sun Yuwei and her yoga partner He Lu took part in a hiking activity in Xishan, Kunming, covering about 8 kilometers in total. Along the way, they breathed fresh air and enjoyed the spring mountain scenery. On the platform at the summit, the two also improvised a few yoga poses, feeling the harmony of body, mind, and nature. This outdoor activity gave her a sense of exhilaration from exercise, and she decided to do a similar activity once a week from then on.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: At 7 a.m. on April 17, Sun Yuwei packed her hiking gear in her bedroom at home, checking and bringing hiking shoes, sportswear, a water bottle, snacks, sunscreen, and a portable yoga mat. She confirmed the meeting time and place with her yoga partner He Lu via WeChat (at the entrance of the Xishan Scenic Area Visitor Center, 8:30 a.m.), and checked the day's weather forecast (sunny, 20–25°C) to ensure suitable conditions for the outdoor activity.
subevent.location: Home bedroom in Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Heading to Xishan Scenic Area
subevent.description: At 7:45 a.m., Sun Yuwei left home, walked to a nearby bus stop, and took Bus C62 to Xishan Forest Park. She arrived at the Xishan Scenic Area Visitor Center around 8:20 and met He Lu, who had been waiting there. The two talked briefly at the entrance. He Lu shared the latest hiking route information she had gathered and reminded Yuwei to stay hydrated.
subevent.location: Kunming - Xishan Forest Park Visitor Center

subevent.name: Went hiking in the Western Hills.
subevent.description: At 8:40 a.m., Sun Yuwei and He Lu started hiking from the trailhead of the Nie Er Tomb trail on the Western Hills, covering about 8 kilometers in total. Along the way, they climbed up stone steps, passed ancient temples such as Huating Temple and Taihua Temple, and briefly stopped in front of the Longmen Grottoes to enjoy the panoramic view of Dianchi Lake. Breathing the fresh mountain air and taking in the green spring forest scenery, they chatted about their recent lives and yoga practice experiences as they hiked, in a relaxed and cheerful atmosphere.
subevent.location: Kunming – Xishan Forest Park Hiking Trail

subevent.name: Rest and replenishment along the way
subevent.description: At around 10 a.m., the two reached a viewing platform halfway up the Western Hills and decided to rest there for 15 minutes. They sat on a bench, took out the water and fruit they had brought with them (Sun Yuwei had brought apples and mineral water; He Lu had brought energy bars and sports drinks) to replenish their energy. He Lu also taught Yuwei a simple set of shoulder and neck stretches to help relieve the muscle tension built up during the hike. After resting, they continued climbing upward.
subevent.location: Kunming - halfway viewing platform at Xishan Forest Park

subevent.name: Hilltop platform yoga session.
subevent.description: At 11:15 a.m., the two successfully reached an open platform near Lingxu Pavilion on Xishan. From there, they could overlook downtown Kunming and the full panorama of Dianchi Lake. They spread out their yoga mats and improvised several yoga poses in the breeze, including Tree Pose, Warrior I, Triangle Pose, and a simple partner balancing pose. He Lu, as a coach, guided Yuwei to adjust her breathing and posture. The session lasted about 20 minutes and helped them both deeply feel the integration of body, mind, and nature.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Xishan Forest Park, Lingxu Pavilion summit platform

subevent.name: Hiking down the mountain
subevent.description: Around noon, after finishing yoga, the two began to slowly descend the mountain along another trail. On the way down, they passed the Maomaoqing Reservoir and enjoyed the tranquil scenery of the mountain reservoir. At the fork in the path, they chose the gentler route to avoid pressure on their knees, while also noticing wildflowers and plants along the roadside. He Lu introduced Yuwei to several common plateau plants. At about 1:15 p.m., the two arrived at the exit of Chama Flower Street at the foot of the Western Hills.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Xishan Forest Park downhill trail to Tea Horse Flower Street

subevent.name: Meal and sharing after the hike
subevent.description: At 1:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei and He Lu found a vegetarian restaurant near Tea Horse Flower Street and had lunch. While eating Yunnan-style crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, they reviewed the day's hiking experience. Yuwei said this outdoor activity made her feel an unprecedented sense of exhilaration and relaxation, closer to nature than her usual yoga studio practice. They also agreed to try another hiking route around Kunming together next Saturday. After the meal, around 3 p.m., they each took a ride home.
subevent.location: Kunming City – Xishan Tea Horse Flower Street Vegetarian Restaurant

subevent.name: Create a weekly outdoor activity plan
subevent.description: After returning home in the late afternoon, around 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei took out her journal and recorded today's hiking reflections—experiencing the exhilarating feeling of exercise and deciding to do a similar activity once a week from now on. She flipped open the calendar and, based on her academic and writing schedule, planned to meet He Lu again next Saturday, April 24, for an outdoor hike or bike ride, and listed several alternative routes around Kunming and the equipment needed. She also measured her heart rate recovery data and recorded it in her fitness log.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Nutrition clinic visit and weight-gain plan implementation
description: In response to the February physical examination showing she was underweight and sometimes fatigued, Sun Yuwei completed her pre-clinic preparations on the evening of July 24. On the morning of July 25, from 9:00 to 10:00, she went to the nutrition clinic at the First People's Hospital of Kunming, received a personalized weight-gain meal plan, and consulted on details. That day, she returned home, bought a smart body-fat scale, took the first measurement, and set reminders. On July 26, she officially adjusted her eating according to the meal plan, logged her diet and body-fat data, and resolved to manage her weight scientifically.

subevent.name: Pre-clinic preparation
subevent.description: The night before her appointment, Sun Yuwei confirmed the outpatient appointment at the Nutrition Department of the First People's Hospital of Kunming, scheduled for July 25 from 9:00 to 10:00 in the morning, through the hospital's official app. She also organized her recent eating habits, daily activity level, and key information from the February physical examination report, such as being underweight and often feeling fatigued, into a brief checklist to present to the doctor. She also checked that she had all the necessary ID documents and previous physical exam reports.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Nutrition Clinic Visit
subevent.description: On July 25, 2025, from 9:00 to 10:00 a.m., Sun Yuwei arrived on time at the nutrition department outpatient clinic of Kunming First People's Hospital as scheduled. In the consultation room, she described in detail to the attending physician of the nutrition department that she was underweight and often felt fatigued in daily life, and presented her physical examination report from February. The doctor performed a body composition analysis and a basic physical examination, then formulated a personalized weight-gain diet plan based on her age, height, weight, activity level, and eating habits, with emphasis on increasing intake of eggs, dairy, nuts, red meat, and healthy fats, and recommended light strength training three times a week. Sun Yuwei carefully recorded every suggestion from the doctor and asked about details in the diet plan (such as cooking methods and substitute ingredients), which the doctor answered one by one.
subevent.location: Nutrition Clinic, Kunming First People's Hospital, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Bought a smart body fat scale
subevent.description: After the clinic appointment ended, Sun Yuwei returned home and ordered a smart body fat scale on an e-commerce platform (delivered the same day). When it arrived in the evening, she unboxed it immediately, connected it to the health management app on her phone according to the instructions, and completed her first measurement (baseline data such as weight, body fat percentage, and muscle mass) as the initial baseline for future tracking. She also set a weekly automatic measurement reminder and was determined to manage her weight scientifically.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Start the weight-gain meal plan.
subevent.description: On July 26, 2025, Sun Yuwei began adjusting her daily diet according to the weight-gain meal plan provided by the nutrition department doctor. For breakfast she added 250ml of whole milk and a boiled egg; for lunch and dinner she added a palm-sized portion of red meat (such as beef or lamb) each, plus a small handful of mixed nuts as a snack. She also asked her mother Li Xiulan to buy healthy fats such as rapeseed oil and walnuts, and after dinner recorded the day's food diary and body-fat scale data, determined to stick with the plan.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District - home kitchen

name: Lost the journal and got it back
description: On the afternoon of April 6, Sun Yuwei walked in Green Lake Park and recorded her inspirations; in the evening, while taking bus No. 5 home, she accidentally left her journal on the bus. After realizing it, she returned to the station to look for it but failed, and was so upset that she couldn't sleep that night. The next day (April 7), she reviewed the journal contents from memory and wrote the essay "The Lost Page Numbers." On the morning of April 8, a kind citizen, Zhao Ming, contacted her using the contact information on the flyleaf and returned the journal intact. After recovering it, she solemnly wrote down her reflections.

subevent.name: Walked in Green Lake Park and recorded inspiration.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei went alone to Green Lake Park in Kunming for a walk. Sitting on a lakeside bench, she used her portable journal to record essay inspiration, yoga insights, and unpublished short poems from the past three months. After writing, she put the journal back into her crossbody bag.
subevent.location: Kunming - lakeside bench at Green Lake Park

subevent.name: Left the journal on the bus
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei took Bus No. 5 from Green Lake Park to go home. After boarding at Cuihu North Road Station, she sat in a window seat. Because the window was open, the wind loosened the clasp of her crossbody bag. When she stood up to get off, the journal accidentally slipped out of the bag into the gap between the seats. She didn't notice and left the bus.
subevent.location: On Kunming's No. 5 bus (Cuihu North Road to Renmin Middle Road).

subevent.name: After realizing it was lost, returned to the station to search for it but to no avail
subevent.description: When Sun Yuwei walked to her door and took out her keys, she found the buckle of her crossbody bag open and her journal missing. She immediately ran back to the Renmin Middle Road bus stop, searched repeatedly around the platform and along the sidewalks, and asked for help at the station's police booth. But the bus dispatch office said the bus had already returned to the depot and could not be searched immediately. Dejected, she went home empty-handed.
subevent.location: Kunming - Wuhua District Renmin Middle Road Bus Stop and surrounding areas

subevent.name: She was so upset about losing her journal that she couldn't sleep.
subevent.description: At night, Sun Yuwei returned to her bedroom at home, repeatedly blaming herself for being careless. Worried that the three months of essay inspiration, yoga insights, and unpublished short poems in her journal would be lost forever, she tossed and turned in bed, barely falling asleep until the early morning.
subevent.location: Kunming City - No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District - bedroom in Sun Yuwei's home

subevent.name: Reviewed and wrote the essay "The Lost Page Numbers".
subevent.description: The next day, Sun Yuwei sat at the desk in her home study, trying hard to recall the key contents of her journal. She jotted down the essay inspirations, yoga insights, and short poem ideas she could remember in a new notebook, and used these as material to write an essay titled "The Lost Pages," published on her personal social media platform, expressing her reflections on cherished things.
subevent.location: Kunming - 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District - Sun Yuwei's home study

subevent.name: A kind citizen contacted and returned the journal.
subevent.description: In the early morning, Sun Yuwei received a call from a citizen who called himself Zhao Ming. He said he had found a journal on the bus the night before and contacted her using the phone number written on the flyleaf. The two agreed to meet at the entrance of the residential complex where Sun Yuwei lives. At around 8:30, Zhao Ming returned the intact journal to her in person. Sun Yuwei thanked him excitedly and treated him to a bowl of crossing-the-bridge rice noodles as a token of gratitude.
subevent.location: Kunming – entrance of the residential compound at 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District

name: Received advance payment for the prose collection publication
description: On December 10, Sun Yuwei received the first advance payment of 8,000 yuan stipulated in the publication contract for Slow Travel Notes. After confirming it on her mobile banking app, she excitedly recorded the income in her journal and planned to use 3,000 yuan of it for red envelopes for her parents during Spring Festival and a New Year travel fund, putting the rest into a fixed-term savings account to practice prudent financial management.

subevent.name: Confirm receipt on mobile banking
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei logged into mobile banking in her home study, checked her account balance, confirmed that she had received the 8,000 yuan advance payment remitted by the publisher of "Slow Travel Notes," and verified the transaction record and amount.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Record income in the journal.
subevent.description: In her study, Sun Yuwei took out her beloved journal and neatly wrote in pen that she had received the first advance payment of 8,000 yuan for 'Slow Travel Notes' today, along with a few lines of her excitement and thoughts.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Planning fund allocation
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei continued writing her fund allocation plan in her journal: 3,000 yuan for red envelopes to her parents for Spring Festival and a New Year travel fund, and the remaining 5,000 yuan would go into a fixed deposit account. She noted that she planned to visit the bank soon to handle it.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Discovered the offline writing group [Ink and Breath] and completed registration
description: On September 13, while browsing Douban city events in the study of her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei found a recruitment post for the writing group 'Ink and Breath.' Attracted by its philosophy of 'honest writing and face-to-face feedback,' she decided to sign up. She then filled out and submitted the application form and waited for the review notice.

subevent.name: Browsing Douban local events
subevent.description: On the morning of September 13, 2025, Sun Yuwei opened the Douban app in her study at home in Kunming and browsed the Kunming local events section, looking for cultural and artistic activities that interested her. She noticed a recruitment post for an offline writing group called "Ink and Breath" with the title "In Kunming, Let Us Breathe with Our Pen Tips — Offline Writing Group Recruitment." Curious, she clicked to view the details.

subevent.name: Read the recruitment post and was moved by it.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei carefully read the recruitment post for the Ink and Breath writing group. The post included the group's philosophy: sincere writing, face-to-face feedback, and gatherings every Saturday afternoon at an independent bookstore; and the activity format: each session includes writing exercises and a peer critique session. She was deeply attracted by this pure, deeply communicative writing atmosphere and felt it highly matched her needs as a student of Chinese literature and a freelance writer, and she felt a strong urge to sign up.

subevent.name: Decide to sign up and fill in the registration form.
subevent.description: After reading the recruitment post, Sun Yuwei made up her mind to sign up. She clicked the registration link in the post, entered the online registration form, and carefully filled in her name, age, occupation, writing experience, and reason for joining (expressing her desire to communicate with like-minded writers and improve her writing level). Before confirming submission, she checked again that the content was complete.

subevent.name: Submitted the registration application and waited for confirmation
subevent.description: After filling in the form, Sun Yuwei clicked the submit button and successfully submitted her registration. The page showed "Registration successful, please wait for review notice." She breathed a sigh of relief and felt full of anticipation, planning to keep an eye on phone messages or email notifications over the next few days, hoping to join the writing group smoothly.

name: Email exchange with advisor Professor Wu about the manuscript.
description: On October 13, Sun Yuwei compiled the editor's feedback on her submission of 'Slow Travel Notes' and her own revision ideas into an email and sent it to her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan. Two days later, Professor Wu replied, not only affirming the progress of the manuscript, but also proposing specific structural adjustments in response to the editor's suggestions, and recommending a reference book. Yuwei was deeply inspired and wrote in her reply: 'Thank you, Professor. Your words give me more direction.'

subevent.name: Compile and send the manuscript exchange email.
subevent.description: In her home study, Sun Yuwei organized the editor's feedback on the submission of 'Slow Travel Notes' and her own revision ideas into a detailed email, and sent it via email to Professor Wu Mingyuan, her advisor in the School of Chinese Language and Literature at Yunnan University.

subevent.name: Checked Professor Wu's reply email.
subevent.description: In the study at home, Sun Yuwei received an email reply from her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan. In the email, Professor Wu affirmed the progress of the manuscript, gave specific opinions on restructuring in response to the editor's suggestions, and recommended a reference book. Sun Yuwei read the email carefully and was deeply inspired.

subevent.name: Reply to thank-you email
subevent.description: After reading Professor Wu's reply, Sun Yuwei immediately wrote a thank-you email, saying she was deeply inspired and wrote, "Thank you, professor. Your words have given me more direction." She then sent the email to Professor Wu Mingyuan.

name: Third session of the pottery workshop: underglaze painting and glazing.
description: On the afternoon of November 15, she attended her third pottery class at a ceramics studio in Wuhua District, Kunming. First, she listened to the teacher's explanation and received materials such as blue-and-white pigment and transparent glaze. Then, using the blue-and-white pigment, she painted simple lines on the cup body and wrote the word 'Breathe,' and added blue dots to the earrings and pendant as embellishments. Finally, she learned glazing methods such as dip glazing and spray glazing, evenly applied transparent glaze to all her pieces, and set them aside to dry before firing.

subevent.name: Pre-class preparation and material pickup.
subevent.description: Before the third class at the pottery workshop, Sun Yuwei listened to the teacher explain key points of underglaze painting and glazing, and received blue-and-white pigment, transparent glaze, brushes, and bisque-fired cup blanks and earring pendant blanks.
subevent.location: A pottery studio in Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Underglaze painting: drawing lines and lettering
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used blue-and-white pigment to paint simple line patterns on the surface of the cup blank, and wrote the two characters 'Breath' on the cup body, completing the main underglaze painting design of the cup.
subevent.location: A pottery studio in Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Earring and pendant ornament: accented with blue dots.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used blue-and-white ceramic pigment to dot blue circles on the earring and pendant blanks, completing the underglaze painted decoration on the small pieces.
subevent.location: A pottery studio in Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Learning glazing and applying transparent glaze.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei learned glazing methods such as dipping and spraying, then evenly applied clear glaze to the cup body, earrings, and pendant, completing the glazing process for all pieces and leaving them to dry before firing.
subevent.location: A pottery studio in Wuhua District, Kunming

name: An attempt at a cultural and creative collaboration with my cousin: from mailing paper to sample feedback
description: On August 18, Sun Yuwei received a package of handmade paper sent by her cousin Shen Wei and sorted it out; that evening the two had a video call, and Shen Wei suggested combining paper and text to create a cultural and creative brand. Yuwei agreed and decided to make sample sheets. On August 19, Yuwei handmade letter paper and sticky note samples. On August 21, she sent photos of the samples to Shen Wei for feedback; they discussed revisions and agreed on the next steps.

subevent.name: Receive and inspect the specialty paper package.
subevent.description: At her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei received a heavy cardboard box sent by her cousin Shen Wei from Hangzhou. After unpacking it, she examined the more than ten kinds of regional handmade paper inside, including mulberry bark paper, flower-and-grass paper, and silk paper. She sorted them by paper type and texture, and arranged them neatly on the study desk in the study for later use in making her journal.

subevent.name: Video call with cousin to discuss the cultural and creative collaboration proposal
subevent.description: That evening, Sun Yuwei and her cousin Shen Wei had a video call on WeChat and shared updates on their lives. Shen Wei suggested combining these distinctive handmade papers with Yuwei's writing to design letter paper or sticky notes, and jointly create a niche cultural and creative brand. Yuwei readily agreed, and decided to first handcraft several sample sheets to test the effect before planning the brand details in depth.

subevent.name: Handmade first batch of sample sheets
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei followed the design plan, choosing mulberry bark paper and flower-and-plant paper as materials, and used a brush pen to write her prose excerpts. She paired them with decorative elements such as dried flowers and stickers, and handmade 3 types of letter paper and 2 sticky note samples. After finishing, she photographed the samples and prepared to send them to her cousin Shen Wei for feedback.

subevent.name: Exchange feedback on sample pages with cousin and adjust plans
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei sent photos of the completed samples to her cousin Shen Wei via WeChat. Shen Wei highly praised one flower-and-plant paper sticky note and one mulberry-bark paper letter sheet, while also suggesting adjustments to the text layout and size. The two discussed the revision details via WeChat voice calls, preliminarily determined the improvement direction for the next batch of samples, and agreed to communicate about the next step of cooperation in a week.

name: Process old-age insurance and basic medical insurance for flexible employment personnel
description: On the morning of September 1, 2025, Sun Yuwei prepared her ID card, household registration booklet and other materials at home, then went to the Wuhua District Social Security Center. Following her older female cousin's suggestion, she planned to enroll in flexible-employment pension insurance and basic medical insurance. After taking a queue number at the center, a window staff member guided her through filling out the enrollment registration form. She provided photocopies of her documents and chose a contribution base, successfully completing enrollment and receiving a receipt. After returning home, she used her phone to send photos of the on-site procedures and the receipt to the family WeChat group. Her father Sun Mingyuan saw them and replied, 'You've grown up and learned to take care of things,' expressing relief at her independence.

subevent.name: Preparing the required materials
subevent.description: On the morning of September 1, 2025, Sun Yuwei organized at home all the materials needed for applying for old-age insurance and medical insurance for flexible employment, including her personal ID card and the original household registration booklet, placed them in a document folder, and planned to go to the Wuhua District Social Security Center.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

subevent.name: Complete insurance registration at the Social Security Center
subevent.description: After arriving at the Wuhua District Social Security Center, Sun Yuwei took a number and waited. At the counter, she explained her intention to the staff, then received and filled out the registration forms for flexible-employment pension insurance and basic medical insurance. The staff guided her in completing the relevant information. She provided copies of her ID card and household registration booklet, completed procedures such as choosing the contribution base, and finally succeeded in processing, obtaining a receipt.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - Social Security Center Service Hall

subevent.name: Shared the processing result with the family.
subevent.description: After finishing the process, Sun Yuwei returned home and used her phone to send photos of the on-site procedure and the receipt slip to the family WeChat group. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, saw them and replied in the group, 'You've grown up and learned to take care of things,' expressing his relief and recognition of his daughter's independent handling of social security matters.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

name: Completion of the first draft of the graduation thesis and in-depth study of spatial theory
description: On April 1, Sun Yuwei completed the first draft of her graduation thesis and submitted it to her advisor. On April 2, she received the advisor’s annotations pointing out that the theoretical depth was insufficient and suggesting that she add spatial theory. From April 3 to 9, she spent a week systematically studying the works of spatial theorists such as Lefebvre and Foucault in the library, taking dense notes to give the thesis theoretical support.

subevent.name: Submitted the first draft of the graduation thesis
subevent.description: On the morning of April 1, Sun Yuwei submitted the completed graduation thesis draft, in both paper and electronic form, to her advisor Wu Mingyuan at the School of Liberal Arts of Yunnan University, and briefly reported the overall framework and main arguments of the thesis.
subevent.location: Kunming - School of Liberal Arts, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Received the advisor’s comments and discussed the direction for revisions.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 2, Sun Yuwei received a marked-up draft sent back by email from her advisor Wu Mingyuan, who noted that the paper lacked theoretical depth and suggested adding spatial theory. She then went to her advisor's office to talk in person. Teacher Wu explained in detail how spatial theory supports the paper's topic, and recommended core works by Lefebvre and Foucault.
subevent.location: Kunming - School of Liberal Arts, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Study Lefebvre's works on spatial theory.
subevent.description: From April 3 to 4, Sun Yuwei intensively studied the chapters related to spatial theory in Lefebvre's The Production of Space and Critique of Everyday Life at the Yunnan University Library from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. each day, recording key concepts, core arguments, and personal thoughts in a new notebook.

subevent.name: Reading literature on Foucault's theory of space and power
subevent.description: From April 5 to 6, Sun Yuwei focused on studying at the Yunnan University library the chapters on spatial discipline in Foucault's "Discipline and Punish" and the related discussions of spatial metaphors in "The Order of Things." She also consulted several applied research papers by domestic scholars on Foucault's spatial theory and supplemented her notes.

subevent.name: Integrate other spatial theories and take systematic notes
subevent.description: From April 7 to 9, Sun Yuwei continued to consult extended literature in the library, including Edward Soja's Thirdspace theory and David Harvey's historical-geographical materialism. She systematically organized the reading notes from the previous four days, reintegrated them according to the structure of her thesis arguments, and marked quotable passages and theoretical intersections.

name: Attended an online writing sharing session and exchanged experiences
description: On the evening of November 11, Sun Yuwei participated in an online sharing session for young writers organized by the Yunnan Writers' Association via Tencent Meeting. She listened to three young writers share their creative insights, and afterward proactively exchanged contact information with one of them to discuss the polishing of prose language.

subevent.name: Attended an online writing sharing session
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei participated in the entire online sharing session for young writers organized by the Yunnan Provincial Writers’ Association via Tencent Meeting. She listened carefully as three young writers shared their creative insights on the topics of novel structure, poetic imagery, and genuine emotion in essays, and recorded key viewpoints and sentences that moved her in her electronic notes.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: After the meeting, exchanged contact information with the writer
subevent.description: After the sharing session ended, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to privately message one of the young writers skilled in prose writing, Chen Ruoyun, in the Tencent Meeting chat area to ask for details on polishing prose language. The two added each other on WeChat and agreed to further exchange writing insights through WeChat.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Taking stock of manuscript fees and rewarding myself.
description: On January 3, in her study at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei counted her income from manuscript fees last year, which totaled 82,000 yuan, and decided to deposit 2,000 yuan every month as a travel fund. The same day, she researched and compared mirrorless cameras. On January 4, based on her research, she ordered a Fujifilm X-T30 II mirrorless camera on JD.com as a reward to herself, providing equipment support for her creation and exploration in the new year.

subevent.name: Review of writing income
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, in the study of her home in Kunming, organized her full-year 2024 freelance writing income through online banking and WeChat records, verified that her total writing fees came to 82,000 yuan, and recorded it in her personal financial ledger.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home study

subevent.name: Made a travel fund plan
subevent.description: Based on her manuscript fee income, Sun Yuwei decided to set aside 2,000 yuan from her royalties each month as a travel fund, specifically for future cultural trips. She planned the savings goal and intended use in her notebook, and considered setting up automatic transfer.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home study

subevent.name: Research mirrorless camera information.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, in her home study in Kunming, used her laptop to browse major e-commerce platforms and photography forums, comparing mirrorless cameras of different brands and models (such as Sony, Canon, and Fujifilm), selected a few models that met her budget and needs, and read user reviews.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home study

subevent.name: Buy a mirrorless camera
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, based on the previous day's research, placed an order on JD.com for a Fujifilm X-T30 II mirrorless camera (with a kit lens), paid by bank card, and completed the purchase as a reward for herself. Expected delivery in 2-3 days.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home study

name: Attend an online new media writing workshop.
description: On September 21, Sun Yuwei prepared in her home study for the upcoming online new media writing workshop. From September 22 to 24, she officially took part in the online workshop hosted by a well-known Chinese writing platform, themed “Advanced Techniques for Nonfiction Writing.” Over the three days, she studied modules such as story structure and reader engagement, completed two writing exercises, and received feedback from instructors. Finally, she organized her notes into her journal and planned to apply them to her future column writing.

subevent.name: Pre-workshop class preparation
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei prepared in her home study for the upcoming online new-media writing workshop, including checking the computer's network connection, downloading the learning platform software, previewing the workshop outline materials, and preparing her journal and pen for taking notes.

subevent.name: Attend Day 1 of the workshop: Story Structure module
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei logged into the writing platform in her home study and attended the first day of the online new media writing workshop. She studied the story structure module of nonfiction writing, including techniques such as character development and plot design, and completed an in-class thinking exercise, recording the key points in her journal.

subevent.name: Attend the second-day workshop: reader interaction and first practice.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei continued participating in the online workshop from her home study, learning modules such as reader interaction and emotional resonance. Afterward, she completed her first writing exercise based on what she had learned, submitted it to the platform for mentor feedback, and organized the day's key notes in her journal.

subevent.name: Attend the third day workshop: second practice and closing organization
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei attended the final day of the online workshop from her home study, completed and submitted the second writing exercise, collected the instructor's feedback on both exercises, systematically organized all three days of notes into her journal, summarized the key methodologies, and accumulated material for her upcoming column writing.

name: Wrote the essay Fragments, posted on Xiaohongshu, and replied to reader comments.
description: On the morning of December 13, Sun Yuwei walked from home to Mingyuan Bookstore. At her work station, using a cracked phone screen as a starting point, she wrote a short essay titled “Shards” and took photos of the shattered light reflections as accompanying images. She then edited the article and images and published them to her Xiaohongshu account “Yuwei’s Slow Record.” Within hours of posting, she replied one by one at home to readers who shared their own broken-screen stories, interacting with them.

subevent.name: Went to Mingyuan Bookstore to write.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 13, Sun Yuwei walked from home to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, planning to write essays at her familiar seat.

subevent.name: Write the essay "Fragments"
subevent.description: On the morning of December 13, at her workstation in Mingyuan Bookstore, Sun Yuwei, using the accidental shattering of her phone screen as a starting point, wrote a short essay titled 'Fragments,' reflecting on the fragility of digital life and the memories and creativity carried by screens.

subevent.name: Take supporting photos
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used her phone to take a photo of fractured light and shadow as an illustration for her essay "Fragments".

subevent.name: Publish a Xiaohongshu note
subevent.description: After editing her essay “Fragments” and the accompanying images, Sun Yuwei published it on her Xiaohongshu account “Yuwei Manlu,” with the title and body text completed.

subevent.name: Replying to reader comments and interacting.
subevent.description: Within a few hours of publishing, Sun Yuwei received nearly a hundred comments on Xiaohongshu, with readers sharing their own cracked-screen stories. She replied to each comment and interacted with readers.

name: Writing a book proposal for publishing the essay collection.
description: From September 29 to 30, Sun Yuwei prepared for the publication of “Slow Travel Notes” by writing a detailed book proposal, including a content summary, target readers, market analysis, and marketing suggestions. She referred to two similar essay collections recommended by Qin Mingyuan and consulted her advisor Wu Mingyuan for opinions, finally producing a 5-page document, ready to be submitted together with the sample copy.

subevent.name: Get reference books.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei went to Mingyuan Bookstore to meet the owner, Qin Mingyuan, and picked up the two similar essay collections he recommended, Jiangnan Sketches and Small-Town Scenes, in preparation for writing a book proposal. She also browsed parts of the books in the store and used her notebook to record the key structure and writing style.

subevent.name: Read reference books and take notes
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei returned to her home study and carefully read the two reference essay collections she had brought back from Mingyuan Bookstore, focusing on analyzing their content structure, target reader positioning, and market selling points. She noted down key passages and writing ideas in her notebook, accumulating material for the market analysis section of the proposal.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

subevent.name: Consulting advisor Wu Mingyuan for advice
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei contacted her advisor Wu Mingyuan via WeChat to ask for advice on the focus of the content summary and target reader positioning in the proposal for "Slow Travel Notes." Wu Mingyuan gave suggestions via voice call, recommending that she highlight the work's cultural travel perspective and local characteristics, and reminding her to pay attention to the timeliness of market analysis data. The call lasted about 40 minutes.

subevent.name: Wrote the first draft of the topic proposal.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei began writing the publication proposal for 'Slow Travel Notes' on her computer. Based on the previous day's notes and her advisor's suggestions, she completed in order the sections on content summary, target reader analysis, market comparison of similar books, and marketing and promotion suggestions. By noon, she had completed about three pages, and the structure was basically taking shape.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

subevent.name: Revise the final draft and export the document.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei repeatedly revised the draft proposal, focusing on polishing the language, adjusting the layout and formatting, and adding specific marketing channel recommendations. The final version was a complete 5-page PDF document saved on her computer, which she planned to submit to the publisher together with the sample copy.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Search for skin care information in Kunming
description: On the morning of March 16, Sun Yuwei used her free time to search for professional skin care clinics in Kunming on Dianping and Xiaohongshu. She checked the services, reviews, and prices of different shops, shortlisted a few studios that interested her, and planned to research them further later.

subevent.name: Search for skin care information in Kunming
subevent.description: On the morning of March 16, Sun Yuwei used her free time to search for professional skin care clinics in Kunming on Dianping and Xiaohongshu. She checked the services, reviews, and prices of different shops, shortlisted a few studios that interested her, and planned to research them further later.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - Yunnan University Library

name: Attended an anthropology lecture and wrote a commentary that earned her supervisor's praise
description: On the afternoon of October 23, Sun Yuwei went to Yunnan University to attend the anthropology lecture “The Poetry of Everyday Life.” The speaker shared poetic moments from fieldwork in border villages. She sat in the back row and took five full pages of rapid notes.
