That evening, back at her residence, she organized a commentary titled “Seeing Poetry in the Field” and published it on her personal WeChat official account “Yuwei's Slow Notes.” The next day, her advisor, Professor Wu, reposted it on Moments with the comment: “This is the best student I've taught at breathing with words.” This was a great encouragement to her.

subevent.name: Attend the anthropology lecture 'The Poetry of Everyday Life'
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 23, Sun Yuwei went to the lecture hall of the School of Literature at Yunnan University to attend the anthropology lecture "The Poetry of Everyday Life" given by an invited scholar. She sat in the back row, listening attentively and taking rapid notes throughout, completing five full pages of shorthand notes that covered the speaker's examples of poetic moments in fieldwork in borderland villages.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Lecture Hall, School of Literature, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Organize lecture notes and write a review to publish on the official account
subevent.description: That evening, Sun Yuwei returned to her home on Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming. In the study, she organized and summarized five pages of lecture shorthand notes, and combining her own thoughts, wrote a commentary article titled 'Seeing Poetry in the Field'. After revising and typesetting, she published it on her personal WeChat official account 'Yuwei Slow Record' and shared it to her Moments and dormitory group chat.

subevent.name: Received praise and encouragement from mentor Wu Mingyuan
subevent.description: On October 24, her advisor Wu Mingyuan saw the article Sun Yuwei posted on his WeChat Moments, then reposted it and commented: 'This is the student I have taught who knows best how to breathe life into words.' Deeply encouraged when she saw the comment, Sun Yuwei replied with a thank-you comment and had a brief exchange with Teacher Wu on WeChat. Teacher Wu encouraged her to continue with her field-writing style.
subevent.location: Kunming City, Yunnan Province - Online (WeChat Moments)

name: Took a group photo in hanfu at the graduation ceremony and agreed with roommates to meet up annually.
description: On June 14, Sun Yuwei and her roommates Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen went to Changshui Airport to pick up Zhou Lin, who had come from Shenzhen, and the four were reunited. On June 15, at the graduation ceremony, the four wore Hanfu, took commemorative photos around the campus, and agreed in front of the library to meet every June.

subevent.name: Roommate Zhou Lin arrives in Kunming
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, along with roommates Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen, went to Kunming Changshui Airport to welcome Zhou Lin, who had come all the way from Shenzhen to attend the graduation ceremony. The four hugged warmly after meeting, then took the metro back to the Yunnan University dormitory, sharing updates and final preparations before graduation on the way.

subevent.name: Preparing hanfu for the graduation ceremony
subevent.description: On the morning of June 15, 2025, Sun Yuwei and her three roommates, Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin, put on the Hanfu they had prepared in advance in the Yunnan University dormitory, helped each other with makeup, arranged hair buns and accessories. The four excitedly discussed the upcoming graduation ceremony process and took selfies with their phones in the dormitory to remember the moment.

subevent.name: Attend the graduation ceremony.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and three roommates dressed in hanfu went to the Yunnan University gymnasium to attend the Class of 2025 graduation ceremony. During the ceremony, the four of them sat next to one another throughout, listening to the president’s address, receiving their degrees, and taking photos with other classmates. The atmosphere was warm and moving.

subevent.name: Group photo in Hanfu on campus as a memento.
subevent.description: After the graduation ceremony, Sun Yuwei and her roommates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin, all four wearing hanfu, went to iconic spots on campus one after another, including the library, the front of the teaching building, and the cherry blossom path, and took photos in various poses. They took turns shooting with a DSLR camera and their phones, recording the final youthful days of college, a process filled with laughter and tears.
subevent.location: Kunming–Yunnan University campus (library, classroom buildings, cherry blossom path)

subevent.name: Schedule the Annual Gathering
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei and her three roommates sat in a circle on the square in front of the Yunnan University library, reminiscing about the moments of the past four years. The four of them made a solemn pact: every June from now on, they would set everything aside and meet once, taking turns choosing the location among their respective cities (Kunming, Chengdu, Shenzhen, and Hangzhou). They made a pinky promise to seal the deal and took a group photo to record the commitment.
subevent.location: Kunming City - square in front of Yunnan University Library

name: Evening walk with parents by Cuihu Lake, listening to old stories and gathering creative inspiration
description: Starting from August 15, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents almost every evening for walks around Green Lake. In the evening breeze and lotus fragrance, her parents gradually told stories about their youth: how they met at Green Lake Photo Studio, the twists and turns of the educated youth returning home, and other past events. She recorded these precious stories in her material notebook, intending to use them as the core content of her next essay collection, "Folds of Time". This habit lasted until the end of the month and became the warmest daily routine of the family.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents for a walk at Green Lake and listening to old memories (Week 1)
subevent.description: Starting from August 15, Sun Yuwei accompanied her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan to Green Lake Park in Kunming for an evening walk every day. In the evening breeze and lotus fragrance, her parents gradually recounted memories from their youth, such as how they met at the Green Lake Photo Studio and the twists and turns of returning to their hometown as educated youth. Sun Yuwei recorded these precious stories in the notebook she carried with her, accumulating material for her essay collection "Folds of Time." During that week, the walks lasted about an hour every evening, and after finishing, the three of them went home together, becoming a warm family routine.

subevent.name: First day accompanying parents for a walk at Green Lake
subevent.description: In the early evening, Sun Yuwei accompanied her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan on a walk to Green Lake Park in Kunming. On the stone path by the lake, the family chatted as they strolled. Her parents talked about how they met when they were young at the Green Lake Photo Studio. Sun Yuwei listened carefully and took out the notebook she carried with her to record key details, gathering material for her prose collection 'Folds of Time.' After about an hour of walking, the three returned home along the familiar path, enjoying warm family time.

subevent.name: The next day, accompany her parents for a walk around Cuihu Lake.
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei accompanied her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan on their second visit to Cuihu Park for a walk. In the afterglow of the sunset, her parents continued recounting the ups and downs of returning home as educated youth. Sun Yuwei listened while jotting down key time points and character details in her notebook, occasionally asking questions to gain a more complete account. After the walk, the three headed home together, and on the way her mother mentioned an amusing story about Sun Yuwei playing in the park as a child.

subevent.name: On the third day, accompanied her parents for a walk around Cuihu Lake.
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents for a third walk in Cuihu Park. That night, her father Sun Mingyuan talked about his struggle to pass the exam for a public institution job when he was young, and her mother Li Xiulan added memories of the two of them running the family together after marriage. Sun Yuwei wrote down this oral history in her notebook, and after the walk used her phone to record her immediate thoughts. As usual, the three of them walked around the lake once and then went home.

subevent.name: Day 4: Accompanied parents for a walk around Green Lake
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents on their fourth visit to Green Lake Park for a walk. That day, her mother Li Xiulan told the complete story of coming from Qujing to Kunming to study and meeting her father, and her father added romantic details about how he pursued her mother. Sun Yuwei recorded it all in detail in her notebook and asked about some life details during the walk so she could faithfully recreate them in future essays. An hour later, the three returned home, and on the way her father bought flower cakes from a street stall for the family to taste.

subevent.name: Day 5: Accompanying parents for a walk at Green Lake
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents on their fifth walk to Cuihu Park. Her parents recalled several major family events, including funny stories about Sun Yuwei and her older sister Sun Yutong growing up, and the family’s experience of moving to a new home. Sun Yuwei recorded these stories on a timeline in her notebook and realized that this material was especially valuable for the family chapter of her essay collection Folds of Time. After the walk, the three went home, and her mother suggested going out for mushroom hotpot on the weekend.

subevent.name: Day 6: accompanied her parents for a walk around Green Lake.
subevent.description: At dusk, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents for the sixth time on a walk in Cuihu Park. Tonight's theme focused on the Green Lake Photo Studio where her parents first met and the look of Kunming in those days. Her parents described in detail the streets, snacks, and ways of life of old Kunming. Sun Yuwei recorded what she saw and heard in her material notebook in diary form, connecting it with her own childhood memories. After an hour of walking, they returned home, and Sun Yuwei marked today's notes separately as a section titled 'City Memories'.

subevent.name: Day 7: accompanied her parents for a walk around Cuihu Lake.
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents on the week's final stroll around Green Lake. Her parents summarized all the stories they had told over the week and shared their hopes for the family's future. On the last page of her material notebook, Sun Yuwei sketched Green Lake Park and wrote the opening inspiration for 'Folds of Time.' After the walk, the three of them had a cup of tea at an old teahouse by the lake, bringing the week's warm family activities to a perfect close.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents on a walk around Green Lake and listening to their old stories (week 2)
subevent.description: Continuing the daily evening walk with her parents in Cuihu Park. The past events her parents recounted became richer and more detailed, including the specifics of life during the sent-down youth period and family building after returning to the city. Sun Yuwei continued to note things down in her material notebook and began planning the chapter structure of her essay collection. The three of them shared their thoughts as they walked, and the family atmosphere was harmonious.

subevent.name: Eighth family walk at Green Lake
subevent.description: At 17:30 in the evening, she went out with her parents (her elder sister stayed home to rest from the flight). Her father began telling stories of his youth as an educated youth working on a farm in the border region, including building reservoirs and planting rubber trees. Her mother added details about the material shortages and the difficulties of communication back then. Sun Yuwei sat down on a lakeside bench and quickly jotted down key time points and people's feelings in her notebook, trying to connect the stories in her mind with the family-memories chapter of her essay collection. After about an hour and a half, they returned, buying fresh vegetables at the market on the way.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents for a walk at Cuihu and listening to old stories (day two)
subevent.description: At 18:00 in the evening, Sun Yuwei went out for a walk with her parents as usual. Today her father continued recalling how, after returning to the city, he passed an exam and entered the Cultural Bureau, and he took them to the side of Green Lake near the Yunnan Military Academy, pointing out the corner where he used to study for the exam. Her mother shared the simple scene of how, when she got married, she only bought a new quilt and a thermos flask. Sun Yuwei was moved by her parents' vivid accounts, and in her material notebook she drew a simple mind map, sorting out the thread of 'educated youth - returning to the city - starting a family.' After the walk, the three of them rested for ten minutes on a stone bench at the park entrance, watching the lotus pond in the sunset, in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents for a walk around Cuihu and listening to old stories (Day 3)
subevent.description: At 17:45 in the evening, the three of them left on time. Today's topic turned to her parents' courtship days—her father, Sun Mingyuan, shyly recalled the funny story of his first trip to Qujing to meet his mother-in-law, while her mother, Li Xiulan, smilingly added how she had helped her father iron that washed-out white shirt. Sun Yuwei listened with great interest, recording vivid details of the conversation in her journal as she walked, such as her father being so nervous that he knocked over a teacup, and her mother secretly slipping him grain coupons for emergencies. She realized that these fragments full of the flavor of daily life were exactly the flesh and blood her essay collection needed. After the walk, the family dropped by a milk tea shop by Green Lake and bought three cups of brown sugar pearl milk tea, drinking them as they walked home.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents for a walk around Green Lake and listening to past stories (Day 4)
subevent.description: At 6:10 p.m., the walk began. Her father talked about the trip to Beijing that his work unit organized in the 1980s—the shock of riding a train for the first time, staying in a guesthouse, and seeing Tiananmen Square. Her mother talked about the pressure and sense of accomplishment when she first led a graduating class as a middle school teacher. Sun Yuwei devoted a full page in her material notebook to recording "personal experience amid the changes of the times" and noted points that could be compared with the current changes in Kunming. During the walk, she actively asked her parents about prices, transportation, and modes of entertainment in that era. As her parents recalled the past, they corrected and supplemented each other, and laughter kept breaking out. After returning home, Sun Yuwei organized the day's harvest on her laptop and began to sketch the outline of the third chapter of her essay collection.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents for a walk at Cuihu Park and listening to old stories (Day 5)
subevent.description: At 17:50 in the evening, the three met as usual at the entrance of the residential community. Today, both parents happened to bring up a major family decision - the process of the eldest daughter, Sun Yutong, being hospitalized due to illness as a child and later choosing to work in Shenzhen. Her father admitted that he had initially opposed his daughter's going far away but was eventually persuaded; her mother recounted how she maintained family ties through phone calls and care packages. Sun Yuwei was deeply moved and wrote down three keywords in her material notebook: 'family, distance, support.' She also noticed many family scenes with children in Cuihu Park, which contrasted with her parents' narrative. During the walk, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to hold her mother's arm, while her father walked ahead, occasionally turning back to smile. After returning, she filed this material about 'letting go and lingering concern' in her study.

subevent.name: Accompanying my parents for a walk at Green Lake and listening to their stories of the past (Day 6).
subevent.description: At 18:05 in the evening, a light rain had just fallen, and the air was fresh. Father told stories of how he cultivated his love of writing in his youth—submitting to his workplace newspaper, buying books with overtime pay, and being appreciated by a teacher at the cultural center. Mother also shared her original reason for becoming a Chinese language teacher: she loved literature. Sun Yuwei was pleasantly surprised to discover that her interest in writing had family roots, so she opened a special "Literary Lineage" section in her notebook. When they strolled to the Fish-Watching Platform in the center of the park, the three of them stopped to watch koi competing for food. Father spontaneously talked about the first large-scale renovation of Green Lake in 1986 and pointed out where things had been back then. After returning home, Sun Yuwei backed up the recording of this conversation (with her parents' consent) to cloud storage as important material for future writing.

subevent.name: Accompany parents for a walk around Green Lake and listen to old stories (Day 7)
subevent.description: At 17:40 in the evening, it was the last walk of the week. Her parents recalled many warm moments from their marriage to the present: her father pacing outside the delivery room when Sun Yuwei was born, the whole family taking photos on the first day of her sister Sun Yutong's primary school, and the happy time when the family traveled to Dali. As she listened, Sun Yuwei wrote in her material notebook and told her parents that she had already sketched out the outline of her essay collection, planning to develop it in three parts: 'Ancestors · Roots,' 'Parents · Era,' and 'Us · Growth.' Her parents were very pleased. Her father even suggested she could write about the changes in Green Lake over the years. The three walked one and a half laps around Green Lake, and only as night fell did they slowly head home. After dinner, Sun Yuwei organized all the materials recorded during the week into an electronic document in her room, officially beginning preparation for her essay collection.

subevent.name: Accompany parents for a walk at Green Lake and listen to stories of the past (end of month)
subevent.description: For the last three days of the month, Sun Yuwei still accompanied her parents for evening walks around Green Lake, and her parents recalled more family anecdotes and reflections on life. After the walks, Sun Yuwei systematically organized her material notebook at her desk at home, marking the core story passages usable for the essay collection "Folds of Time" and writing a preliminary outline. This habit came to a fulfilling close at the end of the month and became the warmest everyday memory of the family.

subevent.name: Accompanying parents for a walk at Green Lake and organizing materials (Day 1)
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei went for a walk with her parents, Sun Mingyuan and Li Xiulan, at Green Lake Park in Kunming. Under the setting sun, her mother Li Xiulan talked about amusing stories from her youth in her hometown Qujing, while her father Sun Mingyuan shared anecdotes from his years working at the Cultural Bureau. After the walk, they returned home. At her desk, Sun Yuwei opened her notebook, categorized and marked the warm stories she had heard that evening, and wrote down fragmentary reflections, gathering material for her essay collection "Folds of Time."

subevent.name: Walking with parents at Green Lake and sorting materials (day two)
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei accompanies her parents again for a walk in Green Lake Park. A gentle breeze blows by the lake. Her mother, Li Xiulan, recalls amusing stories of her daughter learning to walk as a child, and her father, Sun Mingyuan, sighs at how quickly time passes and mentions the origins of the family's two properties. After the walk, back home, Sun Yuwei sits at her desk and further refines the passages related to family memories in her notebook, marking the narrative threads that could be used in her essay collection.

subevent.name: Walk with parents at Green Lake and complete the creation outline (Day 3).
subevent.description: On the evening of the last day of the month, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents on their final walk in Green Lake Park. Her parents recalled touching stories of family trips and the sisters’ growing up, creating a warm atmosphere. Back home, Sun Yuwei systematically organized the month’s material notebook at her desk, annotated the selected key story passages one by one, and wrote the preliminary outline for her essay collection “Folds of Time,” bringing the month’s family walking habit to a satisfying close.

name: Purchase commercial insurance and inform parents
description: During the day on September 17, 2025, Sun Yuwei completed the application procedures for commercial insurance through an online platform in her home study. In the evening, while having dinner with her parents in the dining room, she took the initiative to tell them she had bought insurance. Her father nodded and said, 'If you are self-employed, you need to take care of these things yourself,' and her mother reminded her to pay attention to her diet to manage her anemia. After dinner, on the health page of her journal, she drew a shield, wrote 'coverage activated', and recorded this protection.

subevent.name: Complete the commercial insurance purchase.
subevent.description: On September 17, 2025, during the day, Sun Yuwei completed the commercial insurance enrollment procedure through an online insurance platform or telephone consultation, including steps such as filling in personal information, selecting the insurance type, and paying the premium, thereby adding health protection for herself.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - home study

subevent.name: Informed my parents at dinner that I had purchased insurance
subevent.description: On the evening of September 17, 2025, during dinner with her parents (Sun Mingyuan, Li Xiulan) in the dining room of their Kunming home, Sun Yuwei proactively brought up that she had purchased commercial insurance and explained to her parents the basic types of insurance and the scope of coverage.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - Wuhua District - home dining room

subevent.name: Parents' response and reminders about buying insurance
subevent.description: After Sun Yuwei told her parents about the insurance purchase, her father Sun Mingyuan nodded in approval and said, “As a freelancer, you have to take care of these things yourself.” Her mother Li Xiulan reminded her to manage her anemia through diet and to make sure she got enough nutrition in daily life. Both of them supported their daughter’s initiative in planning her own insurance coverage.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - Wuhua District - home dining room

subevent.name: Record insurance information on the health page of the journal.
subevent.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to the desk in her bedroom, took out her beloved journal, drew a shield pattern on the health management page, and wrote beside it the words Protection Activated, recording this important event of completing her insurance purchase while reminding herself to pay attention to health management.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - Wuhua District - desk in the bedroom at home

name: First meeting with literary friend Yang Xiao at Cuihu Lake, talking freely for six hours about literature and life
description: On August 12, Yang Xiao, a literary friend from Chengdu with whom she had only communicated online, came to Kunming on a business trip. The two met at a teahouse by Cuihu Lake. From afternoon to evening, they walked around the lake and then sat face to face in deep conversation, talking from the novels they were each writing to writing about urban loneliness. Six hours of dialogue interwove literary resonance with the sharing of life. This first offline meeting made an online friendship take root.

subevent.name: Prepare a gift for the meeting and confirm the itinerary
subevent.description: On the morning of August 12, Sun Yuwei carefully prepared a meet-up gift at her home study, including a handmade fabric-covered journal and two boxes of Kunming's specialty flower cakes. At the same time, she confirmed the specific time and place for the afternoon meeting at Cuihu Teahouse with Yang Xiao again via WeChat.

subevent.name: Set off for the Green Lake teahouse
subevent.description: Around 12:30 noon, Sun Yuwei walked from home to the bus stop with gifts, took Bus No. 1 to Cuihu Park, and arrived at the 'Tingyuxuan' teahouse by Cuihu Lake at about 1 p.m. She arrived early and chose a seat by the lake.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City - Green Lake Park - Tingyuxuan Teahouse

subevent.name: Had an in-depth talk with Yang Xiao at a teahouse about literature and life
subevent.description: From 1:30 PM to 4:30 PM, after Yang Xiao arrived at the teahouse, the two sat facing each other by the window and talked freely. Sun Yuwei gave Yang Xiao her journal and flower cakes, while Yang Xiao gave her a limited-edition poetry collection from an independent bookstore in Chengdu. They talked about the novels they were each writing and how to depict urban loneliness, exchanged thoughts on the essays by Ryuichi Sakamoto and Shen Congwen they had recently read, and Yang Xiao shared interesting stories from the cultural circles in Chengdu. During the conversation they ordered pu'er tea and osmanthus cakes, and the atmosphere was warm and lively.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City - Green Lake Park - Tingyuxuan Teahouse

subevent.name: Walking around Green Lake and saying goodbye
subevent.description: From 16:30 to 18:30, the two walked out of the teahouse and strolled around Green Lake. Under the setting sun, the lotus pond shimmered with golden light. They chatted as they walked, topics ranging from literature to their respective city lives, families, and growing-up experiences. Sun Yuwei shared her thoughts on keeping a journal and learning ikebana, while Yang Xiao talked about her feelings on a business trip from Chengdu to Kunming. On the way to the park's north gate, they stopped at a stall in the cultural and creative market, each buying a handmade bookmark. At 19:00 in the evening, they said farewell reluctantly at the park gate, agreeing to meet in Chengdu next time.

subevent.name: Returning home to record first impressions.
subevent.description: At 7:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei returned home. She first told her mother, Li Xiulan, a few interesting stories from the meeting, then went to the study and wrote down in her journal a detailed record of her first meeting with Yang Xiao, the main points of the conversation, and her inner feelings. She decorated the page with photos of the teahouse and Cuihu Lake taken on her phone. Before going to bed, she also sent Yang Xiao a thank-you message on WeChat, and the two agreed to exchange their essay drafts later.

name: Select and purchase a million-yuan medical insurance policy
description: On the afternoon of September 17, Sun Yuwei finally chose a million-yuan medical insurance plan with an annual premium of about 300 yuan, and completed the health declaration and payment through an online link. After the insurance was successfully purchased, she printed out the electronic policy and placed it in the transparent “Important Documents” pocket of her planner.

subevent.name: Selected the product and decided to buy it
subevent.description: Based on her research, Sun Yuwei comprehensively considered the comprehensiveness of coverage and cost-effectiveness, and finally selected a certain million-yuan medical insurance product with an annual premium of about 300 yuan. She opened the online enrollment link for the product and confirmed the product details page.

subevent.name: Complete health disclosure.
subevent.description: On the insurance application page, Sun Yuwei answered the questions in the health disclosure truthfully one by one, including past medical history and recent physical examination abnormalities. After confirming there were no items that did not meet the requirements, she submitted the health disclosure information.

subevent.name: Pay the premium and complete the insurance application
subevent.description: After the health disclosure was approved, Sun Yuwei used WeChat Pay to pay about 300 yuan for the annual premium, received a text message and an email with the electronic insurance policy confirming successful coverage, and confirmed that the policy had taken effect.

subevent.name: Printed and filed the electronic insurance policy.
subevent.description: After completing the insurance application, Sun Yuwei downloaded the electronic policy file to her computer, printed a paper policy using the home printer, then folded it neatly and placed it in the transparent pocket in her journal specifically used for storing important documents.

name: Submitted two cultural travel essays to Dianchi magazine.
description: On December 8, while sorting through her manuscripts, Sun Yuwei found two essays written during her cultural trip in May and June, one about a rainy night by an old bridge in Shaoxing and one about morning mist over the tea mountains in Hangzhou; they had never been published. After polishing them again, with the feeling of a “New Year gift,” she added a brief greeting and submitted them to the literary editor’s mailbox at Dianchi magazine, hoping her words would grow on a broader platform.

subevent.name: Organize the manuscript and dig out travel essays
subevent.description: While organizing her manuscript folder in her study at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei came across two essays she had written during her cultural trip in May and June this year. One was about a rainy night at an old bridge in Shaoxing, and the other was about morning mist over the tea mountains in Hangzhou. These two drafts had been kept on her computer and never published.

subevent.name: Polish two essays again
subevent.description: In her study at her desk, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and read the two essays one by one, polishing the text, including adjusting sentence rhythm, correcting certain word choices, and refining the concluding paragraphs, so that the essays became richer in emotional expression and literary quality. The whole polishing took about two hours.

subevent.name: Write a submission email and send it to Dianchi magazine.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei opened her email on the computer, found the submission email address of the literary editor of Dianchi magazine, and with the feeling of a New Year's gift, wrote a short greeting submission email, adding the two polished essays as attachments. After confirming everything was correct, she clicked send and completed the submission.

name: Watching an independent musician's livehouse show on a whim
description: On Wednesday evening, September 30, Sun Yuwei was scrolling on her phone when she discovered that a local indie folk band was performing at Snail Livehouse, and she decided on the spur of the moment to go. In the dim lights and the plucking of guitar strings, she let go of a month’s exhaustion. After the show, she bought a signed album and brought it home to use as background music for her creative work.

subevent.name: Found performance information and decided to go.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 30, 2025, while browsing her phone at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei happened to see a notification that a local independent folk band was performing that night at Snail Livehouse. Attracted by their musical style, she decided on the spur of the moment to go watch alone. She quickly checked the show time and ticket price, confirmed that tickets were still available, and after getting ready simply, prepared to head out.

subevent.name: Depart for Snail Livehouse
subevent.description: On the evening of September 30, 2025, Sun Yuwei set out from her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, and walked or took a taxi to Snail Livehouse. She wore light, comfortable clothes and carried her phone and wallet, feeling expectant along the way.

subevent.name: Watching a performance at Snail Livehouse.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 30, 2025, Sun Yuwei arrived at Snail Livehouse in Kunming. Amid the dim lights and the plucking of guitar strings, she stood alone in the audience area enjoying the live performance of an independent folk band. The music relaxed the fatigue of the entire month; she immersed herself in it and shot a few short videos with her phone as keepsakes.

subevent.name: Buying a Signed Album
subevent.description: On the evening of September 30, 2025, after the performance, Sun Yuwei bought a signed album by the band at the merchandise area of Snail Livehouse. She briefly shared her love of the music with the band members, carefully put the album away, and planned to take it home to use as background music for her creative work.

name: Maintaining workstation order.
description: From then on, at the beginning of each month, Sun Yuwei would update the sticky notes or dried flowers on the wall, keeping her workstation neat and orderly. This corner became the main setting where she efficiently produced essay drafts and column articles until the end of the year. In her journal she wrote: 'This tiny space held my flow.'

subevent.name: Initial setup and tidying of the workstation
subevent.description: On July 4, 2025, Sun Yuwei gave her desk workstation a thorough makeover: she put up newly purchased sticky notes with essay excerpts, replaced the dried flowers, and cleared away desktop clutter, creating a clean, orderly, and inspiring environment for her upcoming long-term writing. She saw this as the starting point for maintaining a flow state.

subevent.name: Workstation update in early August.
subevent.description: On August 1, following her habit at the start of each month, Sun Yuwei replaced the writing notes on her wall (writing down new monthly writing goals) and swapped out last season's dried flowers, keeping her workspace visually fresh. She took photos to record it and made brief notes in her journal, believing this sense of ritual helped maintain her creative rhythm.

subevent.name: Early October workspace update
subevent.description: On October 1, Sun Yuwei put up National Day-related motivational slogans and a red maple leaf bookmark on the wall above her workstation as decoration, and replaced the dried flowers with warm-colored daisies. She tidied up the scattered manuscripts and restored the desktop to neatness, so that she could focus on completing a commissioned column during the National Day holiday.

subevent.name: Desk update in early November
subevent.description: On November 1, following her monthly habit, Sun Yuwei replaced the sticky notes on the wall, wrote out by hand a quote from Haruki Murakami, and added dried eucalyptus leaves as winter decoration. She checked the desk lamp and chair to ensure comfort for long writing sessions, and recorded the month's writing plan in her journal.

subevent.name: Early December workspace refresh and year-end tidying up
subevent.description: On December 1, Sun Yuwei performed her last workstation maintenance of the year. She cleared away old sticky notes, replaced them with New Year cards and winter pinecone decorations, swapped dried flowers for silver willow branches, and archived the sticky notes used throughout the year. She took a photo as a keepsake and wrote: “In this little corner, I have held on to my flow.”

subevent.name: Doing long-form writing at the workstation
subevent.description: From late July to late November, Sun Yuwei continued her writing work at the desk in her home study in Kunming, completing drafts of two articles for the "Cultural Horizon" column and drafts of the first three chapters of the essay collection, showing an efficient and focused creative state.

subevent.name: Completed the first draft of her first column article
subevent.description: At her desk at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei opened the topic document for “Cultural Horizons” on her laptop and, following the outline she had previously made, wrote the first draft of a column article about the cultural changes in Kunming’s old streets and lanes. She referred to the interview notes and photos at hand, adjusting the structure as she wrote. After about four hours of focused writing, she completed the draft and saved it to the folder for later revision.

subevent.name: Completed the first draft of the first chapter of the essay collection.
subevent.description: At her desk in the study at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei opened the writing plan file for her essay collection and focused on writing the first draft of the first chapter, "Childhood at Green Lake." Based on the materials and journal entries she had accumulated, she recalled her childhood impressions of Green Lake Park and used delicate prose to depict the changing seasons, personal interactions, and her own feelings. After writing for 3-4 hours each day for 3 consecutive days, she completed a draft of about 5,000 characters for the entire chapter on the evening of August 15.

subevent.name: Completed and submitted the second column article.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, at her desk in the study of her home in Kunming, wrote a column article about the cultural tradition of Yunnan crossing-the-bridge rice noodles based on the topic assigned by editor Xu Mingyuan. She consulted materials, recalled family dinner scenes, and incorporated her own understanding of food aesthetics to write an article of about 2,000 characters. Upon completion, she emailed it to Editor Xu with a note on revisions.

subevent.name: Finish the first draft of Chapter 2 of the essay collection.
subevent.description: At her desk in the study at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei continued writing her essay collection. The theme of the second chapter is 'The Scent of Books on Campus,' depicting her reading experiences in libraries and independent bookstores during college. She reread notes on several books that had deeply influenced her and incorporated her reflections into the essay. The writing process lasted a week, with 2-3 hours each day, and she completed the first draft on the afternoon of October 20.

subevent.name: Complete the first draft of Chapter 3 of the essay collection
subevent.description: At her desk in the study of her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei wrote Chapter 3 of her essay collection, 'The Meaning of Travel.' The chapter looked back at moments from several trips in the past few years, including a volunteer trip to Dali and a cultural tour of Hangzhou. She paged through photos and journal entries from her travels, carefully recreating the scents, sounds, and human warmth of different cities. After several rounds of revision, she completed the first draft of the chapter in the evening of November 20.

name: Received a letter of intent for a publishing contract and shared it with her sister over a video call.
description: On the morning of December 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei received an email at her home study in Kunming indicating a publishing contract intention for her new book. After reading it carefully, she took a screenshot and saved it. The next evening (December 6), she showed the screenshot to her elder sister Sun Yutong via WeChat video in her bedroom, explaining the terms and publication plan in detail. Her sister clapped excitedly and promised to buy 100 copies to give to friends and family once the book was released, encouraging her younger sister to focus on writing. The call lasted over an hour, leaving Yuwei deeply warmed and empowered.

subevent.name: Received an expression of intent for a publishing contract.
subevent.description: On the morning of Friday, December 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei received an email in her home study from the publishing house, containing a formal letter of intent for a new book publishing contract. After reading the email repeatedly and confirming the details of the terms, she was filled with excitement and gratitude. She immediately took a screenshot and saved it, planning to share the good news with her elder sister Sun Yutong the next day.
subevent.location: Study at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Shared the good news about publication with her older sister via video call
subevent.description: On the evening of December 6, 2025, Sun Yuwei used her laptop in her bedroom at her home in Kunming to have a WeChat video call with her older sister Sun Yutong, who was far away in Shenzhen. She showed her sister a screenshot of the publishing contract email she had received the day before, and described in detail the signing process and the subsequent publication plan. On the other end of the screen, her sister clapped her hands and praised her excitedly. The two chatted for more than an hour about the new book's content, promotional ideas, and future writing directions. Sun Yutong promised that when the new book was released, she would buy 100 copies out of her own pocket to give to colleagues and friends, and encouraged her younger sister to stay focused on her writing. After the call, Sun Yuwei felt warm and empowered, and became even more determined on her writing path.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming City - Wuhua District - bedroom at home.

name: Collaborated with Qin Mingyuan on a graduation-season used-book drifting event; the excellent copy was featured in cultural news.
description: From June 8 to 9, Sun Yuwei and her good friend Qin Mingyuan planned and promoted the Graduation Season Used Book Drifting event. She was responsible for writing sincere and touching copy, which was released as a warm-up on the campus official account. From June 10 to 12, the event was held on the campus of Yunnan University, attracting over 230 participants in three days and drifting more than 1,200 books. On June 13, the event was featured in the city's cultural news, and her copy was praised as "sincere and touching", which made her see the social influence of writing.

subevent.name: Event planning and copywriting
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her good friend Qin Mingyuan, in the study of her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, communicated by phone and WeChat to finalize the theme, venue layout, and participation process for the graduation-season used-book drifting event. Sun Yuwei was responsible for writing the promotional copy, using sincere writing to describe the farewells of graduation season and the meaning of passing on books, creating emotionally rich publicity text.

subevent.name: Promotional post release and warm-up
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei paired the carefully written event copy with the event poster and process description to create a promotional post, which she published simultaneously via the Yunnan University campus official account and Qin Mingyuan's Mingyuan Bookstore official account. The post spread quickly across campus, attracting widespread attention and reposts from graduates, successfully building anticipation for the event.

subevent.name: First day of the used-book crossing event
subevent.description: The event officially started at the tree-lined plaza beside the main campus road of Yunnan University. Sun Yuwei and Qin Mingyuan arrived early and set up tables, chairs, display racks, and a book-crossing area. At 9 a.m., graduates began to come one after another with their idle books to register and exchange. Sun Yuwei guided participants to write message cards and took photos to document the event. In total, more than 50 students participated during the day, and more than 200 books were collected and circulated.

subevent.name: Day 2 of the Used Book Drifting Activity
subevent.description: The event continued, and a 'Making Friends Through Books' message wall and a 'Recommended Reading List' display area were added on site. Sun Yuwei exchanged reading insights with participants at the venue and captured material for the later summary report. Due to the word-of-mouth effect of the previous day's event, the number of participants on the second day far exceeded expectations, reaching more than 100 people, and over 400 books were circulated. In the evening, she and Qin Mingyuan organized the day's data together and discussed the closing arrangements for the third day.

subevent.name: Third day and wrap-up of the used book drifting activity
subevent.description: On the last day of the event, the atmosphere was lively but tinged with the sadness of parting. In the morning, they continued receiving and exchanging books. At noon, Sun Yuwei and Qin Mingyuan together counted the total number of participants and the number of books in circulation, and handed out handwritten postcards to every participant and volunteer as souvenirs. At three in the afternoon, the event officially ended. They cleaned up the venue together, returned borrowed items, and made a preliminary summary of the event's results. About 80 people participated that day. Final statistics: more than 230 total participants over the three days, and over 1,200 books were circulated.

subevent.name: Cultural news report published.
subevent.description: After the event, a local culture reporter contacted Sun Yuwei for a phone interview. On June 13, a report titled "Graduation Season Old Book Drifting: Keeping Knowledge and Warmth Alive on Campus" was published in the Spring City Culture Daily and on its official news website. The report specifically praised the copy written by Sun Yuwei, saying it was "sincere and moving, demonstrating the cultural responsibility of the younger generation." After seeing the report at home, Sun Yuwei felt that her words had had a social impact and was deeply encouraged.

name: Received the second HPV vaccine dose and recorded the shift in health beliefs.
description: On November 11, Sun Yuwei confirmed the appointment time for her second HPV vaccine dose at home and prepared the vaccination materials. On November 12, she went to the community health service center as scheduled and received the second HPV vaccine dose. The process went smoothly, and she returned home after the observation period. That afternoon, she recorded her vaccination experience and feelings in her journal, writing, "I used to live by feeling alone; now I am learning to talk with my body," marking a new stage in her health management.

subevent.name: Confirmed the appointment for the second dose of the HPV vaccine and prepared to get vaccinated.
subevent.description: On November 11, Sun Yuwei confirmed the appointment time for the second dose of the HPV vaccine the next day at home through the community health service center's WeChat official account or by phone, looked up the vaccination precautions, and prepared her ID card and vaccination card.

subevent.name: Go to the community health service center for the second dose of the HPV vaccine
subevent.description: On the morning of November 12, Sun Yuwei went to a community health service center in Wuhua District, Kunming at the scheduled time. After arriving, she registered at the front desk and filled in her information, then completed the second HPV vaccine injection in the vaccination room. The process went smoothly.
subevent.location: A community health service center in Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Post-vaccination observation and return home
subevent.description: After completing the vaccination at the community health service center, Sun Yuwei rested in the observation area for 30 minutes as required, left after confirming no adverse reactions, and walked home.
subevent.location: A community health service center in Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, and the way home.

subevent.name: Journal and reflect on the shift in health mindset
subevent.description: That afternoon, Sun Yuwei opened her journal in her home study and wrote down her experience and feelings about getting vaccinated that day, recording the line, "I used to live by feelings, but now I am learning to communicate with my body." She marked the beginning of a new stage of actively managing her own health.

name: Afternoon tea at Guilin Bookstore with best friend Zhang Jing and notes on what came after.
description: On the afternoon of November 13, Sun Yuwei went to Guilin Bookstore near the university and met her high school best friend Zhang Jing in the coffee area. The two shared the creative journey behind the afterword 'To Yourself Five Years from Now' in her essay collection. Zhang Jing was moved and gave suggestions for journal layout. They also discussed recent reading lists and decided to sign up for a knitting workshop together in December. Outside, a fine rain was falling; inside, the atmosphere was cozy. After returning home, Sun Yuwei recorded the exchange of ideas in her journal in her study, organized the layout suggestions, and searched for information on knitting workshops in Kunming in December.

subevent.name: Go to Guilin Bookstore
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei set off from home and walked or took the bus to Guilin Bookstore near the university. On the way, she used her phone to confirm the meeting time with her best friend Zhang Jing.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Guilin Bookstore Coffee Area

subevent.name: Exchanged ideas in the coffee area of Guilin Bookstore
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei met her high school best friend Zhang Jing in the coffee area of Guilin Bookstore and chatted over coffee. Sun Yuwei shared the creative journey behind “To Myself Five Years from Now,” the afterword to her prose collection. Zhang Jing was deeply moved and offered suggestions from the perspective of journal layout. The two then discussed what they had been reading recently and decided to sign up together for a knitting workshop in December. Outside, a fine drizzle was falling; inside, warm yellow light and the aroma of coffee made the atmosphere cozy.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Guilin Bookstore Coffee Area

subevent.name: After returning home, recorded the afternoon's insights.
subevent.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei sat in her study and used her journal to record the inspiration from her afternoon conversation with Zhang Jing. She organized the layout suggestions for the journal, and then began searching on her phone or computer for information about knitting workshops in Kunming in December.

name: Received the Ikenobo ikebana certificate.
description: On October 10, 2025, after receiving the email notifying her of passing the Ikenobo flower arrangement exam, Sun Yuwei shared her joy with Su Man, a fellow flower arrangement enthusiast, via WeChat. On the afternoon of October 13, she signed for the paper certificate and put it together with her workshop completion certificate. That evening, she filed the certificate, tidied her desk, and created the watercolor painting 'Green Lake · Autumn'.

subevent.name: Share the good news with fellow flower arrangement enthusiasts
subevent.description: At noon on October 10, 2025, Sun Yuwei sent a screenshot of the pass notification via WeChat to Su Man, a friend from her flower-arranging class, and shared the joy of passing the assessment in a voice message. Su Man replied with congratulations, and the two agreed to celebrate face to face next time they practiced flower arranging together.

subevent.name: Signing for the paper certificate delivery
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 13, 2025, Sun Yuwei received the paper certificate for Ikenobo flower arrangement, delivered by a courier at her home in Wuhua District, Kunming. After signing for it, she opened the package, carefully examined the certificate's embossed pattern and signature, and after confirming it was correct, placed it together with her previous workshop completion certificate.

subevent.name: Archiving certificates, tidying the desk, and creating the watercolor "Green Lake · Autumn"
subevent.description: Before bed, she quickly filed the paper certificates and flower arrangement materials into folders, and tidied the loose stationery and floral materials on the desk to keep the study space neat. Then she completed the watercolor Green Lake · Autumn, depicting the ginkgo avenue and fallen plane tree leaves in warm golden tones, and inscribed the poem 'Ginkgo leaves fall, covering the ground with gold; autumn Green Lake mirrors the clear sky.'

name: Shared the good news with my family about reaching the travel fund goal and planned a family trip to Sanya
description: On the evening of June 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei, excited that her quarterly column bonus had arrived and her travel fund had reached 10,000 yuan, told her parents about her plan to take them to Sanya at the end of the year, and they had an initial discussion about timing, duration, and attractions. On the morning of June 6, she gathered Sanya travel guides online and marked attractions and restaurants her parents would prefer. On the afternoon of June 7, she drafted an initial five-day itinerary and asked her parents for their opinions after dinner; after adjusting based on their feedback, she finalized the basic framework.

subevent.name: Share the good news with family and have an initial discussion about travel plans.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 5, 2025, after dinner, Sun Yuwei sat in the living room with her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan and excitedly announced the good news that her column bonus had arrived and her travel fund had reached its goal. She proposed a plan to take her parents to Sanya at the end of the year, and her parents were very happy. The three of them had a preliminary discussion about the travel time (planned around Sun Yuwei’s winter vacation and her parents’ Spring Festival holiday), the approximate number of days (5–7), and the attractions they were interested in (such as Yalong Bay, Nanshan Temple, and Tianya Haijiao). Sun Yuwei said she would next prepare a detailed itinerary for everyone to consider.

subevent.name: Collecting Sanya travel information.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 6, 2025, Sun Yuwei used a laptop in her study to search online for Sanya travel guides, covering the best months to travel, popular attractions, local food, accommodation recommendations, transportation options, and budget references. She jotted down the key information in her journal and marked attractions and restaurants her parents might be interested in, preparing to make a detailed itinerary.

subevent.name: Made a preliminary travel plan and asked for parents' opinions
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 7, 2025, Sun Yuwei put together a preliminary five-day Sanya travel plan based on the information she had collected, including the daily schedule, accommodation budget, and transportation options. After dinner, she handed the printed plan to her parents Sun Mingyuan and Li Xiulan in the dining room, and the three of them discussed it together. Based on her parents' feedback on the itinerary pace and dietary preferences, Sun Yuwei adjusted the order of some scenic spots and dining locations, finally determining the basic framework.

name: Attend an essay writing lecture and make revisions to my writing.
description: On the afternoon of November 21, Sun Yuwei set out from home to the Yunnan Writers’ Association to attend the lecture “Essay Writing and Regional Culture,” listening carefully and taking notes. After the lecture, she exchanged creative insights with the speaker, Zhou Mingyuan, and received advice and encouragement. She then returned home, and that evening organized her lecture notes and made partial revisions to her essay series “Kunming Slices.”

subevent.name: Set off for the lecture venue
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei set out from her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, at 13:30 on the afternoon of November 21, took the subway to the Yunnan Writers' Association office building, reviewed the lecture-related questions she had prepared in advance on her phone along the way, and confirmed the route.
subevent.location: Kunming - home on Renmin Middle Road to Yunnan Writers' Association, Wuhua District

subevent.name: Attended the lecture 'Prose Writing and Regional Culture'
subevent.description: From 14:00 to 16:00, Sun Yuwei attended a literature lecture given by the renowned essayist Zhou Mingyuan in the meeting room on the third floor of the Yunnan Writers' Association. She sat in the front row and listened attentively, using the journal she carried with her to record key points, including core views such as the influence of regional culture on prose imagery, and photographed the PPT slides.
subevent.location: Kunming City – Yunnan Writers’ Association, third-floor meeting room

subevent.name: Exchanged creative insights with the speaker
subevent.description: After the lecture ended (around 16:10), Sun Yuwei took the initiative to speak with Teacher Zhou Mingyuan. She briefly introduced the series of essays “Kunming Slices” that she was working on and her confusion about “how to elevate personal experience into universal resonance.” Teacher Zhou affirmed her perspective and suggested she incorporate more sensory details such as touch and smell, while also recommending essay collections by Wang Zengqi and Lu Wenfu as references.
subevent.location: Kunming - Yunnan Provincial Writers' Association, third-floor rest area

subevent.name: Returning home
subevent.description: Around 16:30, Sun Yuwei left the Yunnan Writers' Association, walked to the bus stop, and took Bus 85 home. On the way, she noted down several key revision directions suggested by her teacher in her phone memo.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District to home

subevent.name: Organize lecture notes and plan revisions
subevent.description: After arriving home at 17:30, Sun Yuwei had a flower cake as a snack, then copied the notes from her journal into a dedicated creative notebook in the study. Combining Teacher Zhou Mingyuan's suggestions, she made partial revisions to the draft of the chapter “Winter at Green Lake” in “Kunming Slices,” and did not finish until 22:00.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming City

name: Morning walk with father at Green Lake and a heart-to-heart talk
description: On the morning of November 19, Sun Yuwei, who rarely got up early, took the initiative to invite her father Sun Mingyuan to take a walk in Green Lake Park. The two strolled slowly along the lake, talking about the progress of her recent essay collection and her father's retirement plans. Her father praised her for being mature and reminded her to take care of her health. After the walk, Sun Yuwei bought a hot grilled rice cake for her father, and warmth flowed through the silence between father and daughter.

subevent.name: Getting up early in the morning to prepare for a walk
subevent.description: At around 6 a.m. on November 19, 2025, Sun Yuwei woke up naturally in her bedroom at her home in Wuhua District, Kunming. Feeling happy, she decided to take the initiative to invite her father, Sun Mingyuan, to go for a morning walk in Green Lake Park. She washed up briefly, changed into light sportswear, went to the living room to check whether her father was up, and softly called out to him to express her wish to go for a walk.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

subevent.name: Go to Cuihu Park.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her father Sun Mingyuan left home together at around 6:15 in the morning and walked from No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, to Cuihu Park. Along the way, they chatted as they walked. Sun Yuwei mentioned that she was recently working on a chapter about family love in her essay collection, while her father shared memories of his morning exercises when he was young. The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious. After walking about 15 minutes, they arrived at the South Gate of Cuihu Park.
subevent.location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Take a walk by Green Lake and have a heart-to-heart talk.
subevent.description: From 6:30 to 7:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei and her father walked slowly along the lakeside path of Green Lake Park. Morning light was just appearing, and a thin mist hung over the lake. Sun Yuwei gave her father a detailed account of the progress on her essay collection, mentioning the encouragement of her mentor Wu Mingyuan and the new topic invitation from editor Xu Mingyuan. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, listened attentively, praised his daughter for becoming more mature and thoughtful, and also reminded her with concern to balance work and rest and keep a regular routine. The two also talked about the father’s plans after retiring at the end of the year; he said he wanted to spend more time with her mother and older sister, and planned to learn calligraphy. During the walk, the conversation between father and daughter was natural and warm.
subevent.location: Green Lake Park, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Buying grilled erkuai for my father
subevent.description: Around 7 a.m., after the walk, Sun Yuwei saw a stall selling roasted erkuai near Green Lake Park, so she took the initiative to buy two hot portions for her father, one with sweet sauce and one with spicy sauce. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, was deeply moved. The two sat on a park bench, eating and watching the morning exercisers, and Sun Yuwei felt a long-lost sense of peace and happiness.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province – snack stall near Cuihu Park

subevent.name: Returned home after a walk.
subevent.description: Around 7:30 in the morning, after finishing grilled rice cakes with her father, Sun Yuwei leisurely walked back home with him at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District. On the way, her father said he really enjoyed such a warm morning time, and Sun Yuwei promised to try to accompany her father on a walk once a week in the future. After arriving home, Sun Yuwei told her mother Li Xiulan the details of the walk, and her mother smiled and praised her for being thoughtful. The whole family began a new day.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - at home and on the way to Cuihu Park

name: Wrote short postcard phrases for my cousin's company and received 2,000 yuan in design fees.
description: On November 18, her cousin Shen Wei asked Sun Yuwei to write six short poems to accompany the company's scenic postcards. She spent three evenings carefully polishing the lines, blending poetry into the images, and delivered them on November 20. Shen Wei was very pleased and paid 2,000 yuan as a design fee, and they agreed to continue collaborating in the future.

subevent.name: Accepting the commission and formulating the creative concept.
subevent.description: On November 18, Sun Yuwei received a commission from her cousin Shen Wei in Hangzhou, asking her to write six short poems to accompany a company's series of landscape postcards. In her home study, she carefully read the postcard proofs and began to outline a textual direction that would blend poetry into the images.

subevent.name: First night: refine short poems
subevent.description: On the evening of November 18, Sun Yuwei opened her computer in the study and began drafting short poems based on ideas from the day. She carefully weighed her wording and rhythm, completed two poems, and noted down her revision approach.

subevent.name: Polishing the text on the second night
subevent.description: On the evening of November 19, Sun Yuwei continued writing in her home study, revising the first two poems and composing two new ones, focusing on the fit between imagery and words. After finishing four pieces, she discussed the style direction with her cousin on WeChat.

subevent.name: Third night completion and delivery
subevent.description: On the evening of November 20, Sun Yuwei finished writing the last two short poems in her home study, read through all six to adjust the rhyme and rhythm as a whole, and after finishing sent the final draft to her older cousin Shen Wei via WeChat.

subevent.name: Payment received and subsequent arrangements
subevent.description: Later on November 20, her cousin Shen Wei was very satisfied with the six-line short poem and transferred 2,000 yuan as a design fee to Sun Yuwei via WeChat, agreeing to continue cooperating on similar projects in the future. After confirming receipt, Sun Yuwei expressed her thanks.

name: Holding a retirement celebration dinner for mother
description: On August 15, 2025, her mother, Li Xiulan, officially retired from Kunming No. 2 Middle School. The day before, Sun Yuwei and her father planned a family dinner, booked a private room at a home-style restaurant by Green Lake, and invited their neighbor Aunt Xie. Yuwei designed a small bouquet through flower arranging and gave it to her mother, with a card reading: "A three-foot lectern nurtured many students; a room of flower shadows will accompany your remaining years." During the meal, her mother teared up several times, and her father raised a toast to thank his wife for her years of dedication. After dinner, Yuwei and her mother walked along Green Lake. Holding her hand, her mother said, "In the days ahead, I want to go out with you more often." The next day, Yuwei wrote the long conversation from that walk into the afterword of her essay collection.

subevent.name: Plan a retirement celebration dinner.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her father Sun Mingyuan planned together in the living room a retirement celebration dinner for her mother, Li Xiulan. They discussed the venue and finally decided to reserve a private room at a family-run restaurant by Green Lake. They also called their neighbor, Aunt Xie Xiulan, to invite her. Yuwei noted down the flowers and card content to prepare in her phone memo.
subevent.location: Living room at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Making flower bouquets and cards
subevent.description: On the morning of August 15, Sun Yuwei used Ikenobo flower arranging techniques in her home study to carefully design and create a small bouquet of carnations, lisianthus, and eucalyptus leaves. She also wrote a message by hand on the card: “A three-foot podium nurtures peach and plum pupils; a room of flower shadows accompanies the remaining years.” After finishing, she wrapped the bouquet and card, preparing to give them to her mother at the dinner banquet.
subevent.location: Study at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Family celebration dinner
subevent.description: On the evening of August 15, Sun Yuwei, her father Sun Mingyuan, her mother Li Xiulan, and neighbor Aunt Xie Xiulan gathered in a private room at a home-style restaurant by Green Lake. During the meal, Sun Yuwei gave her mother a bouquet and card she had made herself, and her mother was moved to tears. Her father Sun Mingyuan raised a toast to thank his wife for her years of dedication to the family and her devotion to education. Everyone savored Yunnan specialty dishes while reminiscing about the past, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province - Kunming - Cuihu Private Kitchen Restaurant

subevent.name: After-dinner walk around Green Lake and a long conversation
subevent.description: After the dinner, Sun Yuwei walked with her mother, Li Xiulan, by Green Lake. They walked slowly along the lakeside. Her mother held Yuwei's hand and, reflecting on her new life after retirement, said to Yuwei, 'In the days ahead, I want to go out with you more.' Yuwei shared her plans for writing and travel. The walk lasted about an hour, and the atmosphere was intimate.

subevent.name: Write the long conversation into the afterword of the essay collection
subevent.description: On the morning of August 16, in her study, Sun Yuwei organized and polished the content of the long conversation she had with her mother during their walk the previous evening, as material for the afterword of her essay collection. She recorded in detail her mother's reflections on retirement, her expectations for her, and the warm dialogue between them, and incorporated her own feelings to complete the first draft of the afterword.
subevent.location: Study at home, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Expense tracking and budget planning
description: On November 28, Sun Yuwei organized her November income and expense details based on her journal and mobile banking records, found that dining and transportation expenses were relatively high, so she made a December budget, set a monthly fixed savings goal of 1,500 yuan, and decided to reduce the number of takeout orders.

subevent.name: Prepare bookkeeping materials.
subevent.description: During her pre-bedtime organizing time, Sun Yuwei took out the November journal and her phone from the desk drawer, opened the mobile banking app, and prepared to start reconciling her accounts.

subevent.name: Record the income and expense details for November.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei reconciled November's income and expenses transaction by transaction against the daily spending records in her journal and her mobile banking statements, calculated the totals for food, transportation, shopping, entertainment, and other categories, and worked out total income and total expenses.

subevent.name: Analyze November spending structure.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei compared various spending data and found that dining and transportation expenses accounted for a relatively high proportion, exceeding her daily expectations. Realizing that food delivery and taxi costs were relatively high, she decided to make adjustments next month.

subevent.name: Create a December budget plan.
subevent.description: Based on the November income and expenditure analysis, Sun Yuwei wrote down her December budget plan in her journal: set a fixed monthly savings target of 1,500 yuan, set limits for dining, transportation, shopping, and other categories, and make a special note to reduce takeout orders, aiming to cut dining expenses by 20%.

name: Second-round submission of the essay collection and writing afterword: To Myself in Five Years
description: On November 3, Sun Yuwei submitted the carefully revised manuscript to the publishing house editor again. The next day, the editor replied suggesting she add an afterword. From the 5th to the 7th, she spent three days writing the heartfelt afterword titled To Myself Five Years From Now, clarifying her original intentions for writing and her hopes for the future, which moved the editor. This marked the beginning of the formal publication process for her first essay collection.

subevent.name: Second-round submission of the prose collection
subevent.description: At home, Sun Yuwei emailed the carefully revised manuscript of her essay collection to the editor's inbox at the publishing house, attaching modification notes and a sincere submission letter. She repeatedly checked the formatting and attachments, and after ensuring the email was sent successfully, she breathed a long sigh of relief, her heart full of expectation and uncertainty.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Received the editor's reply and communicated
subevent.description: The next morning, Sun Yuwei received an email reply from Zhang Minghui, an editor at the publishing house. The editor praised the quality of the manuscript and suggested adding an afterword to enrich the emotional depth of the book. Sun Yuwei immediately replied to agree, and discussed with the editor via WeChat the general direction and word count requirements of the afterword, agreeing to complete the first draft within three days.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: First day writing the afterword
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei began writing the afterword 'To Yourself Five Years from Now' that same evening. Sitting at her desk, she flipped through her creative notes and fragments of inspiration from her university years, sorting out the original intention behind the essay collection. She wrote about 1,500 words, including recollections of her university days, her commitment to her original aspirations, and her expectations for the next five years of her writing path. The writing was sincere and moving.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Second Day of Writing the Afterword
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei continued to polish and supplement the afterword. Drawing on her recent yoga and meditation experiences, she added thoughts on inner peace and growth and wove into the text her reflections on the independent bookstore culture of Kunming. That day she wrote about 2,000 characters. The overall framework was basically complete, with emotions progressing layer by layer and growing ever richer.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

subevent.name: Completed and submitted the afterword.
subevent.description: On the morning of the third day, Sun Yuwei made final revisions to the afterword and proofread it, adding a sentence of thanks for the editor's patient guidance to complete the emotional arc of the text. At noon, she emailed the finalized afterword to editor Zhang Minghui with a brief note. The editor replied quickly after receiving it, saying he was deeply moved and praising the writing as sincere and touching, and officially confirmed that the essay collection would enter the publication process.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province.

name: Start a regular running plan, alternating with yoga.
description: Starting in August, Sun Yuwei ran three times a week, gradually increasing distance under He Lu's online supervision. She alternated running days with yoga days to avoid overfatigue. In September, her longest single run reached 4 km, and her post-run stretching incorporated yoga poses; her cardiorespiratory fitness and leg strength improved significantly.

subevent.name: September running progression and yoga integration
subevent.description: In September, Sun Yuwei continued her plan of running three times a week, with the longest single run reaching 4 kilometers. Her cardiorespiratory fitness and leg strength improved significantly. She incorporated yoga poses into her post-run stretching, integrating yoga and running more closely. He Lu continued to monitor her running progress through an online platform and provided stretching guidance.
subevent.location: Kunming: park near home / Jingxin Yoga Life Studio

subevent.name: Week 1 Running and Yoga Stretching Training
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei followed a plan of three times a week, running on September 2 (Tuesday), September 4 (Thursday), and September 6 (Saturday). Before each run, she warmed up with a 20-minute jog at Green Lake Park near her home in Kunming, gradually increasing the distance; immediately after running, she did 15 minutes of stretching, incorporating yoga poses such as Downward-Facing Dog and Crescent Moon Pose to relieve muscle tension. He Lu sent the day's training plan via WeChat every day and asked how the run felt in the evening, remotely monitoring progress.

subevent.name: Week 4 running and yoga stretching training
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei kept up her three-times-a-week routine on September 23 (Tuesday), 25 (Thursday), and 27 (Saturday). Using 4 kilometers as her baseline distance, she added the yoga pose Legs-Up-the-Wall to her post-run stretching to relax her legs, and tried to coordinate her breathing rhythm with her running cadence. He Lu checked her training log over WeChat voice and suggested starting interval running next week to build endurance.

subevent.name: End-of-month running summary and plan adjustment
subevent.description: On the evening of September 30, Sun Yuwei had a 30-minute video call with He Lu at home. She reported her running data for the month: total mileage of about 42 kilometers, longest single run of 4 kilometers, and she successfully completed the goal of running three times a week. He Lu looked at her post-run stretching video, affirmed the effectiveness of incorporating yoga, and together they made a plan for October: maintain three runs a week, attempt one 5-kilometer run, and add yoga core-strength training.

name: Dormitory graduation dinner, exchanging handwritten letters and making promises for the future
description: During graduation season, Sun Yuwei and her college roommates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin began discussing the graduation dinner arrangement on June 9, and decided to have dinner at a Yunnan cuisine restaurant near the school on June 16 and exchange handwritten letters. On June 14, Sun Yuwei wrote a handwritten letter recalling her college life by herself. On June 16, the four attended the graduation ceremony and took group photos; in the evening they had dinner at the restaurant, talked freely about the past and the future, then returned to the dormitory to exchange handwritten letters, were moved to tears, and agreed to reunite every June. The next day, Sun Yuwei created a WeChat group called "June Appointment", uploaded group photos and photos of the letters, and agreed on Hangzhou as the first-year reunion location.

subevent.name: Discuss graduation dinner arrangements.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei and her college roommates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin discussed the details of their graduation dinner in the dormitory, including the time (evening of June 16), the place (a Yunnan cuisine restaurant near the school), and the format (each person would prepare a handwritten letter for the others and exchange them on the spot). The four of them quickly agreed and finalized the gathering schedule.
subevent.location: Yunnan University dormitory, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Preparing a handwritten letter
subevent.description: At her desk, Sun Yuwei took out carefully selected stationery and a fountain pen, recalled the little moments spent with her three roommates over four years of college, wrote a handwritten letter full of gratitude and blessings, and included her contact information, hoping for a future reunion.

subevent.name: Attend the graduation ceremony.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin attended the Yunnan University Class of 2025 graduation ceremony together. In the gymnasium, they listened to the president's address and received their degree certificates. After the ceremony, the four of them took commemorative photos in front of campus landmarks in their bachelor's gowns, capturing their final days as classmates.
