subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Yunnan University Gymnasium

subevent.name: Graduation dinner
subevent.description: At six in the evening, Sun Yuwei and her three roommates arrived as scheduled at a private room in a Yunnan restaurant near the school, ordering hometown dishes such as Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles and mushroom hot pot. They chatted while eating about interesting things in college life, internship experiences, and future plans. The atmosphere was warm and slightly sentimental.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Yunnan cuisine restaurant near the school

subevent.name: Exchanged handwritten letters and made a promise for the future
subevent.description: After the gathering, they returned to the dormitory. The four sat around the desk and exchanged the handwritten letters they had prepared. Sun Yuwei was moved to tears reading her roommates' letters, which recalled the warm times over the past four years of attending classes, exploring shops, and keeping journals together. They agreed that no matter whether they went to Hangzhou, Shenzhen, or stayed in Kunming after graduation, they would reunite every June, either by video or in person, to maintain this friendship.
subevent.location: Yunnan University dormitory, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Creating the "June Appointment" WeChat group
subevent.description: The day after the get-together, Sun Yuwei created a WeChat group chat named “June Appointment,” added Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin to the group, and uploaded the group photos and photos of the handwritten letters taken at the get-together. In the group, everyone agreed that the reunion location for the first year (2026) would initially be Hangzhou (the city where Lin Yue lives), and a vote was started.

name: Completed the first batch of Yunnan plant sticker designs
description: On December 22, Sun Yuwei and her college roommate Zhou Lin finally confirmed online via WeChat the first batch of design drafts for the Yunnan Plants and Grasses sticker series, including patterns such as camellias, bougainvilleas, and ferns. She then scanned her hand-drawn watercolor drafts into digital versions, used photo-editing software to fine-tune the colors, and completed the electronic drafts of the first batch.

subevent.name: Confirm the design draft online with Zhou Lin.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, via WeChat, together with her college roommate Zhou Lin (online), finalized the first batch of design drafts for the Yunnan Flora sticker series, including patterns such as camellias, bougainvillea, and ferns. The two discussed colors, layout, and details and reached an agreement.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Scanned the hand-drawn watercolor drafts and fine-tuned the colors
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei scanned the confirmed hand-painted watercolor drafts (camellia, bougainvillea, ferns) into electronic versions using a home scanner, then used photo editing software on her computer to fine-tune the colors, ensuring accurate color reproduction and a style suitable for cultural and creative products.
subevent.location: Home study, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Received the publishing contract intent for "Slow Travel Notes" and celebrated with family.
description: On the morning of December 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei received an email from a publisher in the dormitory of the School of Liberal Arts at Yunnan University, confirming the intention to sign a publishing contract for “Slow Travel Notes” (first printing of 2,000 copies in spring 2026). After reading it repeatedly with excitement, she immediately video-called her parents. Her mother Li Xiulan covered her mouth and shed tears, while her father Sun Mingyuan nodded continuously. After hanging up, she immediately took a car back to her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, and embraced her parents tightly, celebrating together that years of writing had finally been recognized.

subevent.name: Received and confirmed the publishing contract email
subevent.description: On the morning of December 5, 2025, Sun Yuwei logged into her email on her personal computer in the Yunnan University dormitory and found an email from the publisher expressing intent to sign a publication contract for Slow Travel Notes, planned for release in spring 2026 with an initial print run of 2,000 copies. She read it three times to make sure there were no errors, and was extremely excited inside.
subevent.location: Dormitory of the School of Literature, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Video call to inform family of good news.
subevent.description: After confirming the content of the email, Sun Yuwei called her family on a video call with trembling hands. On screen, her mother Li Xiulan covered her mouth and burst into tears upon seeing the news, while her father Sun Mingyuan nodded repeatedly, too excited to speak coherently. Sun Yuwei shared the good news with her family and thanked them for their years of support.
subevent.location: Dormitory of the School of Literature, Yunnan University, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Going to my parents' home for a family gathering to celebrate.
subevent.description: After hanging up the video call, Sun Yuwei immediately left her dormitory and took a bus for about 20 minutes to return home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District. As soon as she entered, she hugged her mother Li Xiulan and father Sun Mingyuan, who had been waiting in the living room. All three were moved to tears; years of writing had finally broken through the soil and seen the light.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Initial layout and professional revision of the prose collection
description: From July 2 to 4, Sun Yuwei arranged nearly six months of prose writing into a complete collection for the first time. The tentative title was Slow Travel Notes, containing 18 essays divided into three sections: "City", "Faraway", and "Whispers". On July 6, she invited editor Xu Mingyuan for an in-depth revision meeting. Xu Mingyuan suggested removing three weaker pieces and adding an author's preface. Although Sun Yuwei was reluctant, she saw it as professional refinement, accepted it with a heavy heart, and began revising.

subevent.name: Prose selection and classification
subevent.description: In the study of her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei went through the prose manuscripts she had written over the past six months one by one, selected 18 works of relatively high quality, and made a preliminary classification according to three thematic categories: 'City,' 'Distance,' and 'Whispers,' in preparation for subsequent arrangement.

subevent.name: Arrangement and compilation of entries
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, at her desk at home, carefully ordered 18 prose pieces according to the themes of the three sections, adjusted the order of the pieces to reflect emotional progression and reading rhythm, and wrote brief notes for each section to perfect the overall structure.

subevent.name: Preliminary layout, finalizing the draft, and naming
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei completed the first full arrangement of the entire essay collection 'Notes on Slow Travel,' integrating the manuscripts from three sections into one document, revising titles and formatting, adding a short epigraph for each section, and confirming the initial typeset version.

subevent.name: Schedule a time for the manuscript revision meeting
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei contacted editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat. The two communicated and confirmed that the next day (July 6) in the afternoon, they would hold an in-depth manuscript revision meeting via video conference. Sun Yuwei sent the preliminary typeset document to Xu Mingyuan in advance for review.

subevent.name: Held an in-depth revision meeting with editor Xu Mingyuan.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei held a revision meeting via video call in her home study with her editor Xu Mingyuan, who was in faraway Beijing. Xu Mingyuan commented on each piece, suggested cutting three structurally weaker works, and adding an author's preface to strengthen the overall coherence. Sun Yuwei listened carefully and reflected on the professional suggestions.

subevent.name: Accepting the suggestion and making a revision plan.
subevent.description: After the revision meeting ended, Sun Yuwei sat alone at her desk weighing the options repeatedly. Although she was reluctant to delete her own works, she realized it was a necessary part of professional growth. In the end, she decided to adopt all of Xu Mingyuan's suggestions and listed a revision checklist in her notebook: delete three essays, write a preface, and adjust some wording.

subevent.name: Deleting entries and restructuring.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei followed the revision plan: she deleted the three essays that had been suggested for removal from the preliminary draft document, then readjusted the structure and order of the related selections to ensure overall coherence and fluency, and updated the table of contents.

subevent.name: Write the first draft of the author's preface.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei spent two days at home writing the preface to her essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes.' She reviewed her creative journey, explained the origin of the book title and the overall concept behind the collection, and did preliminary polishing after completing the first draft.

subevent.name: Wrote the first part of the draft preface.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei, in her own study, focused from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on writing the first part of the draft preface for her prose collection Notes on Slow Travel. She first reviewed her creative journey from entering university to the publication of her first column article, thinking about how writing has helped her understand herself and the world. Next, she explained in detail the origin of the title Notes on Slow Travel—from an insight gained while walking by Cuihu Lake in Kunming—and the overall structural framework of the collection, including the themes and logical order of each chapter. As she wrote, she adjusted her wording to keep the text smooth and natural, and by early evening she had completed about 800 characters of the first part, briefly marking the places that needed revision.

subevent.name: Complete and polish the first draft of the preface
subevent.description: The next day, Sun Yuwei continued working at her home study, starting at 10 a.m. to write the remaining part of the first draft of her preface. She added tributes to her literary idols (such as Wang Zengqi and Shen Congwen) and expressed how her attachment to her hometown's Yunnan culture permeated her writing. After finishing the complete first draft of about 1,500 words at 2 p.m., she read through the entire text, integrated the previous day's writing with the later content, and made preliminary refinements to wording, punctuation, and sentence rhythm. She focused on adjusting the tone of the opening and closing to make it more natural and warm, and added transitional sentences between paragraphs. Before evening, she saved the polished draft to her computer and recorded her writing impressions and follow-up revision plans in her journal.

name: Attended the [Ink and Breath] offline gathering for the first time, shared prose, received feedback, and expressed gratitude.
description: On the evening of September 20, Sun Yuwei attended the Saturday café gathering of [Ink and Breath]. The members came from different professions. She shared an excerpt from her essay 'Watching Behind the Glass' and received specific revision suggestions, experiencing the directness and warmth of offline feedback. After returning home, she organized the feedback notes, and on September 21 thanked the organizer and members via the WeChat group, attaching the revised passage for further opinions, which deepened her connection with the community.

subevent.name: Preparing prose excerpts before the gathering
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei is in her study at her home in Kunming, organizing excerpts from her essay 'The Vigil Behind the Glass'. She chooses the best passages for sharing at the gathering, prints two paper copies in advance, and prepares a notebook to record feedback.

subevent.name: Going to the meeting place for the Ink and Breath gathering.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei took a bus from home to an independent café in Wuhua District, Kunming (the gathering place), and on the way used her phone to confirm the exact time and participant list for the gathering.

subevent.name: Attend an offline gathering and share prose works.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei introduced herself at the [Ink and Breath] Saturday café gathering to members from different professions, then read the core passage of her essay “Watching from Behind the Glass,” accepted the members' specific suggestions (such as adjusting the opening rhythm and adding more detail to the environmental descriptions), and felt the directness and warmth of offline feedback. The whole session lasted about two hours.

subevent.name: Went home to organize the gathering feedback
subevent.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei organized the suggestions recorded at the gathering into her journal at her desk, marked the revision directions that inspired her most, and wrote down her feelings about the gathering for later revisions to her essay.

subevent.name: Thanked the members of the gathering online.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei sent thank-you messages through the WeChat group to the organizers of [Ink and Breath] and the several members who had given her specific suggestions, attaching the revised prose paragraph for feedback, deepening her connection with community members.

name: Exchanged gifts with neighbor Aunt Xie and formed a cross-generational friendship of kindred spirits.
description: On the evening of September 18, Aunt Xie, a neighbor, brought over a jar of homemade pickled vegetables. Sun Yuwei gladly accepted it and gave her in return a carefully arranged autumn floral piece. During the chat, she learned that Aunt Xie had also been a literature lover in her youth and had written many essays. The two hit it off immediately, and afterward often visited each other to discuss reading and writing, forming a warm neighborly friendship.

subevent.name: Preparing a return flower arrangement
subevent.description: In the early evening of September 18, 2025, Sun Yuwei, in her study at home in Wuhua District, Kunming, used seasonal flower materials purchased earlier from Dounan Flower Market (such as daisies, yellow chrysanthemums, maple leaves, etc.) to meticulously arrange an Ikenobo-style floral work with an autumn theme, planning to give it to her neighbor Aunt Xie later.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District, Sun Yuwei's home study

subevent.name: Aunt Xie gave pickled vegetables, and Sun Yuwei reciprocated with a flower arrangement
subevent.description: On the evening of September 18, 2025, neighbor Xie Xiulan (Aunt Xie) came to Sun Yuwei's home carrying a jar of homemade pickled vegetables and warmly gave them to Yuwei. Sun Yuwei gladly accepted and offered one of her just-arranged autumn-themed floral arrangements as a return gift. Aunt Xie loved it and praised her for being skillful and talented.
subevent.location: Kunming - Wuhua District, outside Sun Yuwei's door and living room

subevent.name: Chatted with Aunt Xie and forged a literary friendship.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 18, 2025, Sun Yuwei invited Aunt Xie to sit down and chat in the living room. During the conversation, Yuwei learned that Aunt Xie had also been a literature lover in her youth and had written many essays and prose pieces. The two hit it off immediately, chatting from modern essays to local customs, and agreed to visit each other often to exchange reading insights and writing experiences.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District, Sun Yuwei's home living room

subevent.name: First Visit: Borrowing Auntie Xie's Essay Manuscript
subevent.description: On the morning of September 20, 2025, Sun Yuwei took along a journal she used often and went to visit Auntie Xie, who lived across the hall. Auntie Xie brought out several handwritten essay manuscripts from her youth for Yuwei to read. Yuwei read them carefully and copied down some wonderful passages. The two then had an in-depth discussion about one of the essays describing the scenery of Dianchi Lake, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Xie Xiulan's home, Wuhua District, Kunming.

subevent.name: Second visit: Aunt Xie came over and shared her writing works
subevent.description: In the evening of September 24, 2025, Aunt Xie took the initiative to visit Sun Yuwei's home. This time, Yuwei showed Aunt Xie several column articles she had published in Cultural Vision magazine and excerpts from the draft of a prose collection she was working on. Aunt Xie gave honest feedback and encouraged her to keep writing. The two also agreed to find an afternoon each week to exchange reading notes.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District, balcony at Sun Yuwei's home

name: Year-end closing yoga class: 108 Sun Salutations gratitude practice
description: On December 29, Sun Yuwei attended the yoga studio's last class of the year. At the end of the class, her instructor He Lu gave her a copy of The Tree of Yoga wrapped in a plain, elegant book cover, saying, "The changes in your body and mind over this past year are like a tree slowly taking root." After class, she stayed alone in the studio, accompanied by the dim winter light outside the window, and practiced Sun Salutations 108 times, breathing with each movement, sweat falling on her yoga mat. Each salutation was a gesture of gratitude and farewell to a year of persistence.

subevent.name: Heading to the yoga studio to prepare for class.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 29, 2025, Sun Yuwei left her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, and took the bus to Jingxin Yoga Life Studio in Panlong District. After arriving, she changed into her yoga clothes, spread out her mat, and adjusted her breathing to prepare for the year-end closing class.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Attended the final yoga class of the year and received a book gift.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei attended the last yoga class of the year at Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio, where instructor He Lu led basic asana practice, breathing meditation, and a gratitude session. At the end of the class, He Lu gave Sun Yuwei a copy of The Tree of Yoga wrapped in a plain, elegant book cover and said, 'The changes in your body and mind over this year are like a tree slowly taking root.' Sun Yuwei was touched as she accepted the book and briefly shared her practice reflections with He Lu.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Practiced 108 rounds of Sun Salutations alone
subevent.description: After class, the other students left, and Sun Yuwei stayed alone in the classroom. With the winter light outside the window gradually dimming, she practiced 108 full rounds of Sun Salutations, breathing with each movement. Sweat dripped onto the yoga mat, and each bow was an expression of gratitude for and farewell to a year of persistence. The whole process lasted about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Jingxin Yoga Life Center

subevent.name: Tidied up after class and went home.
subevent.description: After the practice, Sun Yuwei packed up her yoga mat and clothes, and left the yoga studio with The Tree of Yoga, a gift from He Lu. She took the bus home, put the book on her desk, and recorded this special practice experience.

name: At Xu Mingyuan’s invitation, writing a long prose piece “Kunming, Kunming”
description: On September 10, writer Xu Mingyuan formally commissioned Sun Yuwei to write a long prose piece, raising the payment rate to 400 yuan per 1,000 characters. From September 10 to 15, she devoted herself to writing, visiting Green Lake and old neighborhoods for inspiration, and finally completed an 8,000-character essay titled 'Kunming, Kunming', presenting Kunming's everyday life and the passage of time with deep affection. After she submitted the manuscript, Xu Mingyuan gave her high praise and paid part of the fee in advance.

subevent.name: Accept a commissioned article and discuss the topic
subevent.description: On September 10, 2025, at home, Sun Yuwei received an invitation to contribute an article from Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Horizon, sent via WeChat. He hoped she would write a long essay about Kunming, with the pay rate increased to 400 yuan per 1,000 characters. Delighted, Sun Yuwei discussed the essay topic and word count requirements with Xu Mingyuan, accepted the invitation, and began to plan the overall structure and writing schedule.
subevent.location: Sun Yuwei's home, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Visited Cuihu Park to gather creative inspiration.
subevent.description: On the morning of September 11, 2025, Sun Yuwei took her notebook and camera to Cuihu Park in Kunming. Strolling along the lakeside path, she observed elderly people exercising, gulls playing, and relaxed residents, recording the seasonal changes, street life, and natural landscapes of Cuihu. She sat on a lakeside bench for an hour and wrote several pages of observation notes about light, crowds, and memory as source material for her essays. In the afternoon, she returned home, organized her notes, and made an initial plan for the structure of the essays.

subevent.name: Gathering inspiration in the old neighborhoods of Kunming
subevent.description: On September 12, 2025, Sun Yuwei went to Kunming's old neighborhoods (around Wenming Street and Qianwang Street), wandering through bluestone paths and century-old houses, and visiting traditional handicraft shops, old teahouses, and local snack stalls. She chatted with an elderly woman selling tofu pudding and recorded oral accounts of the old streets' changes and stories of human warmth. At noon, she had a meal at a time-honored rice noodle restaurant, savoring the authentic local flavor. In the afternoon, she returned home, integrated today's gains with yesterday's material, and further enriched her essay.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Old Town (Wenming Street, Qianwang Street)

subevent.name: Focus on writing the first draft of an essay at home.
subevent.description: On September 13, 2025, Sun Yuwei stayed in her home study all day, turned off phone notifications, and devoted herself to writing the first draft of the essay "Kunming, Kunming." Following her earlier plan, she used time as the thread, writing from Cuihu Lake in the early morning to the old streets at dusk, depicting Kunming's daily life and passing time with delicate brushwork. In the afternoon she wrote about 4,000 characters, but felt the ending needed more inspiration, so she decided to continue the next day. In the evening, she briefly reviewed the day's output and adjusted the outline for the following sections.
subevent.location: Study in Sun Yuwei's home, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Finish the prose, then revise and polish it.
subevent.description: On the morning of September 14, 2025, Sun Yuwei continued writing the chapter she had not finished the previous day, adding character stories and details accumulated during field visits to old neighborhoods to make the article warmer. In the afternoon, she completed the entire 8000-character first draft. Then she spent two hours reading through the whole text, polishing sentences, adjusting the pacing, and removing redundant descriptions to ensure emotional coherence. In the evening, she exported the final draft as a document, ready to submit to the editor the next day.
subevent.location: Study in Sun Yuwei's home, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Submitted the manuscript and received the editor's feedback and advance payment
subevent.description: On the morning of September 15, 2025, Sun Yuwei sent the completed long essay “Kunming, Kunming” as a document to her editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat. In the afternoon, Xu Mingyuan replied with high praise, saying the piece was “delicate and deeply felt, capturing the soul of Kunming,” and prepaid part of the contribution fee to Sun Yuwei’s WeChat account according to the agreed rate (400 yuan per 1,000 characters, 3,200 yuan in total). Sun Yuwei was very happy, thanked Xu Mingyuan, and began planning her next topic.
subevent.location: Sun Yuwei's home, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Hiking Xishan to build cardiorespiratory fitness and gather creative material.
description: On Sunday, September 14, Sun Yuwei continued her monthly hiking plan and climbed the Maomaoqing route on Xishan alone. Carrying her mirrorless camera, she captured the autumn scenery along the way and distant views of Dianchi Lake. She took a short rest at Taihua Temple and meditated for half an hour. The hike not only accumulated visual material for her column but also gave her the delight of improved cardiorespiratory fitness. After descending the mountain, she decided to add one more aerobic workout each week.

subevent.name: Pre-hike preparation
subevent.description: At 7 a.m., Sun Yuwei checked and organized her hiking gear at home in Kunming, including sneakers, a backpack, a water bottle, and a mirrorless camera. She made sure the batteries were fully charged and packed some snacks and sunscreen. She changed into athletic clothes and made all preparations before departing.
subevent.location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Heading to the Xishan trailhead.
subevent.description: At 7:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei left home and took a bus to the Maomaoqing trailhead of Xishan Forest Park in Xishan District, Kunming. The ride took about 40 minutes. She arrived at the foot of the mountain around 8:10, did a brief warm-up, and got ready to start climbing.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City - Xishan Forest Park Maomaoqing Hiking Trailhead

subevent.name: Hiking up Xishan Mountain and taking photos along the way
subevent.description: Starting at 8:15, Sun Yuwei hiked up Xishan along the Maomaoqing route. She used a mirrorless camera to record the autumn scenery along the way and the distant views of Dianchi Lake, including yellow leaves, wildflowers, and the panoramic view of the lake from the mountaintop. She stopped many times along the way to adjust her shooting angles and capture the changing natural light. The hike took about 1 hour and 45 minutes, and it was already past 10 when she arrived near Taihua Temple.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - Xishan Forest Park Maomaoqing Route

subevent.name: Resting and meditating briefly at Taihua Temple
subevent.description: From 10:00 to 10:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei sat in a quiet corner of Taihua Temple and meditated for half an hour with her eyes closed. She took deep breaths to regulate her heart rate, feeling the mountain breeze and birdsong, and relaxed both body and mind. After the meditation, she drank tea and briefly enjoyed the autumn scenery in the temple.
subevent.location: Taihua Temple, Western Hills, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Go down the mountain and head back.
subevent.description: From 10:30 to 11:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei descended from Taihua Temple along the same route. On the way down, she continued using her mirrorless camera to record the scenery from different angles, while feeling the improvement in her cardiovascular function after exercise. Around 11:30, she returned to the trailhead at the foot of the mountain.
subevent.location: The downhill path of Xishan Forest Park, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Return home and organize materials
subevent.description: From 11:30 a.m. to 12:10 p.m., Sun Yuwei took a ride back home. After arriving, she imported the photos from her mirrorless camera into her computer, browsed and selected the best shots from the hike, and accumulated visual material for her column article. At the same time, she summarized her hiking experience and decided to add one more aerobic exercise session per week starting next week (such as a morning run or jump rope), and recorded this plan in her journal.
subevent.location: Home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province

name: Graduation thesis topic proposal and preliminary research
description: On February 5, she completed the thesis proposal and finalized the topic “A Study of the Cultural Space of Independent Bookstores in Kunming.” Her advisor Wu Mingyuan suggested adding the oral history method and recommended interviewing the veteran bookman Qin Mingyuan. On February 8, she visited Qin Mingyuan for the first time, listened to the changes of old Kunming bookstores, and was deeply moved while transcribing the recording, so she wrote the essay “The Bookworm's Hiding Place.” On February 9, she added an “Interview Inspiration Page” to her journal, used a Polaroid to photograph the interviewees, and incorporated the material into both her thesis and creative database.

subevent.name: Graduation Thesis Proposal
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei submitted her graduation thesis proposal at the School of Liberal Arts at Yunnan University, formally confirming her topic: 'A Study of Cultural Spaces of Independent Bookstores in Kunming'. Her supervisor, Wu Mingyuan, had a half-hour talk with her in his office, suggested incorporating oral history methods into the research, and recommended that she interview veteran bookstore operator Qin Mingyuan (the owner of Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street) to obtain first-hand information about the transformation of old Kunming bookstores. Sun Yuwei recorded the key points of her supervisor's suggestions in detail and drafted an initial framework for the interview outline in her notebook.
subevent.location: Kunming - School of Liberal Arts, Yunnan University

subevent.name: Look up oral history methodology.
subevent.description: In preparation for the interview, Sun Yuwei borrowed two books on oral history methodology from the Social Sciences Reading Area of the Yunnan University Library—A Practical Guide to Oral History and Qualitative Research Methods—and, sitting by the window, spent two hours focusing on the relevant chapters on interviewing techniques, recording equipment selection, informed consent procedures, and later transcription standards. She marked key passages with a highlighter and copied suitable question templates and recording transcription templates into her notebook.

subevent.name: Prepare the interview outline and make an appointment
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei, in her home study, based on her advisor's suggestions and oral history methods, wrote a semi-structured interview outline for Qin Mingyuan, covering dimensions such as his entrepreneurial experience, changes in the bookstore, customer stories, and the significance of urban cultural spaces. In the afternoon, she contacted Qin Mingyuan through WeChat to explain the purpose of the interview for her graduation thesis. Qin Mingyuan readily agreed, and they set a meeting for the afternoon of February 8 at Mingyuan Bookstore. Sun Yuwei then confirmed that her voice recorder, power bank, and instant camera were in good condition, and put spare batteries, a notebook, and a pen into her canvas bag.

subevent.name: Visited Qin Mingyuan and collected oral history materials.
subevent.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei arrived as arranged at Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming. Qin Mingyuan warmly received her, and in the tea seating area in the corner of the bookstore, the two chatted over tea while conducting the interview. Sun Yuwei turned on her voice recorder and asked questions according to the outline. Qin Mingyuan recounted, in a measured and engaging way, everything from his experience of opening a bookstore in Kunming twenty years ago, to the struggles and persistence of brick-and-mortar bookstores in the Internet age, to the stories of old bookstores that have disappeared from the streets of old Kunming. The interview lasted about an hour and a half, during which Sun Yuwei used a Polaroid camera to take pictures of Qin Mingyuan in front of the bookshelves, as well as several photos of the bookstore's interior. After the interview, she took a photo with Qin Mingyuan and thanked him for his heartfelt sharing.

subevent.name: Organizing the recording and writing an essay
subevent.description: At seven that evening, Sun Yuwei returned home, imported the audio files from the voice recorder into her computer, put on headphones, and began listening back segment by segment. When she came to the part where Qin Mingyuan said, "A bookstore is like a bookworm that wedges itself into the cracks of the old city wall," she was deeply moved. She paused her work, opened a new Word document, and, inspired by this sentence, wrote an essay of about 1,200 characters in one sitting, "The Bookworm's Hiding Place," recording the emotions and thoughts stirred by the interview. Afterward, she saved the essay to her creative folder and copied the key interview points into her notebook.

subevent.name: Journal organization and material archiving
subevent.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei took out the Polaroid photos from the previous day to dry and picked the two she was most satisfied with—one was a solo portrait of Qin Mingyuan, and the other was an interior shot of the bookstore. She took out her newly bought journal, added a new page in the middle called "Interview Inspiration Page", decorated the borders with colorful washi tape, pasted the photos on, and handwrote the interview date, the interviewee's name, key quotes, and her immediate feelings with a brush pen. Afterwards, she filed the Polaroid negatives, the backup of the recording files, the written notes, and the electronic draft of the essay "The Bookworm's Hideaway" into the graduation thesis material folder, completing the organization and archiving of the initial research.

name: Writing a new piece, 'Winter Hustle and Bustle at Zhuanxin Market,' for the 'Kunming Slices' column.
description: From November 13 to 17, Sun Yuwei first organized her writing outline and prepared equipment at home. Then, on the 14th and 15th, she went deep into Zhuanxin Market to gather material, observing winter seasonal ingredients and everyday street life. She wrote the first draft on the 16th, and on the 17th, after discussing revisions with editor Xu Mingyuan, she submitted and archived the completed new installment of the "Slices of Kunming" column.

subevent.name: Preparation and material organization before the field trip
subevent.description: At her home in Kunming (123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District), Sun Yuwei organized her writing outline, confirmed that the fieldwork focus would be winter seasonal ingredients (such as morel mushrooms, winter bamboo shoots, and cured meat) and vendor stories, and brought along a notebook and camera to prepare for the on-site observation at Zhuanxin Market.

subevent.name: First field visit to Zhuanxin Market
subevent.description: From 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., Sun Yuwei went alone to the Zhuanxin Farmers' Market in Wuhua District, Kunming, observed the stalls selling winter seasonal ingredients (such as mushroom stalls, cured meat shops, and vegetable stalls), talked with stall owners to learn about local food culture, recorded details of everyday street life, and took several photos as writing material.

subevent.name: Supplementary field trip and in-depth interview at Zhuanxin Market
subevent.description: At 10:00 a.m., Sun Yuwei went to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market again to make supplementary observations of the tofu product area and the deli area that had not been fully recorded the day before. She also had informal interviews with several veteran stall owners to learn about their decades of business stories and changes in winter business, collecting more vivid material.

subevent.name: Write the first draft of the column "Winter Fireworks at Zhuanxin Market"
subevent.description: In her study at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei focused on writing a new piece for her column "Slices of Kunming", titled "Winter Fireworks at Zhuanxin Market", based on the notes and photos from her fieldwork over the previous two days. She focused on describing the colors and smells of winter seasonal ingredients, vendor conversations, and the overall market atmosphere, completing an initial draft of about 2,000 characters.

subevent.name: Communicating with editor Xu Mingyuan about revising the manuscript
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei sent the first draft, “Winter Fireworks at Zhuanxin Market,” to Xu Mingyuan, editor of “Cultural Horizon,” via WeChat. Xu Mingyuan gave feedback that same morning (suggesting adding a detail about the Lunar New Year atmosphere and adjusting the structure of the introduction). Sun Yuwei revised it accordingly, and after about an hour of text and voice communication, they finalized the draft.

subevent.name: Final manuscript submission and archiving
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei submitted the revised final draft to Xu Mingyuan by email, and archived her field notes and photos in her writing work folder, labeled as a column article for Kunming Slices, completing this writing task.

name: Photographing wildflowers with Su Man in Xundian and baking potatoes outdoors.
description: On November 16, Sun Yuwei rented a car with her newly obtained driver's license and drove with her friend Su Man to Xundian Grassland. They photographed wildflowers on the grassland, collected dry branches and tumbleweeds as materials for flower arrangement, and at dusk had a picnic roasting potatoes and corn on a portable stove, then drove back to Kunming.

subevent.name: Car rental preparation.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 16, Sun Yuwei, carrying her newly obtained driver's license, went to a car rental company in Wuhua District, Kunming, to complete the rental procedures. She rented a small SUV suitable for long-distance driving and arranged to meet her good friend Su Man at the rental point.
subevent.location: Rental car company in Wuhua District, Kunming.

subevent.name: Drove to Xundian Grassland.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei drove a rented car, taking Su Man from downtown Kunming, and traveled along highways and county roads for about two hours to reach the grassland in Xundian County. Along the way, they chatted, enjoyed the scenery, and confirmed their photography and collection plans.
subevent.location: Grassland, Xundian County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Photographing wild flowers and collecting flower arrangement materials.
subevent.description: On the vast grasslands of Xundian, Sun Yuwei and Su Man used cameras and phones to photograph various wildflowers, such as wild chrysanthemums and dandelions, and collected some dead branches and dried pampas grass as natural materials for Ikenobo flower arranging. The two chatted about plant knowledge and flower arrangement insights while collecting, lasting about 3 hours.
subevent.location: Grassland, Xundian County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Outdoor picnic with roasted potatoes and corn.
subevent.description: At dusk, Sun Yuwei and Su Man found a flat and dry spot on the grassland and sat down on the ground. Using the portable stove and ingredients they had brought, they roasted potatoes and corn. As they enjoyed the simple picnic, they admired the grassland view at sunset, chatted about life and art, and relaxed.
subevent.location: Grassland, Xundian County, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Drive back to Kunming
subevent.description: After the picnic, Sun Yuwei drove Su Man back to downtown Kunming along the same route. In the car, the two reviewed the day's gains and agreed to sort through the materials and brainstorm flower arrangement works together next time. Back in the city, Sun Yuwei returned the rental car to the car rental company.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - car rental company / home

name: Formed a team with besties Chen Sisi and Zhang Jing for the city orienteering race, with nonstop laughter.
description: On Sunday, September 21, Sun Yuwei teamed up with her close friends Chen Sisi and Zhang Jing to take part in the Kunming Urban Orienteering Race. Although the three got lost several times and took wrong turns around blocks, they kept teasing one another and laughing the whole way, releasing stress through running and searching. In the evening after the race, they reviewed the whole course at an old-town teahouse, shared funny stories, and treasured the beautiful memories of their youthful friendship.

subevent.name: Pre-competition assembly and preparation
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on September 21, Sun Yuwei met her best friends Chen Sisi and Zhang Jing at Jinma Biji Square. They checked each other's belongings, discussed race strategy, and picked up the orienteering task booklet. The three were full of anticipation and cheered one another on.

subevent.name: Urban orienteering race in progress
subevent.description: From 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Sun Yuwei, Chen Sisi, and Zhang Jing navigated through Kunming's old neighborhoods and parks according to the task guide, completing fun challenges at several check-in points. Although they got lost and took wrong turns several times, they kept teasing one another and laughed the whole way. Running and searching helped them release the pressure of studying.
subevent.location: Kunming City Orienteering Race checkpoints (Cuihu Park, Wenming Street, Qianwang Street, etc.)

subevent.name: Post-match teahouse recap and casual chat
subevent.description: At 5 p.m., after the competition ended, the three of them went to the old town teahouse together, ordered a pot of pu'er tea and some snacks, and sat together reviewing the day's amusing moments: which roads they took by mistake, which check-in spots were most interesting, who made a fool of themselves, and so on. They laughed while drinking tea, cherishing the beautiful memories of their youthful friendship.
subevent.location: Kunming City – Old Town Teahouse (near Zhengyifang)

name: Systematic learning in the introductory tea ceremony course
description: On four consecutive Saturday afternoons—April 5, 12, 19, and 26—Sun Yuwei systematically studied basic tea techniques at Yunshuijian Teahouse under a tea master, including gaiwan brewing, using a purple clay teapot, and controlling water temperature. During the course she took careful notes and made friends with a classmate, Sister Zhao, and after class she often exchanged tea-tasting insights with her. At the same time, she studied the tea ceremony in depth as a cultural skill.

subevent.name: Pre-class preparation and registration
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Friday, April 4, Sun Yuwei went to Yunshuijian Teahouse in Wuhua District, Kunming City, formally signed up for the introductory tea ceremony class held every Saturday afternoon in April, and paid the course fee on site. Afterwards, she bought a basic gaiwan tea set and a notebook at the teaware shop inside the teahouse, preparing for the first class the next day.

subevent.name: First tea ceremony class: Basics of brewing with a gaiwan.
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, April 5, Sun Yuwei arrived on time at Yunshuijian Teahouse for her first introductory tea ceremony class. The tea master explained and demonstrated the basic techniques of gaiwan brewing, including warming the cup, adding tea, pouring water, and decanting the tea. Sun Yuwei followed along seriously, took detailed notes, and met a fellow classmate, Sister Zhao (real name Zhao Min), during the break. The two exchanged their interest in tea culture and agreed to practice together after class.

subevent.name: Second tea ceremony class: techniques for using a purple clay teapot
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, April 12, Sun Yuwei attended her second tea ceremony class. The focus of this session was on how to use the Yixing purple clay teapot, including seasoning a new pot, maintaining it, and which pot shapes suit different types of tea. Under the guidance of the tea master, Sun Yuwei practiced hands-on, paying attention to controlling the water temperature and the infusion time, and noted down insights in her notebook. During the break, she exchanged experiences with Sister Zhao about their respective gaiwan brewing practice the previous week.

subevent.name: Third tea ceremony class: water temperature control and brewing rhythm
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, April 19, Sun Yuwei attended her third tea ceremony class, which focused on the precise control of water temperature and its effect on the flavor of different teas, as well as the rhythm of brewing. She used a thermometer to measure different water temperatures, repeatedly practiced the pouring technique, and carefully recorded the optimal brewing parameters for various teas in her notes. After class, she tasted the sample tea brewed by the teacher with Sister Zhao and discussed the differences in taste.

subevent.name: Fourth tea ceremony class: comprehensive practice and course completion.
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, April 26, Sun Yuwei attended her final tea ceremony class. The class was a comprehensive review, requiring students to independently complete the entire process from preparing the utensils and warming the pot to brewing. The tea artist gave comments one by one. Sun Yuwei successfully completed the brewing demonstrations with both a gaiwan and a purple clay teapot, earning the teacher's approval. After class, she and Sister Zhao exchanged contact information and agreed to practice tea tasting together in the future.

subevent.name: Discussed tea-tasting insights with Sister Zhao after class
subevent.description: After the fourth class, Sun Yuwei and Zhao Min stayed together in the rest area of the teahouse, took out their notes, and exchanged insights from their month of learning the art of tea. They discussed the pros and cons of different brewing techniques, shared the difficulties they had encountered while practicing at home, tasted the tea samples each had brought, and talked freely about their understanding of tea culture.

name: Started reading Walden in the original English.
description: On October 7, the last day of the National Day holiday, Sun Yuwei found an English edition of Walden at an old bookstore on Wenlin Street. Starting that day, she read aloud for 30 minutes every morning, copying new words and beautiful sentences into her journal and adding small illustrations, making English reading a daily ritual. This habit, which continued until the end of the month, gave her a sense of dual accumulation of language and nature.

subevent.name: Found a bargain English edition of Walden
subevent.description: On October 7, 2025, the last day of the National Day holiday, Sun Yuwei was browsing in a second-hand bookstore on Wenlin Street in Wuhua District, Kunming, when she happened upon an English original of Walden. She bought it immediately and decided to start reading it daily.
subevent.location: Wenlin Street old bookstore, Wuhua District, Kunming

subevent.name: Daily morning reading and note-taking
subevent.description: From October 7 to October 31, 2025, Sun Yuwei spent 30 minutes every morning reading aloud the English original of "Walden" at her desk, copying new words and beautiful passages into her journal, adding small watercolor illustrations, and weaving English reading into her daily morning ritual. This continued throughout the entire month of October.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Week 1 morning reading and notes
subevent.description: From October 7 to 12, 2025, Sun Yuwei spent 30 minutes at 7:00 each morning reading the English original of Walden aloud at her desk. After reading, she copied down the new words and beautiful sentences she encountered that day in her personal journal, and used the watercolor paints she carried with her to paint a small illustration related to that day's reading. The whole process was quiet and focused, lasting about 40 minutes, and became her fixed morning ritual. This week she finished reading and taking notes on the first two chapters of the book.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Week 2: morning reading and note-taking
subevent.description: From October 13 to 19, 2025, Sun Yuwei did 30-minute readings of the original English edition of Walden at her desk every morning at 7:00. After reading aloud, she copied and translated key sentences in her journal and drew small illustrations. During this week she became more proficient, with an improved reading pace, and she paid more attention to sentence structure analysis when copying. The watercolor paintings in her journal gradually formed a series, and she tried using different tones to express the mood of the four seasons at Walden Pond.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Week Three morning reading and note-taking.
subevent.description: From October 20 to 26, 2025, Sun Yuwei read aloud from the original English edition of Walden for 30 minutes every morning at 7:00 at her desk at home. After reading, she continued to copy beautiful sentences into her journal and pair them with watercolor paintings. That week she began trying to write a few short reflections in English beside the illustrations to improve her sense of the language. She felt more accustomed to Thoreau’s language style, and while reading aloud she could feel the tranquility and strength beneath the words.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Week 4 morning reading and notes.
subevent.description: From October 27 to 31, 2025, Sun Yuwei insisted on reading aloud from the original English version of Walden for half an hour every morning at 7:00 at her desk at home, and made journal notes and illustrations. These were the last five days of the month; her reading progress had reached nearly half of the book, and her journal had accumulated a thick stack. On the morning of the 31st, she spent extra time organizing all of this month's journal entries, drawing a stage conclusion to this 25-day morning ritual.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

subevent.name: Organizing reading notes and reflections.
subevent.description: On October 31, 2025, after finishing the last morning reading session of the month, Sun Yuwei compiled the new words, beautiful sentences, and illustrations recorded in her journal, and wrote a short reading reflection, bringing this month's English reading habit to a close.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming - home study room

name: College roommate Liu Jia comes to Kunming for a small gathering
description: On October 18, Liu Jia, Sun Yuwei's college roommate, succeeded on her second attempt at the postgraduate entrance exam and was admitted to Kunming University of Science and Technology, so she made a special trip to Kunming to visit Sun Yuwei. That evening, Sun Yuwei prepared a table of home-style dishes at her rental apartment, and Liu Jia brought red wine. After dinner, they made a video call, connecting with Zhao Xiaowen far away in Chengdu and Zhou Lin, who was on a business trip. The four of them relived their dormitory night talks, talking about everything from post-graduation plans to their current relationship status, with laughter never stopping, as if they were back in college.

subevent.name: Preparing dinner ingredients
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 18, to welcome Liu Jia, Sun Yuwei went alone to the food market near her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, to buy vegetables, meat, seasonings and fruit, to prepare for making home-style dishes.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wuhua District Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Welcoming Liu Jia to the rental apartment
subevent.description: Around 6 p.m., Liu Jia took a bus from Kunming University of Science and Technology and arrived at Sun Yuwei's rented apartment in Wuhua District. The two hugged warmly and caught up on each other's news. Liu Jia handed the red wine she brought to Sun Yuwei.
subevent.location: Kunming – rental apartment in Wuhua District

subevent.name: Cooking dinner
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei started cooking in the kitchen of her rented apartment, making several home-style dishes, including toppings for Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles and mushroom soup. Liu Jia helped by washing vegetables and setting out bowls and chopsticks. As they cooked, the two chatted about exam preparation and plans after graduation.
subevent.location: Kunming – rental apartment in Wuhua District

subevent.name: Having dinner together and a video call.
subevent.description: At 7:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei and Liu Jia sat down at the table, opened the red wine Liu Jia had brought, and had dinner together. After dinner, around 8:30, the two used WeChat video call on their phones to connect with Zhao Xiaowen, who was far away in Chengdu, and Zhou Lin, who was on a business trip. Across the screen, the four of them recalled funny stories from their university dorm days, and talked about their post-graduation plans, relationship updates, and writing insights. Laughter never stopped, and the call lasted nearly two hours.
subevent.location: Kunming – rental apartment in Wuhua District

subevent.name: Seeing Liu Jia Off
subevent.description: Around 10:30 p.m., the video call ended. Since Liu Jia had classes the next day, she got up to say goodbye. Sun Yuwei walked Liu Jia downstairs, and the two agreed to meet again next time. Liu Jia took a taxi back to Kunming University of Science and Technology.
subevent.location: Downstairs of the rented apartment in Wuhua District, Kunming

name: Browse and compare consumer-type million-yuan medical insurance
description: Starting September 3, during breaks from writing, Sun Yuwei browsed pure-protection million-yuan medical insurance on Alipay and several insurance platforms. She took notes on the key points her cousin had highlighted, such as “deductible,” “guaranteed renewal,” and “exclusions,” and selected three products, drawing a comparison table in her journal.

subevent.name: Preliminary browsing of million-yuan medical insurance products.
subevent.description: During a break from writing, Sun Yuwei opened the Alipay app and browsed the list of term medical insurance products with million-yuan coverage in the insurance section. She looked at each product's name, eligible age range, basic coverage amount, and approximate premium range, and wrote down the names and links of the products she was interested in.

subevent.name: Record key insurance policy terms.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei compared the product detail pages she had browsed on several insurance platforms (Alipay, Huize, etc.) against the key points her older cousin Shen Wei had circled, such as 'deductible,' 'guaranteed renewal,' and 'exclusions.' She recorded each product's deductible, renewal conditions, and exclusion clauses as notes in her phone memo for later comparison.

subevent.name: Select three products for focused comparison.
subevent.description: Among the many products she had recorded, Sun Yuwei screened out three consumer-type million-yuan medical insurance products with relatively high overall scores based on criteria such as deductible, guaranteed renewal period, and additional services (such as green-channel medical treatment and hospitalization advance payment), and transcribed their names and core parameters into her journal.

subevent.name: Create a product comparison table.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei drew a comparison table of three medical insurance products in her journal. Horizontally, she listed the product names, coverage items (general hospitalization, critical illness medical, etc.), deductibles, maximum coverage, renewal terms, annual premiums, etc.; vertically, she compared the differences. Below the table, she wrote down her personal preferences and questions, waiting to discuss with family or consult customer service later.

name: Completed the 5km health run of the Kunming Plateau Half Marathon
description: On the morning of October 19, Sun Yuwei got up early and prepared before heading to the starting point of the Kunming Plateau Half Marathon, where she met her yoga partner He Lu and warmed up. After the 7 a.m. start, she finished steadily at a pace of about 7:48 per kilometer, with a net time of 39 minutes. After the race, she returned home and shared race photos and her reflections on Xiaohongshu.

subevent.name: Pre-competition preparation and departure
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei got up at her home in Kunming, changed into running gear, checked the sports waist pack she had bought the day before, put her phone and supplies in it, then at 6:15 walked to the starting point of the Kunming Highland Half Marathon (near Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center).
subevent.location: Kunming - at home and near the Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center

subevent.name: Highland Half Marathon and 5K Health Run Race
subevent.description: At 6:50 a.m., Sun Yuwei met her yoga partner He Lu in the starting area and they warmed up together. After the race started at 7:00, she steadily completed the 5 km course at a pace of about 7 minutes 48 seconds per kilometer, finally crossing the finish line at 7:39 with a net time of 39 minutes, successfully finishing the race.
subevent.location: Kunming Plateau Half Marathon course (Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center to Haigeng Park)

subevent.name: Post-Race Social Sharing
subevent.description: At 8:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei returned home, organized the race photos and award photos, and posted an update on Xiaohongshu with the caption "From 800 meters to 5 kilometers, it's okay to be a little slower," recording her mental journey and thanking He Lu for her company.

name: Wrote the essay 'Wrinkles Under the Shutter'
description: The family portrait photo session and the stories of her parents' youth inspired Sun Yuwei. Using this as material, she wrote the essay “Wrinkles Under the Shutter,” and communicated with her editor about trying to include it in the supplementary draft of “Slow Travel Notes.”

subevent.name: Concept development and material organization.
subevent.description: At home in her study in Kunming, Sun Yuwei flipped through the emotional notes she had taken while shooting the family portrait and the youthful stories told by her parents, settled on the essay Wrinkles Under the Shutter to use family images as a thread to explore the themes of time and memory, and listed the writing outline.
subevent.location: Study at home, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: First draft writing.
subevent.description: In her study, Sun Yuwei wrote the first draft of an essay according to the outline, focusing on the atmosphere at the family portrait photo shoot, the details of her parents’ youthful photos, and the emotional resonance these triggered. She completed a first draft of about 2,000 words.
subevent.location: Study at home, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Revising and polishing, and submission communication
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei repeatedly revised the initial draft, adjusting the rhythm of the sentences and the emotional expression, until it became the final version. She then sent the essay Wrinkles Under the Shutter to Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision, via WeChat, along with a note on her creative process, to discuss the possibility of including it in the supplement to Slow Travel Notes.
subevent.location: Study at home, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Planning a volunteer trip to Dali with Fang Qing
description: On October 2, Sun Yuwei and Fang Qing met at a teahouse by Green Lake to plan a volunteer trip to Dali next spring. They discussed the route and listed topics on Bai tie-dye and jiama paper culture. On October 3 and 4, Sun Yuwei studied the two cultures in depth at home and organized her notes. On the evening of October 5, they communicated via WeChat video, confirmed details such as the travel route, time frame, and accommodation, and agreed to continue refining the plan. The whole planning process was full of anticipation, and they made thorough preparations for the trip.

subevent.name: Planning a volunteer trip to Dali with Fang Qing at a teahouse by Cuihu Lake
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 2, Sun Yuwei met her good friend Fang Qing at a teahouse near Green Lake Park in Kunming. The two savored Pu'er tea while flipping through a Dali travel guide, planning a volunteer trip to Dali next spring together. They discussed the travel route in detail, covering Weishan Ancient Town, Shaxi Ancient Town, and other places, and listed the topics of Bai tie-dye and Jiama paper culture that they wanted to study in depth, intending to combine the trip with writing and fieldwork. The entire discussion lasted about three hours, and the two were full of anticipation for this cultural exploration.
subevent.location: Yunnan Province, Kunming - teahouse near Green Lake Park

subevent.name: At home, researching Bai tie-dye culture
subevent.description: On October 3, Sun Yuwei spent the whole day in her home study, using the internet and library materials to conduct in-depth research on the history, techniques, and modern inheritance of Dali Bai tie-dye. She recorded key points in detail, prepared material for future travel and field research, and organized everything into travel notes, planning to do hands-on experiences and creative work during her volunteer trip.

subevent.name: Researching Jiama paper culture at home.
subevent.description: On October 4, Sun Yuwei spent the whole day in her home study systematically researching the Jiama paper culture of the Dali area using online materials and related academic papers, including its origins, folk uses, and contemporary artistic value. She took notes while reading, organizing key information into a travel handbook, preparing for next spring's trip and subsequent writing.

subevent.name: Communicated online with Fang Qing to confirm travel details.
subevent.description: On the evening of October 5, Sun Yuwei had a WeChat video call with Fang Qing to share the research materials each had compiled. The two further confirmed the preliminary travel route, time frame, and the accommodations and volunteer positions that needed to be booked in advance. They agreed to continue refining the travel plan individually and to have another detailed discussion a month later.

name: Late spring insomnia: trying meditation and abdominal breathing to improve sleep
description: On April 22, Sun Yuwei searched for and downloaded guided meditation audio to prepare. On the evening of April 23, she tried guided meditation for the first time and her sleep improved slightly. On April 24, she learned the basics of diaphragmatic breathing. From April 25 to 27, she practiced diaphragmatic breathing and meditation every evening, and fell asleep faster. From April 28 to 30, she had fully mastered them, and her sleep quality improved significantly.

subevent.name: Prepare meditation resources.
subevent.description: To improve her late-spring insomnia, Sun Yuwei used her phone during the day before bedtime to search on a meditation app or related websites and download a guided meditation audio suitable for relaxing before sleep. She saved it to her playlist, preparing for her first attempt at meditation that night. At home, she previewed the audio on her bed in the bedroom to make sure the volume was appropriate and the atmosphere was quiet.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Kunming - bedroom at home

subevent.name: First attempt at guided meditation
subevent.description: Before going to bed at night, Sun Yuwei put on headphones, lay flat on the bed at home, and played the guided meditation audio she had prepared on the 22nd. She followed the audio instructions to do deep breathing and body scan exercises, trying to relax all her muscles and clear her mind. The whole process lasted about 15 minutes. Then she turned off the audio and fell asleep naturally. Her sleep improved slightly that night.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Kunming - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Learning the basics of diaphragmatic breathing
subevent.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei learned the basic steps of abdominal breathing through a health app or official account article on her phone: inhale slowly through the nose and feel the abdomen rise, hold the breath for 2-3 seconds, then exhale slowly through the mouth and feel the abdomen contract. Lying in bed, she practiced repeatedly for 10 minutes, placing both hands on her abdomen to feel the rise and fall, and tried to combine short meditation with the practice to relax her body and mind.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Kunming - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Continue practicing abdominal breathing and meditation
subevent.description: For three consecutive nights, Sun Yuwei practiced abdominal breathing before bed, about 10 minutes each time, and then played a guided meditation audio. She gradually mastered the rhythm and depth of her breathing, was able to relax her body more quickly during the practice, and her pre-sleep anxiety eased. After each night's practice, she could fall asleep within 20 minutes, noticeably faster than before.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Kunming - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Mastered the techniques; sleep quality improved significantly.
subevent.description: In the last three nights, Sun Yuwei could skillfully use abdominal breathing together with the meditation audio, and she usually fell asleep within 15 minutes after practice. The number of times she woke up at night dropped to fewer than two, and she woke up in the morning feeling more energetic than before. She felt that her late-spring insomnia had been effectively relieved, her overall sleep quality had improved significantly, and she was satisfied with the relaxing effects of abdominal breathing and meditation.
subevent.location: 123 Renmin Middle Road, Kunming - bedroom at home

name: Winter Solstice Family Gathering
description: On December 21, the Winter Solstice, Sun Yuwei stayed home with her parents and made dumplings to celebrate the festival. Her mother prepared two kinds of filling: chive and egg, and cabbage and pork. Sun Yuwei was in charge of rolling the wrappers, and her father talked about the custom of eating dumplings on the Winter Solstice in his hometown. After the meal, the family of three watched a nature documentary and spent the cold winter night in warmth.

subevent.name: Purchased Winter Solstice ingredients
subevent.description: On the morning of December 21, Sun Yuwei's mother, Li Xiulan, went to the nearby vegetable market to buy the ingredients needed for making dumplings for the Winter Solstice, including chives, eggs, Chinese cabbage, pork, and flour, to prepare for a family meal.

subevent.name: Prepare dumpling filling and dough.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 21, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan began preparing the ingredients for making dumplings in the kitchen. Her mother Li Xiulan was in charge of mixing the fillings; she prepared two kinds of filling—chive and egg, and cabbage and pork—then chopped and seasoned them. Sun Yuwei was responsible for mixing and kneading the dough to get ready for rolling out the wrappers. Her father Sun Mingyuan rested in the living room and occasionally came over to check on their progress.

subevent.name: Making dumplings together as a family.
subevent.description: From the afternoon to early evening of December 21, Sun Yuwei made dumplings with her parents in the dining room. Sun Yuwei was responsible for rolling the wrappers, her mother Li Xiulan wrapped the fillings, and her father Sun Mingyuan also joined in and made a few, while telling stories about the custom and memories of eating dumplings at the Winter Solstice in their hometown. The family chatted while wrapping, creating a warm scene.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Winter Solstice dinner: eat dumplings
subevent.description: On the evening of December 21, after the dumplings were cooked, Sun Yuwei and her family of three sat around the dining table enjoying the dumplings they had made by hand. Her mother had prepared a dipping sauce (vinegar, minced garlic, and chili oil). Everyone ate and chatted, commenting on the different fillings. Her father also had a little wine, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Kunming, Yunnan Province

subevent.name: Watch nature documentaries and tidy up after the meal.
subevent.description: After dinner on December 21, Sun Yuwei helped her parents clear the table. Then the family of three sat on the living room sofa and watched a nature documentary about wildlife. Sun Yuwei brewed hot tea, her mother brought out snacks, and her father occasionally commented on the documentary. After watching it, Sun Yuwei helped tidy up the kitchen and living room, ending a warm winter solstice evening.
subevent.location: Kunming, Yunnan Province - home living room.

name: Annual journal summary: essay collection completed, royalties 86,000 yuan, yoga 168 sessions, took the first step into financial management.
description: On November 30, Sun Yuwei opened her annual journal to compile the year's statistics: the essay collection was completed; she submitted 27 pieces during the year (19 published); total writing income was 86,000 yuan; she practiced yoga 168 times; traveled 2 times; read 57 books. She solemnly wrote "First regular fund investment in the CSI 300" and drew a small sapling icon to symbolize wealth growth. She ended with a tree shedding its leaves, signifying accumulation and renewal.

subevent.name: Prepare tools and materials for the journal summary
subevent.description: In her study at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei took down from the bookshelf her 2025 annual journal, colored pens, stickers, stamps, and other decorating tools. She also found source materials such as the spreadsheet of her submissions for the year, screenshots of yoga class check-ins, travel photo collections, and reading notes, and laid them out on her desk to prepare for the annual summary in her journal.

subevent.name: Compile statistics on the essay collection and submission payment data.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei took out her phone and laptop and went through her submission records to Culture Horizon and other platforms for 2025, checking them one by one: 27 submissions in total, 19 of which were published. At the same time, she cross-referenced bank statements and royalty notification records, calculated total royalties of 86,000 yuan, and officially entered the figure into the data page of her journal.

subevent.name: Count yoga practice sessions
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei opened the member app of 'Jingxin Yoga Life Studio' or her handwritten practice check-in journal, counted month by month from January to November, and confirmed that she completed 168 yoga sessions in 2025, an average of about 3 times per week. She accurately entered these data into the corresponding sections of her annual journal.

subevent.name: Tally the number of trips and books read
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei browsed her phone photo album and the reading records on her reading app, confirming that she took 2 trips in 2025 (likely short cultural trips) and finished reading 57 books during the year. She wrote these numbers on a dedicated journal page and briefly noted the book titles and travel destinations that left the deepest impression.

subevent.name: Write the annual summary and draw icons
subevent.description: On the year-end summary page of her annual journal, Sun Yuwei neatly wrote the year's data in pen: completed the essay collection, 27 submissions with 19 published, 86,000 yuan in writing fees, 168 yoga sessions, 2 trips, 57 books read. Then, in the 'Finance' subsection, she solemnly wrote 'First regular investment in the CSI 300 index fund' and drew a small sapling icon beside it to symbolize the growth of her wealth. Finally, at the bottom of the page, she ended with a tree shedding its leaves, symbolizing settling down and renewal, and stuck on a few golden leaf stickers.

subevent.name: Tidied up journal pages and photographed them as a record
subevent.description: After finishing all the writing and decorating, Sun Yuwei took a photo of the year-end review page with her phone and saved it in a folder named "2025 Journal." Then she closed the journal, put it back on the bookshelf, returned all the materials and stationery to their places, cleaned the desk, and ended the year-end review session.

name: Gave my parents red envelopes to thank them for raising me.
description: On December 25, Sun Yuwei used her writing earnings to transfer 2,000 yuan to each of her parents via WeChat, along with a voice message: "Thank you, Mom and Dad, for always supporting my dreams. Your daughter is now beginning to be able to give back." In the evening she went home for dinner. Her mother kept putting food on her plate, while her father looked at the transfer screenshot on his phone again and again, the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes full of smiles. Half-jokingly, he said, "Our daughter is finally supporting the family." At the dinner table, laughter and emotion intertwined.

subevent.name: Made a transfer and sent a voice message of gratitude.
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei used mobile banking at her home in Kunming to transfer 2000 yuan via WeChat to her father Sun Mingyuan and her mother Li Xiulan respectively, and recorded a grateful voice message to send to her parents, thanking them for their continued support and companionship.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

subevent.name: Go home and have dinner with parents.
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei returned to her parents' home (No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming) and had dinner with them. Her mother Li Xiulan kept putting food on her plate, while her father Sun Mingyuan looked at the transfer screenshot again and again, his eye wrinkles full of smiles, and half-jokingly said that his daughter was finally supporting the family. The dinner table was filled with laughter and emotion, and the whole family was full of joy and harmony.
subevent.location: Wuhua District, Kunming, Yunnan Province - home

name: Have an in-depth conversation with Qin Mingyuan about digital dependence and plan activities.
description: On the afternoon of December 13, 2025, Sun Yuwei received a message from Qin Mingyuan and went to Mingyuan Bookstore. The two sat by the window and had a heart-to-heart talk about digital dependence and the warmth of paper books. They decided to include a "one-hour digital detox" segment in next January's book club meeting, and together drew a hand-drawn sketch for the event poster. Sun Yuwei left in the evening.

subevent.name: Heading to Mingyuan Bookstore.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 13, 2025, after seeing Qin Mingyuan's message at home, Sun Yuwei walked to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, Kunming, planning to meet Qin Mingyuan and discuss her published article 'Fragments'.
subevent.location: Kunming City - Wenlin Street, Wuhua District

subevent.name: Heart-to-heart talk about digital dependence
subevent.description: In the seating area by the window of Mingyuan Bookstore, Qin Mingyuan and Sun Yuwei had an in-depth exchange about the essay "Fragments." Qin Mingyuan remarked that he often sees customers in the bookstore with their heads down, scrolling through their phones. The two chatted from the phenomenon of digital dependence to the warmth of paper books and the value of deep reading, sharing their observations and feelings.

subevent.name: Planning a digital detox event.
subevent.description: Based on the consensus from their heart-to-heart talk, Qin Mingyuan and Sun Yuwei decided to incorporate a "Digital Detox Hour" into the reading club next January: participants would check their phones at the door upon entering the store, focusing on reading and face-to-face conversation. The two discussed the event flow, promotion methods, and possible difficulties.

subevent.name: Hand-drawn sketch for the event poster
subevent.description: Sun Yuwei sketched the poster for the Digital Detox for One Hour event in her journal, including elements such as the event name, time, and an illustration of phone storage. Qin Mingyuan smiled and added a few strokes to perfect the composition. The tacit understanding of their cross-generational friendship flowed naturally on the paper.

subevent.name: Saying goodbye and leaving Mingyuan Bookstore
subevent.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei and Qin Mingyuan finished their event planning and creative work, packed up their journals and belongings, and agreed to further refine the event details later. Filled with inspiration and a sense of achievement, Sun Yuwei walked home to her residence on Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District.

name: Discussed financial planning with my cousin Shen Wei.
description: On October 12, Sun Yuwei and her cousin Shen Wei arranged via WeChat to have a video call that evening to discuss personal finance. At 8 p.m., they had a video call. Shen Wei suggested that Sun Yuwei use her idle royalty funds to try regular index fund investing and recommended the book “The Index Fund Investment Guide.” After the call, Sun Yuwei immediately looked up the book on a reading app and noted the key points of regular investing, planning to buy the paper edition the next day for deeper study.

subevent.name: Scheduling a video call time
subevent.description: During the day on October 12, Sun Yuwei contacted her cousin Shen Wei via WeChat, and they agreed to have a video call at 8 p.m. that evening specifically to discuss financial planning matters.

subevent.name: Video call with my cousin to discuss financial management
subevent.description: At 8 p.m. on October 12, Sun Yuwei made a video call from home on her phone with her cousin Shen Wei in Hangzhou. Shen Wei suggested that Sun Yuwei try regular investing in index funds with some of her idle royalty income, and recommended the introductory book The Index Fund Investment Guide. The two discussed in detail the basic concepts, risk-return characteristics, and operating methods of regular investing. Sun Yuwei listened carefully and took notes, saying she would research it carefully before deciding whether to start investing.

subevent.name: Looked up information on introductory personal finance books
